jobs.title: Senior Systems Engineer - Email Deliverability & Infrastructure
jobs.excerpt: • Location: Fully Remote (Global) • Compensation: $24k to $36k USD Yearly • Position Type: Full-Time Contract Role OverviewWe are seeking a highly technical, impact-driven Senior Systems Engineer to own, scale, and protect our core email transmission infrastructure.
jobs.description:
• Location: Fully Remote (Global)
  • Compensation: $24k to $36k USD Yearly
  • Position Type: Full-Time Contract

Role Overview

We are seeking a highly technical, impact-driven Senior Systems Engineer to own, scale, and protect our core email transmission infrastructure. In this role, your golden rule will be Reputation Above All. You are not just managing email lists or monitoring dashboards; you will architect and maintain the high-availability server infrastructure, Mail Transfer Agents (MTAs), and automated defensive systems that ensure our legitimate traffic hits the inbox while bad actors are ruthlessly contained.

The ideal candidate bridges the gap between deep Linux systems administration, network engineering, and advanced email deliverability strategy. You will have a massive impact on the company by safeguarding our global IP/domain reputation, minimizing blast radiuses, and ensuring zero-downtime mail operations across our entire infrastructure network.

Core Responsibilities

1. Infrastructure Management & High Availability

  • MTA Optimization: Maintain and configure core MTAs (Postfix, Postal) and IMAP/POP3 servers (Dovecot), ensuring graceful reloads over restarts to prevent dropping active connections.
  • Traffic Routing & Load Balancing: Utilize HAProxy and network routing protocols (like BGP via FRRouting) to distribute outbound traffic and architect high-volume failover mechanisms.
  • Redundancy & Failover: Administer backend infrastructure databases (PostgreSQL replica setups) and maintain dedicated "Block" backup/archive servers to instantly take over the workload of a failed primary "Cube" server.
  • Architectural Segregation: Maintain strict workload isolation across our infrastructure network—separating standard nodes for mail stacks, specialized injection nodes (Postal), and separate archiving/backup systems to prevent high-volume senders from degrading performance.

2. Deliverability Engine & Authentication Protocol Architecture

  • Protocol Enforcement: Act as the absolute technical authority on DNS and authentication setups, maintaining flawless configurations for SPF (navigating the 10-lookup limit), DKIM (key rotation and forwarding protection), DMARC (safely driving policies toward p=reject), and BIMI.
  • Traffic Throttling: Implement automated, MTA-level dynamic throttling to handle 4xx deferrals instantly, preventing a single high-volume sender from triggering global rate limits across our shared IP pools.
  • Warm-up Strategy: Design and guide automated IP/Domain Warm-up Plans for new infrastructure, managing incremental volume scaling over 2–4 week cycles.

3. Edge Security, Anti-Abuse & Incident Response

  • Outbound Spam Filtering: Configure and optimize Rspamd to actively scan, flag, and quarantine highly spammy content before it exits our network.
  • Edge Defense: Deploy automated connection-dropping systems (Fail2Ban, custom SMTP blocker scripts) to mitigate authenticated attacks, brute-force attempts, and malicious traffic.
  • Blast Radius Mitigation: Program and maintain a dynamic IP pooling engine ("The Penalty Box") to instantly isolate accounts displaying poor metrics (bounces, FBL spikes) away from prime Tier-1 IP pools.
  • Blocklist Remediation: Act as the primary responder to major DNSBL (e.g., Spamhaus) listings. Leverage log analysis to locate the root cause account, plug the security leak, and submit expert delisting requests.

4. Observability & Monitoring

  • Log Shipping Architecture: Build and manage high-performance log aggregation pipelines using Vector to ship system and MTA data into a centralized repository for real-time auditing and incident response.
  • Network Auditing: Utilize IPAudit and custom tools to continuously scan for bandwidth anomalies, connection spikes, or compromised user credentials.
  • Dashboard Management: Actively monitor ISP infrastructure portals daily (Google Postmaster Tools, Microsoft SNDS, Yahoo Sender Hub) along with third-party tracking tools (GlockApps, Validity/ReturnPath, MXToolbox, DMARCian).

Requirements

Must-Have Technical Stack & Skills:

  • Systems Engineering Background: 5+ years of experience as a Linux Systems Administrator, DevOps, or Infrastructure Engineer with deep networking knowledge (TCP/IP, routing, ports, DNS management).
  • MTA Mastery: Expert-level proficiency configuring, debugging, and optimizing enterprise mail tools such as Postfix, Dovecot, or Postal.
  • Security & Filtering: Hands-on experience writing rules and maintaining mail-filtering/anti-abuse applications like Rspamd and Fail2Ban.
  • Observability Pipelines: Proven experience building or maintaining log pipelines using Vector or similar high-scale telemetry frameworks.
  • Infrastructure Automation: Experience implementing network routing layer tools (HAProxy, FRRouting) and relational databases (PostgreSQL replication).
  • Certificate Management: Strong familiarity with automated SSL/TLS certificate rotation and multi-node compliance monitoring to ensure broken TLS never causes silent drops.

Deliverability & Operational Standards:

  • Deep comprehension of the difference between Delivery (server handoff) and Deliverability (inbox placement).
  • Expert parsing of aggregate DMARC reports using platforms like DMARCian, Valimail, or Postmark.
  • Strict commitment to Acceptable Use Policies (AUP): zero tolerance for purchased/scraped lists and a firm grasp on Feedback Loop (FBL) automated triage.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Your success in this role will be directly measured by your ability to keep our infrastructure metrics pristine:

  • Global Infrastructure Spam Complaint Rate: Maintained strictly under 0.1%.
  • Global Hard Bounce Rate: Kept consistently below 2.0%.
  • Infrastructure Uptime: 99.99% availability across all outbound MTAs and mail relays.
  • Incident Isolation Time: Transitioning high-risk or abusive senders to the "Penalty Box" or circuit-breaking campaigns within minutes of a threshold breach.

Benefits

This is a highly technical systems engineering role, not a marketing or email campaign management position. To be considered, you must have hands-on experience configuring Linux mail servers at the command-line level. Please confirm upon applying that the compensation range of $24,000 to $36,000 USD per year aligns with your expectations.

jobs.description:
PURPOSE

Leads complex, enterprise-wide strategic programs and transformation initiatives critical to achieving corporate objectives. Partners with executive and senior leadership to translate strategic priorities into executable roadmaps, align cross-functional teams, accelerate decision-making, and drive realization of intended business outcomes. The Principal Program Manager operates across business, technology, deployment, change management, and support organizations, driving integrated execution and accountability across teams without direct authority.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Scope of role: Leads enterprise strategic programs and cross-functional initiatives from strategy through execution, operational readiness, adoption, and value realization. Serves as a trusted advisor to IT Delivery Leadership and brings structure, transparency, and forward momentum to complex transformation priorities. Delivery and Execution

Establish integrated delivery strategies, governance, milestones, and operating rhythms for complex enterprise transformation initiatives. Drive execution across multiple concurrent business and technology workstreams, ensuring dependencies, risks, decisions, and commitments are actively managed. Maintain an integrated view of program critical path, organizational readiness, major dependencies, and barriers to successful delivery. Hold workstream leaders accountable for commitments and proactively drive corrective action when execution is at risk. Anticipate delivery challenges and resolve issues before they require executive escalation.

Strategic Planning and Alignment

Partner with executive and senior leadership to translate strategic objectives into actionable roadmaps, priorities, investment decisions, and measurable outcomes. Facilitate alignment across business, technology, deployment, change management, support functions, and external partners. Identify and resolve organizational friction, competing priorities, and cross-functional dependencies that impede execution. Connect program priorities and investments to enterprise strategy and expected business value.

Executive Leadership and Decision Support

Provide concise analysis, recommendations, scenarios, and briefing materials that enable timely executive decisions. Maintain visibility into significant program decisions, unresolved issues, dependencies, and required executive actions. Frame complex issues into clear decisions, options, trade-offs, recommendations, and consequences. Drive strategic decisions to conclusion and ensure resulting actions and commitments are executed. Escalate issues requiring executive intervention while driving program-level resolution at the appropriate organizational level.

Translate complex technology and transformation topics into clear business implications and executive-level narratives. Partner with organizational change management and communications teams to maintain consistent messaging across stakeholder groups. Connect program milestones and technology deliverables to business outcomes, adoption, operational readiness, and expected value. Identify when delivery activity or technical completion is not translating into intended business results. Proactively identify systemic risks, cross-program dependencies, critical decisions, and organizational constraints. Drive ownership and resolution of risks and issues rather than relying primarily on escalation. Ensure material risks include clear ownership, mitigation actions, decision points, and business implications. About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Customer Success & Client Retention Specialist to strengthen client relationships, improve the customer experience, and reduce churn.

This role is focused on what happens after a client comes onboard — making sure customers see value, stay engaged, receive proactive support, and have compelling reasons to continue the relationship.

You’ll work closely with leadership, sales, and operations to improve the customer journey from onboarding through long-term retention.

Customer Success & Relationship Management

    • NPS
    • CSAT

  • Share customer insights with leadership and relevant teams

Monitor and report on metrics such as:

  • Client retention rate
  • Customer churn
  • NPS
  • CSAT
  • Customer engagement
  • Renewal performance

Use customer data and feedback to identify trends, risks, and opportunities for improvement.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with sales, operations, and leadership teams

jobs.description:
Senior Software Engineer, Back End – Accounting & Treasury

About Caliza

Caliza is commercial banking infrastructure for companies that operate across borders. Most global businesses still piece together several banks, FX providers and spreadsheets to move money. Caliza replaces that with one platform and API: hold USD accounts, collect and pay in 33+ currencies, and convert between fiat and stablecoins, over local rails, SWIFT or stablecoins, in minutes instead of days. On top of that, we’re building the treasury layer: programmable accounts, approval policies, automated reconciliation and working capital, run by a customer’s finance team or their AI agents.

Our customers are importers, exporters, FX brokers, payment companies and fintechs across the Americas, Europe, Africa and Asia. We’re licensed and regulated across our core markets, and our team has built financial infrastructure at Visa, Nubank, EBANX, Flutterwave, Upstart, Intuit and Silicon Valley Bank.

Our backers

Initialized Capital, Better Tomorrow Ventures, Abstract Ventures, New Form Capital, QED Investors, Valor Capital and Quona Capital, along with the founders of Flutterwave, Chipper Cash, Rappi, Pomelo, Dock, Remesa Online and Anchorage.

About the role

Every payment Caliza processes has to be recorded exactly once, in the right amount, in the right currency, and reconciled against what actually happened at the bank or on-chain. Our accounting and treasury systems are the source of truth for where every dollar and stablecoin sits, and they need to be correct even when payments are returned, reversed or delayed.

As a Senior Software Engineer on our Accounting & Treasury team, you'll build and own those systems: our double-entry ledger, reconciliation against bank accounts and stablecoin wallets, the recording of fiat–stablecoin conversions, and the tooling that helps us manage liquidity across payment rails. You'll work closely with our finance, compliance and payment operations teams.

Location: Remote. Professional English required.

In your first six months, you'll

  • Design and build, from scratch, the system that tracks and accounts for our yield and financing instruments.

  • Learn our ledger and money flows end to end, across fiat rails and stablecoin wallets.

  • Reduce the manual reconciliation work our operations and finance teams do today.

  • Improve the visibility of balances and liquidity positions across rails and currencies.

What you'll be doing

  • Design, build and maintain ledger and treasury services in Kotlin and Spring Boot.

  • Model money movement correctly with double-entry accounting, including returns, reversals, fees and FX.

  • Build reconciliation between our ledger, bank statements and on-chain wallet balances, and surface breaks clearly.

  • Make our systems idempotent and resilient, so retries and partial failures never create or lose money.

  • Maintain immutable audit trails that support finance, compliance and external audits.

  • Build the data and tooling that support liquidity management.

  • Model yield-bearing and financing instruments in the ledger, from simple to complex.

  • Write thorough tests and review your teammates' code.

What we're looking for

  • 5+ years of professional back-end development experience.

  • Experience building ledgers, accounting systems, or other systems where correctness of money is critical.

  • A solid understanding of double-entry accounting: debits, credits, balances and reconciliation.

  • Strong experience with Kotlin or Java (we use Kotlin), and relational databases such as Postgres.

  • Experience with exact decimal arithmetic, idempotency, and consistency in distributed systems.

  • Experience with message-driven architectures (e.g. RabbitMQ).

  • Hands-on experience with AI-assisted development in your daily work, with the judgment to review and question what the tools produce.

  • Comfort with high autonomy and ambiguity in a fast-moving, remote startup.

  • Clear written communication. Most of our collaboration is async.

Nice to have

  • Experience at a payments company, bank, or fintech, ideally with treasury or settlement.

  • Familiarity with bank statement formats and payment messages (e.g. ISO 20022 camt.053, BAI2).

  • Experience with stablecoins, custody wallets, or on-chain reconciliation.

  • Experience with FX, multi-currency accounting, or liquidity management.

  • Experience with yield-bearing or financing instruments (e.g. money market funds, treasury bills, credit facilities).

  • Experience supporting audits or regulatory reporting.

How we work

We use AI coding tools every day and expect you to as well. They make us faster at the routine parts of the work. But you own every line you ship: you understand it, test it, and can defend it in review. That matters even more for systems that hold the source of truth for money. Because we handle financial data, we follow clear rules about what code and data can go into which tools.

Benefits

Benefits vary by country of employment and may include health coverage, paid time off and holidays, a home office or equipment allowance, a professional development budget, and in-person team offsites. Candidates based outside the US may be employed through an employer of record or engaged as contractors, with pay and benefits structured to local law and market practice.

Equal opportunity and other disclosures

Equal opportunity employer. Caliza is an equal opportunity employer. We make employment decisions without regard to race, color, religion, creed, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital or family status, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We value diverse backgrounds and encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every listed qualification.

Accommodations. We provide reasonable accommodations to qualified applicants with disabilities and to anyone who needs one during the hiring process. To request an accommodation, contact the recruiting team.

Background screening. Because we handle sensitive financial data and regulated activity, any offer will be contingent on a background check, which may include criminal history, employment and education verification, and sanctions screening, to the extent permitted by law. In the US, we conduct screening in line with the Fair Credit Reporting Act and applicable state and local fair chance laws, and we consider qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records in accordance with those laws.

Work authorization. Candidates must be authorized to work in their country of residence. We are not able to sponsor visas for this role.

Employment terms. For US-based hires, employment with Caliza is at-will. Terms for hires outside the US follow local law.

Applicant privacy. We collect and process applicant personal data solely for purposes of evaluating applications and managing the recruitment process in accordance with applicable data protection laws, including the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA), Brazil’s General Data Protection Law (LGPD), Mexico’s Federal Law on the Protection of Personal Data Held by Private Parties (LFPDPPP), the European Union’s General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), and the Nigeria Data Protection Act 2023 (NDPA). We retain personal data only for as long as necessary for these purposes or as required by applicable law. Subject to applicable legal requirements, applicants may request access to, correction or deletion of their personal data, as well as exercise other applicable rights, including restricting or objecting to processing and requesting data portability.

Use of AI in hiring. We may use AI tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications or assessing responses. These tools assist our team but do not replace human judgment, and final hiring decisions are made by people.

jobs.description:
The Patrick J. McGovern Foundation (PJMF) is a philanthropic organization dedicated to advancing artificial intelligence and data science solutions to create a thriving, equitable, and sustainable future for all. PJMF works in partnership with public, private, and social institutions to drive progress on our most pressing challenges, including digital health, climate change, broad digital access, and data maturity in the social sector.

ABOUT THE ROLE:
Strategic Capital is the Patrick J. McGovern Foundation’s grantmaking function. We fund nonprofits and civil society organizations using data science and AI to advance social good.

Portfolio Analysts help ensure that philanthropic resources are allocated effectively and with impact. They conduct research and analysis to identify and evaluate high-potential grant partners, perform due diligence through desk research, interviews, and financial reviews, and prepare materials to support final grant decisions. Analysts also monitor trends across the data and AI for good ecosystem, distill insights from existing grants, and contribute to learning that informs future investments.
This position reports to the Director of Strategic Capital and offers an opportunity to shape how PJMF deploys capital to accelerate responsible and equitable technology solutions worldwide.


HOW YOU’LL MAKE AN IMPACT:
  • Strategy Development
    • Develop and maintain a working understanding of PJMF’s grantmaking focus areas and the role of data and AI solutions within them.
    • Complete field sensing and landscape analyses that help PJMF stay abreast of new developments, opportunities, and shifts in the fields of AI and data science, and how they can be applied to drive social good.
    • Produce portfolio strategy retrospectives that synthesize outcomes, lessons, and directional insights from grant activity to inform future priorities.
    • Support the generation, validation, and refinement of strategic hypotheses and learning questions that guide PJMF’s philanthropic investments and deepen understanding of the field.
  • Grant Portfolio Development
    • Conduct research and outreach, and lead early-stage conversations, to identify nonprofit and civil society organizations whose work aligns with PJMF’s strategy and may be a fit for grant funding.
    • Prepare clear, evidence-based recommendation materials to support funding decisions.
    • Identify opportunities for collaboration and shared learning across grantees, portfolios, and adjacent fields to enhance collective impact.
  • Team Collaboration
    • Provide flexible, project-based support as we build systems and team practices that enable effective, efficient, and high-impact grantmaking.
    • Summarize learnings from grant reports and external sources into insights that contribute to the Foundation’s broader work in convening and thought leadership.

WHO YOU ARE:

  • Experience. 3+ years of relevant work experience in a role requiring rapid learning and sound judgment, such as consulting, business analysis, strategy, or investing. Comfort with data and AI topics is a plus, but curiosity and the ability to get up to speed quickly matter more than any specific sector background.
  • Fast and Nimble Learner. Prepares thoroughly for conversations and brings enough fluency to ask sharp questions without needing to be a subject-matter expert.
  • AI Fluency. Uses AI tools regularly to accelerate research, analysis, and synthesis, and brings sound judgment about when to trust, verify, or set aside their outputs. Understands the basics of how these systems work well enough to engage credibly with grantees building or deploying AI.
  • Team-oriented Independence. Pair an ability and desire to work independently with a willingness to check in with leadership and/or teammates on a variable cadence depending on the specifics of a project and its context.
  • Clear Synthesis and Communication. Critically assess how an opportunity aligns with organizational strategy and turns that analysis into a clear, well-reasoned recommendation that identifies open questions and areas for further learning. Communicate outputs from research, analysis, and other activities in a clear, concise, and structured manner.
  • Relationship Management. Be a thoughtful, responsible representative of the Foundation and remain mindful of power dynamics when interacting with external stakeholders. Proactively identify potential issues or roadblocks in external relationships and follow team norms when addressing them.
  • Curiosity. Naturally curious and energized by learning new things, with a habit of following that curiosity wherever it leads.
  • Commitment to Equity. Consistently seek to include the perspectives of underrepresented voices when assessing a potential course of action.

WHAT WE OFFER:
We offer a comprehensive benefits package with a whole person support approach including:

  • Health Insurance: Employer-paid medical, dental, and vision insurance for employees, spouses/domestic partners, and dependents. HSA/FSA plans, life insurance, and short- and long-term disability coverage
  • Long-term Rewards: 401(k) retirement plan with generous matching up to 6% of annual pay, plus an additional discretionary match at the end of the year
  • Time Off: Flexible PTO Policy, 11 paid holidays, paid sick leave, and paid holiday breaks
  • Remote Work Environment: Ability to work 100% remotely, but not alone - with mature, socially minded professionals who care about each other as much as the work, and we connect in person at least once a year to collaborate and create together
  • Wellness Support: Access to Ginger+, Active and Fit Gym membership discount, and SmartSpend Plus, along with financial well-being providers
  • Parental Leave: Up to 6 months of gender-neutral paid leave for parents and caregivers when they have a new addition to their families
  • Learning & Development: Company reimbursement policy, allowing employees to explore development opportunities such as peer learning, internal trainings, and external activities or conferences; savings on student loans (available via insurance provider)
  • Philanthropic Matching Gift Program: Opportunity for team members to support vulnerable communities, reflecting PJMF’s commitment to social impact
The starting salary range for this position is $100,000 - $115,000 annually. The actual offer may vary depending on factors including the candidate’s relevant experience, education, certifications, skills, and geographic location.

Agora dá uma olhada nas principais responsabilidades da vaga:

Direção e estratégia de design

  • Responder pelas decisões estratégicas de design e usabilidade do Astrea, definindo princípios, padrões e diretrizes que orientam todos os squads.
  • Liderar o redesign do produto de ponta a ponta: visão, conceito, arquitetura de informação, padrões de interação e plano de entrega incremental em convivência com as telas legadas.
  • Traduzir a estratégia de produto em direção de design, apresentando racional e trade-offs para diretoria, GPMs, PMs e Engenharia.

Design system

  • Ser guardião(ã) do design system: estratégia, arquitetura de componentes, documentação, governança, roadmap e métricas de adoção.
  • Garantir, junto com Engenharia, que o design system seja implementável em código, com o Figma como fonte da verdade e handoff claro.
  • Incorporar acessibilidade e usabilidade como padrão nos componentes e fluxos.

Liderança de projetos e execução

  • Conduzir a execução dos projetos transversais com os designers dos squads: planejar frentes, distribuir trabalho, revisar entregas e garantir consistência.
  • Atuar hands-on em fluxos, protótipos e UI de alta fidelidade nos pontos mais críticos dos projetos.
  • Conduzir pesquisas, testes de usabilidade e validações qualitativas e quantitativas para embasar as decisões de design.
  • Facilitar workshops, alinhamentos e dinâmicas de ideação e priorização entre squads.

Qualidade e desenvolvimento do time de design

IA no design e no produto

  • Definir padrões de experiência para funcionalidades de IA no Astrea, como assistentes e automações nos fluxos do escritório.

Para participar desta seleção, nossa expectativa é de que você tenha:

  • Graduação em Design ou áreas correlatas.

About the Job

zerohash is looking for a Senior Blockchain Engineer to help architect and build the infrastructure that powers digital asset transactions across multiple blockchain networks. We are a high-performing team looking for an equally ambitious and driven teammate.

The right candidate for this position is detail-oriented, deeply technical, and driven. You are eager to learn new technologies and complex systems. You build resiliency and scalability into the platform at every step.

If you're looking to have a massive impact in one of the most exciting markets in decades, you will find this role challenging and rewarding in equal measure

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and build blockchain integration services — transaction signing, deposit processing, and confirmation tracking — across multiple networks (EVM, Solana, Polkadot, XRP, and others)
  • Build and maintain gRPC microservices in Go within an event-driven architecture using NATS JetStream
  • Implement transaction state machines with reliability guarantees including idempotency, distributed locking, and chain reorganization handling
  • Integrate with custody providers for secure transaction signing and wallet management
  • Monitor blockchain networks for deposits, confirmations, and anomalies
  • Participate in on-call rotation, responding to production incidents across blockchain infrastructure
  • When necessary, communicate directly with client technical teams

Requirements

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience, preferably in the FinTech space
  • Deep proficiency with Go
  • Understanding of blockchain technologies, protocols, and their applications
  • Experience with gRPC and Protocol Buffers
  • Familiarity with message brokers or event streaming systems (NATS, Kafka, or similar)
  • Experience with MongoDB or other document databases
  • Understanding of SQL and relational database schema design
  • A humble and scrappy get-it-done mindset; you're resourceful and in your element going from 0 to 1
  • Excellent problem solving skills — can troubleshoot complex distributed systems
  • Comfort with ambiguity; the ability to independently lay out and test clear hypotheses and solve problems without well-defined direction
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills

Preferred

  • Bachelor's in computer science or equivalent experience
  • Experience at a banking-as-a-service, brokerage-as-a-service, or payment-as-a-service business
  • Experience with digital assets or centralized exchanges
  • Experience integrating with blockchain custody platforms (Fireblocks, BitGo, or similar)
  • Experience with distributed systems patterns (distributed locking, idempotency, state machines, CQRS)
  • Experience with smart contracts
  • Familiarity with Kubernetes and observability tooling (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry)

About zerohash

zerohash is the leading crypto and stablecoin infrastructure platform and the operating system for digital money, powering the next generation of financial services. Founded in 2017, zerohash enables banks, brokerages, fintechs, and payment companies to offer crypto trading, stablecoin payments, and tokenized assets without having to build or manage complex blockchain infrastructure on their own.

The zerohash platform supports three core pillars: Trade, Transact, and Tokenize. Through a single integration, customers can launch regulated crypto buy, sell, and custody services; enable 24/7 stablecoin-based funding, payouts, and settlement; and issue and manage tokenized assets with built-in compliance, risk controls, and reporting. By abstracting away technical, regulatory, and operational complexity, zerohash allows partners to treat digital assets as just another financial primitive: fast, programmable, and global.

zerohash is trusted by some of the world’s most recognized financial and consumer brands, including Interactive Brokers, Morgan Stanley, Stripe, Franklin Templeton, BlackRock, DraftKings, Gusto, Worldpay, Kalshi, One Pay, among others. Today, zero infrastructure supports millions of end users across brokerage, wealth, payments, and marketplace platforms globally.

The company is deeply regulated and compliance-first, operating across the U.S. and internationally with licenses and approvals that allow partners to enter crypto and stablecoins with confidence. zerohash has become a trusted partner for enterprises seeking to modernize financial products while meeting the highest standards for security, risk management, and regulatory oversight.

To date, zerohash has raised over $280 million in funding from a mix of leading venture firms and strategic investors, including Morgan Stanley, Interactive Brokers, SoFi, Point72 Ventures, Bain Capital Crypto, Lightspeed Venture Partners, and more.

zerohash has been featured in top-tier media outlets such as Bloomberg, CNBC, The Wall Street Journal, Financial Times, Reuters, Forbes, and CoinDesk, and its leadership team regularly contributes to global conversations on the future of payments, investing, and financial infrastructure.

At zerohash, we're building the infrastructure that makes digital money work securely, compliantly, and at global scale.

For any concerns relating to Republic Services’ commitment to equal opportunity employment, you may contact the AWARE Line at 1-866-3-AWARE-4.

ABOUT THE COMPANY

Republic Services, Inc. (NYSE: RSG) is a leader in the environmental services industry. We provide customers with the most complete set of products and services, including recycling, waste, special waste, hazardous waste and field services. Our industry-leading commitments to advance circularity and support decarbonization are helping deliver on our vision to partner with customers to create a more sustainable world.


In 2025, Republic’s total company revenue was $16.6 billion, and adjusted EBITDA was $5.3 billion. We serve 13 million customers and operate more than 1,000 locations, including collection and transfer stations, recycling and polymer centers, treatment facilities, and landfills.


Although we operate across North America, the collection, recycling, treatment, or disposal of materials is a local business, and the dynamics and opportunities differ in each market we serve. By combining local operational management with standardized business practices, we drive greater operating efficiencies across the company while maintaining day-to-day operational decisions at the local level, closest to the customer.


Our customers, including small businesses, major corporations and municipalities, want a partner with the expertise and capabilities to effectively manage their multiple recycling and waste streams. They choose Republic Services because we are committed to exceeding their expectations and helping them achieve their sustainability goals. Our 42,000 team members understand that it's not just what we do that matters, but how we do it.


Our company values guide our daily actions:

  • Safe: We protect the livelihoods of our colleagues and communities.
  • Committed to Serve: We go above and beyond to exceed our customers’ expectations.
  • Environmentally Responsible: We take action to improve our environment.
  • Driven: We deliver results in the right way.
  • Human-Centered: We respect the dignity and unique potential of every person.

We are proud of our high employee engagement score of 86. We have an inclusive and diverse culture where every voice counts. In addition, our team positively impacted 5.1 million people in 2024 through the Republic Services Charitable Foundation and local community grants. These projects are designed to meet the specific needs of the communities we serve, with a focus on building sustainable neighborhoods.


STRATEGY

Republic Services’ strategy is designed to generate profitable growth. Through acquisitions and industry advancements, we safely and sustainably manage our customers’ multiple waste streams through a North American footprint of vertically integrated assets.

We focus on three areas of growth to meet the increasing needs of our customers: recycling and waste, environmental solutions and sustainability innovation.

With our integrated approach, strengthening our position in one area advances other areas of our business. For example, as we grow volume in recycling and waste, we collect additional material to bolster our circularity capabilities. And as we expand environmental solutions, we drive additional opportunities to provide these services to our existing recycling and waste customers.


Recycling and Waste

We continue to expand our recycling and waste business footprint throughout North America through organic growth and targeted acquisitions. The 13 million customers we serve and our more than 5 million pick-ups per day provide us with a distinct advantage. We aggregate materials at scale, unlocking new opportunities for advanced recycling. In addition, we are cross-selling new products and services to better meet our customers’ specific needs.


Environmental Solutions

Our comprehensive environmental solutions capabilities help customers safely manage their most technical waste streams. We are expanding both our capabilities and our geographic footprint. We see strong growth opportunities for our offerings, including PFAS remediation, an increasing customer need.

Sustainability Innovation

Republic’s recent innovations to advance circularity and decarbonization demonstrate our unique ability to leverage sustainability as a platform for growth.


The Republic Services Polymer Center is the nation’s first integrated plastics recycling facility. These innovative sites process rigid plastics from our recycling centers, producing recycled materials that promote true bottle-to-bottle circularity. We also formed Blue Polymers, a joint venture with Ravago, to develop facilities that will further process plastic material from our Polymer Centers to help meet the growing demand for sustainable packaging. We are building a network of Polymer Centers and Blue Polymer facilities across North America.


Our customers are increasingly looking for decarbonization solutions, and we are leveraging our network of landfills to meet that need. Republic is committed to harnessing landfill gas, a natural byproduct of decomposing waste, and converting it to energy. Republic has partnered with renewable gas developers to construct Renewable Natural Gas (RNG) plants at our landfills, expanding beyond the 77 projects we currently have to make progress towards our goal to beneficially reuse 50% more biogas by 2030 (2017 baseline year).

Esta é uma oportunidade exclusiva para Pessoas com Deficiência (PcD)
Vaga 100% remota

Aqui a gente conecta o mundo

A Sensedia é uma multinacional brasileira provedora de plataforma de gerenciamento de APIs, governança de agentes e soluções de integração, além de serviços profissionais. Impulsionamos a transformação digital de grandes empresas, habilitando arquiteturas mais ágeis, modernas e escaláveis para que nossos clientes possam oferecer melhores produtos e experiências digitais.

Trabalhar aqui é pertencer a uma cultura plural, descontraída e inovadora. É ter espaço para contribuir com diferentes perspectivas, aprender, experimentar e construir junto.

Acreditamos que times diversos ampliam a forma como pensamos, criamos e entregamos. Por isso, esta oportunidade faz parte do nosso compromisso de ampliar a representatividade de Pessoas com Deficiência na Sensedia e construir experiências cada vez mais inclusivas.

Nos comprometemos com um ambiente acolhedor e respeitoso e, durante o processo seletivo, queremos entender também quais condições podemos oferecer para proporcionar a melhor experiência para cada pessoa.

Conheça mais sobre a Sensedia em: Sensedia Careers

Qual a missão do cargo?

Garantir a qualidade da entrega do produto da melhor maneira possível e ao mesmo tempo desenvolver, manter e evoluir os nossos processos de Qualidade com foco em Testes de APIs e microserviços.

Quais serão suas atividades no dia a dia?

  • Implantar e disseminar a cultura de qualidade para o time e dentro de projetos correlacionados.
  • Criar um relacionamento de parceria junto a área de desenvolvimento para que haja alinhamento para a criação e evolução do projeto / produto.
  • Executar os testes funcionais manuais e automatizados, com objetivo de garantir a qualidade da entrega (código / produto / processo). Avaliar e mitigar possíveis bugs (código / produto / produção) que possam aparecer durante o desenvolvimento do projeto / produto.
  • Compreender a demanda e regras de negócio para garantir a qualidade da entrega e alinhamento entre projetos /produtos. Participar ativamente dos ritos ágeis do time.
  • Executar testes exploratórios e integrados, a partir dos requisitos definidos pelo cliente (interno / externo).
  • Compreender design e padrões de API para executar os testes atendendo às diversas demandas do projeto / produto.
  • Realizar reuniões junto ao cliente para alinhamento de demandas.
  • Identificar novas ferramentas e inovações que sejam adequadas para o projeto / produto, considerando as particularidades do contexto em que estiver inserido.
  • Criar e aprimorar documentos que facilitem a utilização do produto para o usuário a partir de orientações recebidas dos líderes e arquitetos.
  • Realizar o levantamento de cenários de testes, identificando fluxos básicos e alternativos.
  • Preparar massa de dados para execução de cenários de testes.
  • Colaborar na coleta de dados para criação de métricas e gerar estimativas para entregar ao cliente.
  • Preparar o ambiente de teste para iniciar os testes seguindo as demandas.
  • Aplicar os conceitos de testes adequados para garantir a qualidade da entrega.

Quais são os requisitos obrigatórios para este cargo?

  • Experiência em ferramentas de testes android como: Appium, Robot Framework, Roboeletric, JUnit, Mockk, Espresso e UI Automator;
  • Experiência em ferramentas de testes para backend como: Postman e Newman;
  • Ferramentas utilizadas pela companhia: Jira, Git, Zephyr Scale, RabbitMQ e Openshift;
  • Experiência com alguma ferramenta de CI/CD como: Jenkins, Bitbucket Pipelines ou Gitlab;
  • Experiência em banco de dados relacionais e não relacionais;
  • Experiência com testes em Microserviços e filas de processamentos como o RabbitMQ;
  • Experiência em versionamento com Git;
  • Experiência em banco de dados (SQL, NoSQL);
  • Ter atuado em times ágeis;
  • Ter visão de todo o ciclo de entrega da solução e propor melhorias;
  • Conhecimentos em APIs RESTful e GraphQL;
  • Forte senso de análise crítica e validação de problemas na aplicação e consulta de logs para extração e abertura de bugs para equipe de desenvolvimento.

Quais são os diferenciais para este cargo?

  • Experiência com automação de testes, em alguma linguagem de programação, como: Javascript, Java ou NodeJS;
  • Experiência em ferramentas de automação de testes como: Cucumber, JUnit, Postman/Newman, REST Assured, JMeter.

Sobre esta oportunidade

Esta é uma vaga exclusiva para Pessoas com Deficiência (PcD).

Sabemos que cada pessoa possui experiências e necessidades diferentes. Por isso, durante a candidatura, teremos algumas perguntas para conhecer melhor você e entender se existe alguma adaptação ou recurso de acessibilidade que possamos oferecer durante o processo seletivo.

Caso precise de alguma adaptação — como recursos de acessibilidade, adequação de uma etapa, apoio de comunicação ou outra necessidade — queremos saber. Nosso time de Talent Acquisition estará disponível para conversar com você.

A necessidade de adaptação não interfere na avaliação das suas competências para a posição.

Temos o #WorkWhereYouBelong como nossa proposta de valor para um modelo flexível de trabalho. Trabalhe onde você pertence, porque as barreiras físicas estão menores e queremos que exista uma só Sensedia, independentemente de onde você esteja.

Queremos conhecer você!

Queremos conhecer sua trajetória, suas experiências e o que você pode construir com a gente.

Who you are:

As a Digital Analytics Engineer, you'll own how Hometap captures and governs its product and marketing event data. Today we track roughly 200 product events, and you'll be the person who manages that ecosystem by owning the event taxonomy and tracking plan, to keep the data flowing into our downstream tools trustworthy. You'll sit on the data engineering and analytics team and work closely with marketing, product, and engineering - all of whom interact with this data to make decisions.

This is a role for someone early in their analytics engineering career who cares about data quality, can turn messy tracking into a clear system, and is comfortable partnering across teams to get instrumentation right.

What you'll do:

  • Audit the current Segment inventory, consolidate duplicates and naming drift, and establish a governed object-action naming convention
  • Build and maintain the tracking plan, keeping it to a navigable size, and deprecating events deliberately as the product changes.
  • Stand up enforcement so standards are gated
  • Configure and manage Segment Protocols for schema validation and violation handling, and manage the sources feeding downstream tools
  • Advise on our hybrid capture model with product and engineering; determine if events should be server-side, client-side, or both
  • Partner with marketing, product, and engineering on what gets tracked and what it means, and translate their requirements into well-formed event specs
  • Document tracking standards, interact with teams so they instrument consistently, and run a review process for proposing, approving, and deprecating events
  • Build automated monitoring for schema conformance, event volume, and property completeness that catches naming drift, type mutation, and alert on shift before it corrupts downstream metrics

What you bring:

  • 2+ years of experience in a Data Analyst, Data Analytics, or similar role
  • Experience with Segment or a similar customer data platform. Familiarity with the broader analytics landscape like Amplitude, Mixpanel, PostHog, or GA4 is a plus
  • A solid grasp of event taxonomy and tracking-plan concepts, including object-action naming, controlled vocabularies, and property typing
  • SQL proficiency and comfort querying data in a cloud data warehouse
  • Working knowledge of JSON Schema and JavaScript
  • Familiarity with Git and CI/CD, and the instinct to treat tracking like code by wiring validation and tests into the pipeline
  • Ability to explain tracking standards clearly to marketing, product, and engineering partners and align non-technical stakeholders on why governance matters

The salary range for this role is $110,000 - $120,000, depending on your experience, skills, location, and other factors. You’ll also receive meaningful equity, so you can share in our growth and success. We offer generous medical, dental, and vision coverage, a work-from-home stipend, parental leave, and plenty of paid time off to recharge.

Hometap is on a mission to make homeownership less stressful and more accessible. Our home equity investment product provides homeowners with a fast, simple, and straightforward way to access the equity in their home without taking out a loan or having to sell. By investing alongside homeowners, Hometap offers debt-free cash in exchange for a share of their home’s future value — all without any monthly payments over the life of the investment. Through a combination of financial innovation and best-in-class customer service, Hometap enables people to get more from homeownership so they can get more from life.

L’objectif de ce projet vise à collecter des enregistrements vocaux de personnes de langue maternelle française afin d’améliorer les technologies d’assistant vocal.

Description de la tâche :

Pour ce projet, nous recherchons une grande variété de locuteurs natifs de langue française (France et outre-mer) avec divers accents régionaux. Les participants enregistreront de courtes phrases d’activation et des énoncés scriptés généralement utilisés lors d’interactions avec un assistant vocal, en suivant les instructions fournies.

Qui peut participer à l’étude ?

Pour participer, vous devez remplir les conditions suivantes :

  • Avoir 18 ans ou plus.

  • Être né(e) et vivre en France ou outre-mer.

  • Être de langue maternelle française, de n’importe quelle région de France ou outre-mer.

  • Avoir une bonne maîtrise de l’anglais, car toutes les instructions du projet seront en anglais.

  • Être en mesure d’utiliser un téléphone portable pour ce projet.

  • Pouvoir utiliser un casque filaire ou le microphone de l’appareil pour enregistrer des phrases.

  • Avoir accès à un environnement intérieur calme pour effectuer les enregistrements.

    Notes:

    • Dans le cadre de ce projet, nous recherchons des participants issus de groupes démographiques spécifiques afin de contribuer au développement d’une technologie impartiale qui soit représentative de tous. Certains groupes sont déjà complets, mais nous recherchons toujours des voix masculines avec des accents du Nord, du Nord-est, du Sud-ouest et du Sud-est de la France.

    • Nous recherchons aussi des participants issus d’outre-mer: Guadeloupe (971), Martinique (972), Guyane (973), La Réunion (974), Mayotte (976), Saint-Pierre-et-Miquelon (975), Saint-Barthélemy (977), Saint-Martin (978), Wallis-et-Futuna (986), Polynésie française (987), Nouvelle-Calédonie (988), Terres australes et antarctiques françaises (984) et Clipperton (989).

Veuillez noter que ce projet est également ouvert aux participantsâgés de 7 à 17 ans. Pour plus de détails, veuillez vous référer à ce formulaire :Gardenia Speech Collection - France (Minors) | DataForce Community

Où le projet a-t-il lieu ?

C’est un projet entièrement à distance. Vous pouvez participer depuis n’importe où en France ou outre-mer.

Combien de temps dure-t-il ?

La durée estimée de la tâche d’enregistrement est de 30 minutes.

Quel est le montant de la rémunération ?

Vous recevrez $ 33 USD pour vos livrables entièrement terminés et acceptés.

jobs.description:
JAVA ENGINEERING LEAD – CUSTOMER COMMUNICATION MANAGEMENT (ENGINEER II/III)
Brand, Marketing & Communications | Mutual of Omaha Information Services

Mutual of Omaha is expanding its Brand, Marketing & Communications (BMC) program to launch a newly approved, enterprise-wide Customer Communication Management (CCM) platform. This is not a backfill – it is a new role created to help build something from the ground up. The CCM platform will give our customers control over how they receive information from Mutual of Omaha, moving statements and benefit communications that were traditionally printed and mailed to secure digital delivery. The result: a better customer experience and meaningful cost savings for the company.

As the Engineering Lead for the CCM platform, you will set the technical direction and engineering standards across a set of interconnected applications – spanning greenfield development, enterprise scaling of existing applications, and integration with vendor and internal systems. You will serve as a Solution Lead, starting with a newly formed discovery team and continuing as the platform expands into dedicated delivery teams.

This role combines technical leadership with hands-on engineering (approximately 40–50% coding). The ideal candidate is an experienced solution or engineering lead who enjoys building new platforms, keeps teams honest on engineering practices, and is energized by shaping a multi-year transformation of how Mutual of Omaha communicates with its customers.

WHAT WE CAN OFFER YOU:

  • Estimated Salary:
    • Engineer II - $125,000 - $140,000, plus annual bonus opportunity
    • Engineer III - $150,000 - $163,000, plus annual bonus opportunity
  • Benefits and Perks: 401(k) plan with a 2% company contribution and 6% company match
  • Time Off: Up to 15 days of vacation annually, plus 11 paid holidays including 2 floating holidays
  • Work Arrangement: Remote, with occasional in-person team events (approximately once per year for 3–4 days)
  • Eligibility: Applicants must not now, nor in the future, require employment sponsorship

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

  • Platform Engineering Leadership: Serve as the overall engineering lead for the CCM platform, establishing and enforcing engineering standards, patterns, and practices across interconnected applications to ensure they are scalable, maintainable, and ready for future growth.
  • Solution Leadership: Act as Solution Lead for the CCM discovery team and future delivery teams, coordinating closely with other Solution Leads to align designs, dependencies, and delivery across the program.
  • Hands-On Development: Spend roughly 40–50% of your time coding – building greenfield applications and enhancing and scaling existing applications using Java, MuleSoft, and AWS.
  • Discovery & Build-vs-Buy Analysis: Assess the capabilities and gaps of existing applications, estimate the effort to make them enterprise-ready, and evaluate vendor solutions to recommend where to build versus buy. Findings will directly shape the 2027 critical path plan.
  • Platform Capabilities: Help design and deliver core CCM capabilities, including a decision engine, a customer consent and preference center, workflow management, and analytics tracking – along with integrations to Salesforce and third-party tools.
  • Mentorship & Collaboration: Mentor and guide engineers on the team and partner with QA, business analysts, and technical leadership within a SAFe Agile environment (three-week sprints, quarterly PI planning).
  • AI-Enabled Engineering: Champion the use of AI tools and agents to accelerate development, improve code quality, and increase team productivity.

WHAT YOU’LL BRING:

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, including experience as a Solution Lead, Engineering Lead, or Technical Lead.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Java and AWS cloud services.
  • Experience with MuleSoft or similar integration platforms, including API design and system-to-system integration.
  • Proven track record of building applications from scratch and taking them from concept to production.
  • Experience scaling and modernizing existing applications for enterprise-wide use.
  • Ability to define and uphold engineering standards across multiple applications and teams.
  • Experience with CI/CD practices and tooling, including GitHub.
  • Experience leading and mentoring other engineers.
  • Comfortable working in SAFe Agile environments and contributing to PI planning within Agile Release Trains (ART).
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to coordinate across teams and stakeholders.

PREFERRED:

  • Experience with Vue.js.
  • Experience with TypeScript and AWS CDK.
  • Experience or strong interest in AI-assisted engineering, including using AI agents in the development process.
  • Experience with Salesforce integrations.
  • Experience with customer communication management, digital document delivery, or consent and preference management solutions.
  • Experience evaluating and implementing vendor solutions.
  • Insurance or financial services industry experience.

We value diverse experience, skills, and passion for innovation. If your experience aligns with the listed requirements, please apply!

We invite photographers, photo hobbyists, visual creators, and anyone passionate about photography to participate in our RAW Photo Collection project.

The photos should be native RAW and DNG where applicable (including CR3, NEF, ARW, RAF, DNG, RW2, ORF, and PEF). These files retain the raw data captured by the device at the moment the photo was taken.

All submitted photos must be original and taken by you. Photos downloaded from the internet or generated using AI will not be accepted.

Intellectual Property Rights:Participants retain full ownership of all submitted photos, which will be used exclusively for internal purposes by our client and will not be distributed, or published.

    • iPhone models accepted:

      • 15 Pro, 15 Pro Max

      • 16 Pro, 16 Pro Max

      • 17 Pro, 17 Pro Max

        No other smartphones are permitted.

    • Digital Cameras

      • Full-frame mirrorless

      • Full-frame DSLR

      • APS-C mirrorless

      • APS-C DSL

Where is the project taking place?

This is a fully remote project. You can participate from the comfort of your home or preferred location within the US.

jobs.excerpt: ABOUT USOur client is an established business coaching company that helps successful business owners build stronger, more scalable, owner-independent companies.
jobs.description:
ABOUT US

Our client is an established business coaching company that helps successful business owners build stronger, more scalable, owner-independent companies. For more than 20 years, the company has worked with business owners to improve growth, profitability, leadership, systems, and ultimately create businesses that can thrive without depending entirely on the owner.

They are seeking an experienced, hands-on Sales Leader to lead, rebuild, and scale our sales organization.

This is not a role for someone who has only managed sales teams from a distance. They are looking for a true player-coach: someone who has personally been a successful high-ticket salesperson, knows how to coach and develop salespeople, has built outbound-generated pipeline, and has successfully improved an underperforming sales organization.

Why Join US

This is an opportunity to make a visible impact, not simply maintain an existing sales organization.

You'll inherit a company with an established brand, proven coaching programs, existing sales infrastructure, a substantial prospect database, and a history of strong sales performance—but you'll also have the autonomy to rebuild and improve the sales engine.

The right person will have significant influence over how the sales organization evolves and meaningful upside as the company grows.

If you're a proven sales leader who still understands what it takes to personally win business—and you enjoy building teams, fixing problems, and creating predictable revenue—we'd like to talk.

Compensation: $60,000–$100,000 base/guaranteed compensation + uncapped performance compensation
Expected Year-One Earnings:Approximately $150,000–$200,000 based on performance

The Opportunity

The sales organization currently includes:

  • A team of outbound setters responsible for proactively generating qualified sales appointments.

  • An Enrollment Director responsible for conducting consultative sales conversations and enrolling business owners into coaching programs.

  • An Account Management function responsible for client relationships, retention, referrals, and expansion opportunities.

The foundation is already in place, including CRM, dialing technology, sales scripts, an existing database, and a functioning outbound process.

The next Sales Leader will own improving, scaling, and managing the system.

Initially, your biggest priorities will be scaling the outbound setter team and improving closing performance. Over time, you will also develop additional revenue opportunities through referrals, past-client reactivation, previous qualified prospects, events, and other proactive sales strategies.

What You'll Do

Lead and Scale the Sales Team

Manage, coach, train, and develop the company's sales organization, including outbound setters and Enrollment Directors.

Recruit and onboard additional sales talent as the organization grows.

Establish clear expectations, activity standards, KPIs, accountability, and performance management.

Make difficult personnel decisions when necessary and continuously upgrade the strength of the sales organization.

Build a Predictable Outbound Sales Engine

Scale the existing outbound setter organization to consistently generate qualified sales conversations.

Create a sales organization that can generate its own pipeline rather than relying primarily on inbound marketing.

Continuously improve prospecting strategies, scripts, lead management, follow-up, reactivation, and referral generation.

Work closely with leadership and marketing to maximize the company's house database, outbound lists, inbound opportunities, events, referrals, and other lead sources.

Coach High-Ticket Sales

Review sales conversations and identify opportunities to improve discovery, qualification, objection handling, emotional engagement, and closing.

Coach Enrollment Directors through recorded calls, role-playing, scripting, and ongoing feedback.

Initially serve as a backup closer when necessary.

The long-term goal is not for the Sales Leader to compete with the sales team for deals, but this person must be capable of stepping into a sales conversation, successfully closing business, and demonstrating what great selling looks like.

Drive Sales Performance

Analyze activity, appointments, conversion rates, enrollments, pipeline, and revenue.

Use data to identify performance gaps and translate those insights into specific coaching, process, staffing, and sales strategies.

Build a disciplined sales culture focused on accountability and measurable results.

Initial Success Measures

Within approximately the first 2–4 months, we expect the Sales Leader to:

  • Evaluate the existing sales organization.

  • Scale and strengthen the outbound setter team.

  • Build toward approximately 6–8 productive part-time setters.

  • Generate at least 20–30 held qualified sales appointments per month.

  • Evaluate current closing performance and determine the appropriate coaching or personnel strategy.

  • Begin moving qualified close rates toward a minimum 25% target.

After stabilizing the core sales organization, the Sales Leader will expand into referrals, client reactivation, previous qualified opportunities, events, and other self-generated revenue strategies.

What We're Looking For

1. Experience With a Comparable Sales Model

You have meaningful experience with a sales process where appointments are generated and then handed to a closer for a consultative sales conversation.

Ideally, you have sold high-ticket services or programs directly to small and midsized business owners through phone or Zoom conversations.

2. You Have Personally Been a Successful Salesperson

You didn't begin your career managing salespeople—you learned how to sell.

You can discuss your personal sales results, close rates, average deal sizes, quotas, and performance.

You understand how to conduct discovery, uncover business and emotional pain, handle objections, and confidently ask for the business.

3. You Know How to Generate Business Without Depending on Marketing

You have led teams that generated meaningful pipeline through outbound prospecting, cold and warm outreach, database reactivation, referrals, or similar proactive strategies.

You appreciate inbound leads, but don't depend on them to succeed.

4. You've Successfully Rebuilt a Sales Team

You have at least five years of relevant sales leadership experience, ideally 10+.

More importantly, you've inherited an underperforming sales team or sales function and materially improved it.

You can clearly explain:

  • What performance looked like when you arrived.

  • What wasn't working.

  • What you changed.

  • Who you hired, coached, or replaced.

  • How you changed process or accountability.

  • The measurable results that followed.

5. You're a High-Accountability Leader
You're self-directed, organized, and comfortable operating with autonomy.

You communicate clearly, do what you say you're going to do, and take ownership when something isn't working.

You're comfortable making difficult decisions and don't need someone else continually motivating or managing you.

Outbound Sales Development Representative – Remote

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a highly driven and results-oriented Outbound Sales Development Representative (SDR) to help build and scale their outbound sales function.

This is not a lead-following role.

You’ll be responsible for building your own prospect lists, executing multi-channel outbound campaigns, booking qualified meetings, and maintaining a healthy sales pipeline. Success in this role comes from proactively creating opportunities through cold calling, cold emailing, and LinkedIn outreach—not waiting for inbound leads.

If you’re competitive, resilient, and thrive on opening doors with decision-makers, this role offers significant growth potential within a fast-growing marketing agency serving the home services industry.

What You’ll Own

Outbound Prospecting & Lead Generation

  • Execute high-volume outbound prospecting through:
    • Cold calls
    • Cold emails
    • LinkedIn outreach
  • Identify and engage decision-makers within target companies.
  • Build and maintain your own prospecting lists using sales tools and research.
  • Generate qualified opportunities for the closing team.
  • Maintain consistent daily outreach activity across multiple channels.

Appointment Setting & Pipeline Development

  • Book qualified meetings with prospective clients.
  • Qualify prospects using established criteria before scheduling appointments.
  • Improve meeting attendance through effective follow-up and communication.
  • Maintain a healthy pipeline of opportunities.
  • Partner closely with Account Executives to ensure smooth handoffs.

Objection Handling & Sales Execution

  • Handle objections confidently and professionally.
  • Navigate gatekeepers and decision-makers effectively.
  • Build rapport and communicate value quickly.
  • Continuously improve scripts, messaging, and outreach strategies.
  • Test new approaches to increase conversion rates.

CRM & Sales Operations

  • Maintain accurate CRM records and pipeline updates.
  • Log call notes, outreach activities, and follow-up tasks.
  • Track opportunity stages and sales activity.
  • Ensure CRM hygiene and reporting accuracy.

Reporting & Performance

  • Report daily and weekly outreach activity.
  • Track meetings booked and pipeline performance.
  • Monitor key sales metrics and identify improvement opportunities.
  • Take ownership of personal performance and quota attainment.

What Success Looks Like

  • Consistently books qualified meetings.
  • Maintains high outbound activity across multiple channels.
  • Achieves strong meeting attendance rates.
  • Generates a predictable pipeline of sales opportunities.
  • Maintains clean CRM records and accurate reporting.
  • Contributes directly to business growth through outbound sales.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • You genuinely enjoy outbound prospecting.
  • You’re motivated by competition and measurable goals.
  • You thrive on opening conversations with new prospects.
  • You remain persistent and positive after rejection.
  • You take ownership of your performance without constant supervision.
  • You continuously improve your outreach strategy based on results.

Required Experience & Skills

Experience

  • Proven experience as:
    • Sales Development Representative (SDR)
    • Appointment Setter
    • Business Development Representative (BDR)
    • Outbound Sales Representative
  • Demonstrated success achieving or exceeding outbound sales targets.
  • Experience executing multi-channel outbound prospecting through:
    • Cold calling
    • Cold emailing
    • LinkedIn outreach
  • Strong objection-handling and prospecting skills.
  • Proven ability to book qualified meetings with decision-makers.
  • Experience maintaining CRM accuracy and managing pipelines.
  • Excellent written and spoken English communication skills.
  • Strong organizational and time-management abilities.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Ability to provide measurable performance metrics such as:
    • Meetings booked
    • Show-up rates
    • Call volume
    • Conversion rates
    • Quota attainment

Nice to Have

  • Experience selling to U.S.-based clients.
  • Background in:
    • B2B sales
    • Marketing services
    • Agency sales
  • Experience selling into the home services industry.
  • Experience using:
    • Salesforce
    • HubSpot
    • Similar CRM platforms
  • Familiarity with:
    • CloudTalk
    • Aircall
    • Similar dialers
  • Experience using LinkedIn Sales Navigator.
  • Exposure to AI tools, SaaS, or startup environments.

Tech Stack

  • Salesforce
  • HubSpot
  • LinkedIn Sales Navigator
  • CloudTalk
  • Aircall
  • Google Workspace
  • Microsoft Office
  • AI productivity tools (ChatGPT or similar)

What a Typical Day Looks Like

  • Review your pipeline and prioritize follow-ups.
  • Conduct cold calls and outbound prospecting.
  • Send personalized cold emails and LinkedIn messages.
  • Qualify prospects and overcome objections.
  • Schedule meetings for the sales team.
  • Update CRM records and pipeline stages.
  • Review outreach metrics and refine messaging.
  • Collaborate with the closing team to ensure smooth handoffs.

In short: You’ll build pipeline from scratch by prospecting, qualifying decision-makers, booking meetings, and creating consistent outbound opportunities that drive business growth.

Key Metrics for Success (KPIs)

  • Outbound calls completed.
  • Cold emails and LinkedIn outreach activity.
  • Qualified meetings booked.
  • Meeting attendance (show-up) rate.
  • Lead-to-meeting conversion rate.
  • Pipeline growth and opportunity creation.
  • CRM accuracy and activity tracking.
  • Quota attainment.

Why This Role Stands Out

  • High ownership over outbound sales and pipeline generation.
  • Opportunity to shape and grow the outbound sales function.
  • Direct impact on company revenue and growth.
  • Fully remote work environment.
  • Performance-driven culture with significant career advancement opportunities.
  • Career progression into:
    • Senior SDR
    • Business Development Manager
    • Account Executive
    • Sales Manager

Interview Process

  1. Application Review
  2. Spark Hire Intro Video (3–5 minutes)
  3. Client Interview
  4. Offer & Onboarding

What Happens After You Apply

After submitting your application, you’ll receive an email invitation from Spark Hire to record a short 3–5 minute Intro Video. This is the first step in our hiring process and can be completed whenever it’s convenient for you.

Instead of multiple initial screening calls, you’ll have one opportunity to introduce yourself, discuss your outbound sales experience, and explain how you’ve built prospect lists, handled cold calling, managed objection handling, and consistently booked qualified meetings. You’ll also have the opportunity to highlight your outbound performance metrics, CRM experience, and ability to work independently in a target-driven environment. Your video will be reviewed by the hiring team before moving to the client interview.

You can record your video as many times as you’d like before submitting it—only your final version will be reviewed.

Please keep an eye on both your inbox and spam folder for your Spark Hire invitation after applying.

Apply Now

If you’re passionate about outbound sales, enjoy creating opportunities from scratch, and thrive in a performance-driven environment, we’d love to hear from you. Apply today and help drive business growth through high-quality outbound prospecting and lead generation.

  • Prioritize candidates with proven sales performance and relevant experience.

Sales Screening & Interviews

Recruitment Pipeline Ownership

  • Maintain accurate candidate and pipeline information using Google Sheets.

Reporting & Communication

Required Experience & Skills

  • Strong understanding of how to screen and evaluate sales ability.
  • Experience conducting structured candidate interviews.

  • Strong Google Sheets skills.

  • Excellent spoken and written English.
  • Strong communication, organization, follow-up, and time-management skills.
  • Ability to work U.S. Eastern Time hours; Central Time availability preferred.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

You are someone who:

  • Has actually hired salespeople, rather than only general corporate or administrative talent.

  • Is comfortable interviewing candidates about sales performance, targets, objections, and results.

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Network Engineer to design, configure, secure, and maintain enterprise-grade network infrastructure across production environments.

This is a hands-on infrastructure role focused on routing and switching, firewalls, VPNs, network security, monitoring, cloud networking, and performance optimization. You’ll work across enterprise environments using Cisco, Juniper, Palo Alto, Fortinet, and hybrid cloud technologies to ensure secure, reliable, and highly available networks.

If you enjoy solving complex networking challenges, maintaining critical infrastructure, and improving enterprise network performance, this role is for you.

Responsibilities

Enterprise Network Infrastructure

  • Configure, maintain, and optimize enterprise routers, switches, firewalls, and VPNs.
  • Work across networking platforms including Cisco, Juniper, Palo Alto, and Fortinet.
  • Configure and manage:
    • VLANs
    • QoS
    • VPN tunnels
    • ACLs
    • Network segmentation
  • Implement and maintain routing protocols including BGP, OSPF, and EIGRP.
  • Perform firmware upgrades, hardware maintenance, patch management, and infrastructure improvements.
  • Support enterprise network expansions, migrations, and infrastructure upgrades.

Network Monitoring & Troubleshooting

  • Monitor network health using SolarWinds, Nagios, PRTG, Zabbix, or similar monitoring tools.
  • Troubleshoot:
    • Latency
    • Packet loss
    • Routing instability
    • VPN connectivity
    • Failover issues
  • Utilize tools such as Wireshark and TCPdump for packet analysis.
  • Perform root-cause analysis and document remediation plans.
  • Respond to escalated production incidents while meeting SLA requirements.

Network Security & Compliance

  • Configure and maintain enterprise firewall policies and VPN security.
  • Implement:
    • ACLs
    • Network segmentation
    • Intrusion prevention
    • Secure remote access
    • Zero Trust networking principles
  • Support compliance initiatives including:
    • PCI-DSS
    • HIPAA
    • SOX
    • GDPR
  • Work with security tools such as Snort and Suricata where applicable.

Performance Optimization & Reliability

  • Perform bandwidth utilization analysis and capacity planning.
  • Optimize:
    • High availability
    • Redundancy
    • Load balancing
    • Failover performance
  • Maintain network uptime of 99.9% or greater.
  • Proactively identify and resolve infrastructure risks before they impact production.

Documentation & Governance

  • Maintain:
    • Network diagrams
    • Topology maps
    • Configuration documentation
    • Runbooks
  • Use Visio, Lucidchart, or similar tools.
  • Follow structured ITIL change management processes.
  • Ensure documentation remains accurate and audit-ready.

Cloud Networking & Infrastructure Projects

  • Collaborate with infrastructure, cloud, and DevOps teams.
  • Support networking across:
    • AWS VPC
    • Azure VNets
    • Google Cloud Platform
    • Hybrid cloud environments
  • Participate in:
    • Infrastructure migrations
    • Office expansions
    • Data center deployments
    • Network modernization initiatives

What Makes You a Great Fit

  • Strong troubleshooting skills under pressure.
  • Detail-oriented with excellent documentation habits.
  • Proactive approach to preventing outages and improving reliability.
  • Strong communicator who explains technical concepts clearly.
  • Comfortable balancing operational support with infrastructure projects.
  • Passionate about networking, security, and continuous improvement.

Required Experience & Skills

  • 3+ years of professional experience in:
    • Network Engineering
    • Infrastructure Engineering
    • Enterprise Networking
  • Hands-on experience with:
    • Cisco
    • Palo Alto
    • Fortinet
    • Juniper
  • Strong understanding of:
    • TCP/IP
    • VLANs
    • QoS
    • VPNs
    • ACLs
    • BGP
    • OSPF
  • Experience with enterprise monitoring, troubleshooting, and packet analysis tools.
  • Strong documentation, analytical, and communication skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication.

Preferred Experience

  • CCNP, CCIE, or equivalent networking certifications.
  • Palo Alto or Fortinet certifications.
  • Experience with:
    • AWS VPC
    • Azure Networking
    • Hybrid cloud environments
  • Familiarity with:
    • Python
    • Ansible
    • Terraform
    • Network automation
  • Experience supporting highly available, multi-site enterprise environments.

What Success Looks Like

  • Network uptime consistently maintained at 99.9%+.
  • Network incidents resolved within SLA targets.
  • Zero missed critical patches or compliance gaps.
  • Accurate and current infrastructure documentation.
  • Reduced recurring outages and escalations.
  • Strong stakeholder satisfaction with network reliability and support.

Interview Process

Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Real Estate Transaction Coordinator / Real Estate Specialist to manage real estate transactions, listings, documentation, and compliance from accepted offer through closing.

This is a hands-on, detail-intensive role for someone who understands real estate workflows and can keep multiple transactions moving simultaneously without missing critical deadlines.

You’ll work closely with agents, brokers, buyers, sellers, lenders, title companies, inspectors, and other stakeholders to ensure every transaction remains organized, compliant, and on schedule.

If you have hands-on experience with MLS platforms, DocuSign, transaction management systems, and real estate documentation, this role is a strong fit.

What You’ll Own

Transaction Coordination

  • Manage 5–15 active real estate transactions simultaneously
  • Coordinate transactions from accepted offer through closing
  • Build and maintain transaction checklists and timelines
  • Track critical dates, contingencies, and contractual milestones
  • Coordinate with:
    • Escrow and title companies
    • Lenders
    • Inspectors
    • Appraisers
    • Agents and brokers
  • Schedule inspections, appraisals, and other transaction-related activities
  • Proactively follow up on outstanding items to keep deals moving
  • Ensure no contingency or closing deadlines are missed

MLS & Listing Management

  • Create, input, and maintain property listings across MLS platforms
  • Ensure listing information is accurate and complete

    • Zillow
    • Realtor.com
    • Apartments.com

Compliance & Transaction Documentation

  • Review contracts and transaction files for completeness and accuracy
