    • Purchase agreements
    • Disclosures
    • Addenda
    • Amendments
    • Inspection documents
    • Closing documentation
  • Coordinate electronic signatures through DocuSign
  • Ensure required documents are properly completed and signed
  • Maintain compliance with applicable state regulations, brokerage policies, and MLS requirements
  • Keep transaction files organized and audit-ready
  • Identify missing documentation and follow up promptly

Client & Agent Communication

  • Serve as a reliable coordination point throughout the transaction
  • Provide timely updates to buyers, sellers, agents, and other stakeholders
  • Respond professionally to transaction-related questions
  • Coordinate appointments, inspections, appraisals, and closing activities
  • Keep agents informed of upcoming deadlines and outstanding requirements
  • Escalate potential transaction issues before they become closing delays

Listing Marketing Support

  • Create and coordinate property marketing materials
  • Support development of:
    • Property flyers
    • Brochures
    • Social media assets
    • Open house materials
  • Assist with listing distribution across digital platforms
  • Track listing activity and marketing performance
  • Maintain accurate and consistent property information across channels

Reporting & Brokerage Administration

  • Prepare pipeline and transaction status reports
  • Track:
    • Contingency deadlines
    • Closing dates
    • Transaction stages
    • Commissions
  • Maintain organized records for active and completed transactions
  • Support brokers with compliance reviews and audits
  • Assist with back-office real estate operations as needed

Must-Have Experience & Skills

  • 2+ years of experience in:
    • Real estate transaction coordination
    • Brokerage operations
    • Real estate administrative support
    • Similar transaction-focused roles
  • Hands-on experience managing real estate transactions from contract through closing
  • Proficiency with MLS platforms
  • Strong experience with DocuSign
  • Experience with transaction management platforms such as:
    • Dotloop
    • SkySlope
    • Brokermint
    • Similar systems
  • Familiarity with real estate contracts, disclosures, addenda, and transaction documentation
  • Understanding of real estate compliance requirements
  • Strong Google Workspace and/or Microsoft Office skills
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills
  • Ability to manage multiple transactions and competing deadlines simultaneously
  • Comfortable working remotely during U.S. business hours

Nice to Have

  • Licensed real estate agent
  • Certified Transaction Coordinator
  • Experience managing 10+ concurrent transactions
  • Experience supporting both residential and commercial real estate transactions
  • Experience with brokerage compliance audits
  • Commission tracking experience
  • Basic marketing and design skills using Canva, InDesign, or similar tools

Tools & Tech

MLS Platforms | DocuSign | Dotloop | SkySlope | Brokermint | Zillow | Realtor.com | Apartments.com | Google Workspace | Microsoft Office | Canva

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • You’re highly organized and naturally deadline-driven
  • You understand the real estate transaction lifecycle
  • You notice missing signatures, documents, dates, and details before they become problems
  • You can manage multiple active deals without losing track of priorities
  • You communicate confidently with agents, clients, lenders, and vendors

What a Typical Day Looks Like

You may start by reviewing your active transaction pipeline and checking upcoming contingency and closing deadlines.

Throughout the day, you’ll keep transaction files organized, communicate with stakeholders, and make sure every deal continues moving toward closing.

In short: you keep real estate transactions organized, compliant, and on track from contract to close.

Apply now and help ensure every transaction moves smoothly, accurately, and efficiently from accepted offer through closing.

jobs.description:
Growth Marketing Manager – AI, SEO, Content & Organic Growth

Full-Time | Remote | U.S. Business Hours

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Growth Marketing Manager to own and execute growth initiatives across SEO, content marketing, social media, and AI-driven marketing workflows.

This is a hands-on role — not just strategy or campaign coordination. You’ll be expected to create content, drive organic growth, improve search visibility, manage marketing systems, and use AI tools to execute faster and more efficiently.

If you understand how to turn content + SEO + social media + AI into scalable growth, this role is a strong fit.

What You’ll Own

SEO & Organic Growth

  • Develop and execute SEO strategies to increase organic traffic and search visibility
  • Conduct keyword research and build content strategies around search opportunities
  • Manage backlink acquisition and domain authority initiatives
  • Conduct competitor research and SEO audits using:
    • Ahrefs
    • SEMrush
    • Surfer SEO
    • Google Search Console
  • Work with developers and content teams to implement SEO improvements
  • Monitor rankings, traffic, and organic performance

Content & Social Media

  • Plan and execute organic growth across:
    • LinkedIn
    • Instagram
    • Facebook
    • X (Twitter)
  • Create and manage:
    • Blog content
    • Social media content
    • PR content
    • Marketing assets
  • Repurpose long-form content into multiple formats and channels
  • Schedule and publish content using Buffer or Hootsuite
  • Analyze engagement and continuously improve content performance

AI-Driven Marketing

  • Use tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Jasper, and Copy.ai to accelerate:
    • Content ideation
    • Research
    • Copywriting
    • Content repurposing
    • Marketing analysis
  • Build AI into recurring marketing workflows
  • Identify repetitive processes that can be automated
  • Test emerging AI tools and workflows to improve marketing speed and output

Website & Content Infrastructure

  • Oversee marketing-related website projects using ASTRO, headless WordPress, or similar platforms
  • Coordinate with developers on:
    • Landing pages
    • Website updates
    • Content publishing
    • SEO improvements
  • Ensure website infrastructure supports marketing and organic growth initiatives
  • Maintain accurate, optimized, and up-to-date website content

Marketing Operations & Reporting

  • Track marketing performance using:
    • Google Analytics
    • Google Search Console
    • HubSpot
  • Build and maintain marketing reports and performance tracking
  • Support email marketing, Google Ads, and broader revenue initiatives
  • Ensure campaigns are properly tracked and measured
  • Coordinate projects across marketing, design, and development teams using Slack and Asana
  • Turn performance data into clear optimization opportunities

Required Experience & Skills

  • Proven experience in Growth Marketing, Digital Marketing, Content Marketing, or a similar role
  • Strong experience with organic social media growth
  • Hands-on content creation and content management experience
  • Understanding of SEO, keyword strategy, and organic acquisition
  • Experience coordinating across marketing, design, and development teams
  • Proven ability to integrate AI tools into marketing workflows
  • Familiarity with tools such as:
    • ChatGPT / Claude / Jasper
    • Buffer / Hootsuite
    • Canva
    • HubSpot
    • Google Analytics
    • Google Ads
  • Strong organizational and project execution skills
  • Strong written and verbal English communication
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment

Nice to Have

  • Hands-on experience with Ahrefs, SEMrush, or Surfer SEO
  • Google Search Console experience
  • Backlink strategy and link-building experience
  • Experience with ASTRO, WordPress, or headless CMS platforms
  • Experience with marketing automation
  • Background in organic acquisition or growth marketing
  • Experience building scalable AI-assisted content workflows

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • You’re a hands-on marketer who can both plan and execute
  • You understand how SEO, content, and social work together to drive growth
  • You actively use AI to improve productivity rather than treating it as an add-on
  • You’re comfortable working with data and optimizing based on performance
  • You can coordinate effectively with designers and developers
  • You’re organized, proactive, and comfortable owning multiple initiatives
  • You enjoy building scalable marketing systems and workflows

What a Typical Day Looks Like

You may start by reviewing SEO and social performance, identifying content opportunities, and researching keywords or competitors.

From there, you could create and repurpose content using AI, coordinate graphics with a designer, publish social posts, review website updates with developers, and optimize existing content based on performance data.

You’ll also monitor reporting, improve marketing workflows, and experiment with new AI tools or automations.

In short: you build and execute an AI-powered organic growth engine across SEO, content, social media, and marketing operations.

Key Metrics for Success

  • Organic traffic and search ranking growth
  • Social media reach and engagement
  • Content production consistency and quality
  • Growth in website visibility and inbound traffic
  • SEO and backlink performance
  • Marketing workflow efficiency
  • Successful adoption of AI-driven processes
  • Accurate and actionable marketing reporting

Why This Role Stands Out

  • Ownership across SEO, content, social media, and AI-driven marketing
  • Hands-on exposure to modern AI marketing tools
  • Opportunity to build scalable marketing systems
  • Direct impact on organic growth and brand visibility
  • Cross-functional work with marketing, design, and development
  • Fully remote environment with strong ownership and autonomy
  • Growth opportunities into Senior Growth Marketing, Head of Growth, or Marketing Leadership

Interview Process

  1. Initial Application Review
  2. Spark Hire Intro Video
  3. Pavago Recruiter Interview
  4. Practical Marketing / SEO Exercise
  5. Client Interview
  6. Offer & Onboarding

Apply Now

If you have experience across growth marketing, SEO, content, social media, and AI-driven marketing workflows and enjoy turning ideas into measurable growth, we’d love to hear from you.

jobs.description:
This is a remote position.

DoD SkillBridge Internship: Defense Strategy and Growth Internship
SkillBridge Host Company: Anno.Ai
SkillBridge Provider: Vets2PM LLC
Location: Remote (per DoW SkillBridge guidelines)

Applicants must be active-duty U.S. Military Members who qualify for the DoD SkillBridge Program.

To Apply:Go toand complete the SkillBridge interest form.Return to this posting and click ‘Apply’.

What We Do at Anno.Ai

Anno.Ai is a mission-focused defense technology startup dedicated to accelerating the safe and effective development of next-generation autonomous systems. We specialize in building and operating advanced test ranges for low Technology Readiness Level (TRL) single- or dual- use autonomous platforms, providing a critical bridge between early-stage innovation and real-world mission requirements.

Our ranges are designed to replicate complex, contested, and dynamic environments—giving innovators, researchers, and defense partners the ability to validate, stress-test, and mature their systems with speed and rigor. By combining deep technical expertise with a strong national security ethos, Anno.Ai ensures that emerging autonomous technologies are tested not only for performance but for resilience, adaptability, and operational relevance.

Anno.Ai is a growing company with a team drawn from diverse professional backgrounds, bringing together expertise in defense, technology, engineering, and operations. We intentionally build our teams on the foundation of trust.

At Anno.Ai, we believe that mission success depends on empowering innovation at the edge. We exist to help our partners move faster, fail smarter, and ultimately deliver autonomous capabilities that safeguard both national security and the future of global stability.

Position Overview

As a Defense Strategy and Growth intern, you will support business development, contracting, and acquisition planning initiatives in the defense and national security market. This role offers hands-on exposure to how organizations identify opportunities, understand government requirements, develop capture strategies, and navigate the federal acquisition process. You will assist with market and customer research, opportunity analysis, acquisition timelines, contract-vehicle assessments, proposal development, and strategic briefings. Working alongside business development and contracting professionals, you will help transform complex information into clear, actionable recommendations. We value good management, your career growth, and ethical, responsible practices.

For this opportunity we are looking for individuals who have experience in federal acquisitions. The ability to think on your feet and good communication skills are essential. We are looking for someone who has a learning mindset and loves to think outside the box.

The ideal candidate for this role would reside in Minneapolis MN. However, this position is remote and any other location within the Continental United States (CONUS) is acceptable as well.

Candidates need to be able to obtain and maintain U.S. Government security clearance (U.S. citizenship required).Candidates must be able to travel up to 20% of the time.

What You Will Do
  • Be introduced to program management tasks of early-stage defense technology efforts, including schedule, cost, and risk tracking
  • Learn federal contracting and acquisition processes within the DoD ecosystem
  • Gain exposure to Business development and capture activities in the defense technology sector
  • Translate military acquisitions experience into a commercial technology environment

Required Qualifications

  • Military, government, academic, or professional experience supporting complex planning, analysis, coordination, or program activities.
  • Foundational familiarity with Department of Defense missions, organizations, requirements, acquisition, contracting, or program-management processes.
  • Demonstrated ability to research complex topics, evaluate information from multiple sources, and translate findings into clear, actionable recommendations.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including experience developing briefings, reports, plans, or decision-support materials.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage competing priorities and meet deadlines.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a remote, fast-moving, mission-focused team.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint, with the willingness to learn additional business-development and research tools.
  • Sound judgment and discretion when handling sensitive, proprietary, or mission-related information.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. Government security clearance, including meeting applicable citizenship requirements.
  • Ability to travel up to 20% of the time.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting DoD acquisition, contracting, requirements development, resource management, program management, or operational planning.
  • Experience developing, reviewing, or contributing to Performance Work Statements (PWS), Statements of Work (SOW), Statements of Objectives (SOO), or related acquisition and requirements documentation.
  • Strong technical writing skills, with the ability to translate complex operational, technical, and acquisition information into clear, concise, and well-structured documentation.
  • Familiarity with the federal acquisition lifecycle, FAR/DFARS, contract vehicles, Other Transaction Authorities, or SBIR/STTR programs.
  • Experience with defense business development, capture management, proposal development, customer engagement, or opportunity assessment.
  • Experience conducting market, customer, competitor, or opportunity research and presenting findings to decision-makers.
  • Experience translating operational needs into requirements, acquisition approaches, or strategic recommendations.
  • Experience tracking program schedules, costs, risks, milestones, or stakeholder actions.
  • Familiarity with autonomous systems, unmanned platforms, artificial intelligence, data analytics, or other emerging defense technologies.
  • Education, military training, certification, or coursework in acquisition, contracting, business, public policy, national security, engineering, data science, or a related field.
  • Experience working effectively in a startup, small-team, or rapidly changing environment.
  • An active or recently held U.S. Government security clearance

Head of Client Operations (Cold Email & Client Delivery) – Remote

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: Flexible (Aligned with U.S. Client Time Zones)

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Head of Client Operations to take full ownership of client delivery, campaign performance, client retention, and operational execution for a fast-growing outbound lead generation business.

This is not a traditional account management or project coordination role. You will be responsible for ensuring clients achieve measurable outcomes by improving campaign performance, optimizing operational systems, and maintaining exceptional delivery standards.

Working directly with the founder, you’ll thrive in a fast-paced startup where priorities evolve quickly, ownership is expected, and execution matters more than theory. You’ll combine strategic thinking with hands-on execution—solving problems, improving systems, and building long-term client relationships.

If you’re experienced in cold email operations, outbound lead generation, and client success, and enjoy building scalable operational processes, this role is for you.

Responsibilities

Client Ownership & Retention

  • Manage a portfolio of 20–30 client accounts.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for client delivery, campaign performance, and strategic discussions.
  • Lead client meetings, quarterly reviews, escalation management, and account planning.
  • Build trusted relationships while proactively managing client expectations.
  • Identify account risks early and implement retention strategies before issues escalate.
  • Own client satisfaction, retention, and long-term account success.

Campaign Performance & Delivery

  • Monitor and optimize cold email campaign performance.
  • Diagnose and resolve deliverability issues, inbox placement challenges, low reply rates, messaging performance, and list quality concerns.
  • Conduct quality assurance reviews before campaign launches.
  • Continuously improve deliverability, engagement, reply rates, and conversion performance.
  • Ensure clients consistently receive measurable business outcomes.

Hands-On Cold Email Execution

  • Refine outbound messaging, campaign strategy, and email sequences.
  • Optimize subject lines, value propositions, calls-to-action, and email copy.
  • Improve outbound infrastructure and inbox placement.
  • Work directly within platforms including:
    • Apollo.io
    • Smartlead.ai
    • Instantly.ai
  • Troubleshoot campaigns and implement recovery and optimization strategies.

Systems, SOPs & Operational Scaling

  • Design and improve scalable operational systems and delivery workflows.
  • Develop SOPs, playbooks, and standardized processes.
  • Track and improve SLAs, client health metrics, delivery quality, and operational efficiency.
  • Continuously refine workflows to support company growth.
  • Drive practical process improvements through ongoing iteration.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Collaborate with outreach teams, developers, infrastructure teams, and leadership.
  • Coordinate the resolution of technical issues, automation challenges, and infrastructure concerns.
  • Maintain visibility into campaign performance, operational risks, and delivery bottlenecks.
  • Ensure smooth communication and accountability across teams.

What Makes You a Great Fit

  • You thrive in fast-paced startup environments.
  • You take ownership without requiring constant direction.
  • You enjoy solving complex operational problems.
  • You balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution.
  • You communicate confidently with clients, founders, and cross-functional teams.
  • You focus on measurable results and continuous improvement.

Required Experience & Skills

Experience

  • Proven experience leading client delivery, client operations, account management, or operational execution.
  • Background in cold email agencies, outbound lead generation, growth marketing, or similar high-volume outbound environments.
  • Experience working in startup or rapidly scaling businesses.

Technical & Operational Skills

  • Strong understanding of:
    • Cold email strategy
    • Deliverability
    • Inbox placement
    • Email infrastructure
    • Outbound copywriting
  • Ability to diagnose and resolve campaign performance issues independently.
  • Experience with APIs, workflow automation, and operational systems.
  • Hands-on experience using AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, and automation platforms.

Communication & Leadership

  • Excellent client-facing communication and relationship management skills.
  • Comfortable handling difficult conversations and managing expectations.
  • Strong decision-making and operational judgment.
  • Able to work independently in a fully remote environment.

Preferred Experience

  • Experience scaling client delivery or account management teams.
  • Experience working directly with founders or executive leadership.
  • Familiarity with:
    • DNS configuration
    • Domain management
    • Email warming
    • Outbound infrastructure
  • Exposure to RevOps, automation systems, and outbound analytics.
  • Experience in growth-stage startup environments.

Tools & Platforms

Candidates should have experience with:

  • Apollo.io
  • Smartlead.ai
  • Instantly.ai
  • CRM platforms
  • ChatGPT and AI tools
  • Slack
  • Google Workspace
  • Automation and API platforms

What Success Looks Like

  • High client retention and reduced churn.
  • Strong campaign deliverability and reply rates.
  • Excellent client satisfaction and account health.
  • Consistent SLA adherence and delivery quality.
  • Fast, effective resolution of campaign and operational issues.
  • Increased revenue retention through successful client outcomes.

Interview Process

  • Initial Screening
  • Founder Interview
  • Final Discussion
  • Offer & Onboarding

What Happens After You Apply

Right after you apply, you’ll receive an email invitation from Spark Hire to record your Intro Video. This short, self-recorded video is the final step that completes your application.

Instead of repeating yourself across multiple screening calls, you’ll introduce yourself once, and your video will be shared with the hiring team. This allows the founder and hiring team to evaluate your communication style early, making future interviews more meaningful while reducing unnecessary interview rounds.

Don’t overthink it—you can record your video as many times as you’d like before submitting it. Only your final submission will be reviewed. Please keep an eye on both your inbox and spam folder for your Spark Hire invitation.

Apply Now

If you’re an operations leader who can own client outcomes end-to-end, optimize cold email campaigns, improve operational systems, and thrive in a fast-moving startup environment, we’d love to hear from you. Apply today and help build a scalable client delivery operation that drives measurable business results.

jobs.excerpt: DLB Associates is a premier engineering and consulting firm specializing in innovative, mission-critical solutions across hyperscale data centers, advanced infrastructure, and high-performance building systems.
jobs.description:
DLB Associates is a premier engineering and consulting firm specializing in innovative, mission-critical solutions across hyperscale data centers, advanced infrastructure, and high-performance building systems. With over four decades of expertise, we partner with some of the world’s most influential companies to design and optimize environments that demand precision, scalability, and resilience.

Join us and be part of a team where your voice matters, your work makes an impact, and your growth is a shared priority.

Position Title: Senior Power Engineer – Energy Storage

Position Location:Remote - workvirtually fromanywhere in the United States

Salary

DLB recognizes salary ranges from jobboardsdo not necessarily reflect our pay ranges. In many instances we out-compete those ranges for well-qualified candidates.

Job Summary

DLB is expanding its energy storage engineering services and is seeking a Senior Power Engineer – Energy Storage to support and help grow this practice. This roleis responsible forthe engineering delivery of Battery Energy Storage System (BESS), microgrid, and other inverter-based resource (IBR) interconnections across utility, renewable, data center, and industrial markets, from concept through construction, commissioning, and energization.

The Senior Power Engineer – Energy Storage will provide technical input, support engineering decisions, and represent the firm with clients, utilities, and partners. This position is hands-on, blending detailed engineering execution with quality-focused delivery and support of business growth.

The Senior Power Engineer – Energy Storage works with a high degree of independence on day-to-day work and receives general direction on new projects, tasks, or assignments. Will execute projects, tasks, or assignments of complex scope. May coordinate activities of other personnel.

The Senior Power Engineer – Energy Storage will communicate andoperatein line with organizational goals and values, as well as departmentalobjectives.

Essential Functions

Energy Storage Engineering (40%)

  • Serve as an engineering contributor for Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) projects, performing advanced engineering work with general oversight. Perform detailed design, analysis, and engineering of BESS, microgrid, and other inverter-based resource (IBR) systems, ensuring compliance with customer requirements, utility requirements, industry standards,codesand regulations
  • Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to integrate BESS and IBR designs seamlessly into larger electrical systems, including substation, generation, and grid interconnection infrastructure
  • Support technical scoping, design, and utility/developer coordination for Battery Energy Storage System (BESS), microgrid, and other inverter-based resource (IBR) interconnections at the medium- and high-voltage level, including protection philosophy, interconnection studies, and compliance with IEEE 1547 / IEEE 2800
  • Contribute to engineering approaches, design standards, and technical risk management.
  • Support project delivery as engineer of record (or in support of the EOR), contributing to technical accuracy, constructability, and code compliance.
  • Apply and helpmaintainengineering standards, design criteria, and quality expectations for energy storage work.

Energy Storage Design Activities (25%)

  • BESS one-line, three-line, and AC/DC schematics
  • Physical layouts, equipment arrangements, and site plans for containerized/modular BESS installations
  • DC architecture including battery racks, inverters/power conversion systems (PCS), and medium-voltage collection systems
  • Grounding systems and electrical safety designs
  • Protection & control philosophies, relay schemes, and coordination
  • BESS/microgrid interconnection one-lines, protection & control schemes, and anti-islanding / transfer trip logic
  • Fire detection/suppression and thermal management coordination with mechanical disciplines
  • Develop and review equipment specifications for major BESS components including battery modules, power conversion systems (PCS), transformers, switchgear, protection relays, and communications/SCADA systems.
  • Perform complex engineering studies with general guidance
  • Perform and/or direct short-circuit, arc flash (IEEE 1584), harmonic (IEEE 519), power flow, and EMT/transient (e.g.,PSCADor equivalent) studies, including fault, harmonic, and dynamic contribution from BESS and other inverter-based resources
  • Support interconnection application processes and LGIA/SGIA coordination with utilities, developers, and BESS vendors
  • Ensure compliance with applicable standards and utility requirements whileidentifyingand helping resolve technical conflicts and ambiguities.
  • Utilize AutoCAD and Revit software to prepare drawings and visual aids
  • Supporttimelyand effective coordination of the project design team, including resource forecasting
  • Identifypotential project scope changes and aid in development of strategies to minimize impact and control deviations from estimated costs and project deadlines

Project Execution / Pre-Construction / Client Interface (25%)

  • Support execution of the firm’s client value system and helpassurethat the project is executedin accordance withcompany policies and standards
  • Work closely with clients to understand their specific project requirements,providetechnical insights, and ensure client satisfaction throughout the project lifecycle
  • Support resolution of design, construction, and field issues,escalating toleadership when business or contractual risk requires involvement.
  • Support construction, testing, commissioning, and energization through RFIs, field engineering, and technical troubleshooting.
  • Participate in technical reviews, design meetings, and client presentations.
  • Prepare project design and construction documents

Reporting (10%)

  • Prepare project progress reports for internal and external stakeholders
  • Update andmaintainshop drawing and RFI log
  • Manage personal hours using company tools

Technology, Digital Tools & AI-Enabled Efficiency

  • Identifyopportunities and lead the strategic use of technology, digital platforms, and AI-enabled tools to enhance efficiency through workflow automation, reduced manual effort, and improved accuracy in forecasting, documentation, reporting, and quality processes.
  • Support adoption of emerging technologies - including advanced analytics, data visualization tools, and digital construction management platforms - to strengthen readiness, quality assurance, and project controls.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to ensure technology solutions align with DLB standards for data security, privacy, and operational integrity.
  • Support a culture that embraces innovation, continuous improvement, and the strategic use of technology tooptimizeperformance and scalability.

Completion of Assigned Tasks and Deliverables on Time and on Budget

Performs Other Related Duties as Assigned

Position Requirements (Intermediate to Advanced level for all the following)

  • Knowledge of medium- and high-voltage electrical systems including BESS, microgrid, and IBR configurations, protection & control philosophies, and utility-scale grounding and electrical safety design
  • Knowledge of various electrical topologies and distribution systems
  • Strong working knowledge of applicable electrical codes and standards, specifically NESC, NEC, NFPA (including NFPA 855 for battery energy storage systems), ANSI, and utility interconnection standards, along with IEEE 1547 and IEEE 2800 (interconnection of inverter-based resources), IEEE 1584 (arc flash), IEEE 519 (harmonics), and IEEE 80 (substation grounding grid design), with ability to apply requirements through code analysis and system design.
  • Knowledge of power systems engineering / design software including short-circuit, arc flash, harmonic, and power flow analysis tools (e.g., ETAP, SKM, or ASPEN), equipment sizing, and EMT/transient simulation (e.g., PSCAD or equivalent)
  • Strong working knowledge of Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS), microgrids, and inverter-based resource (IBR) interconnection requirements, including protection coordination, anti-islanding/transfer trip schemes, and utility interconnection processes (LGIA/SGIA)
  • Hands-on experience with protective relay platforms (e.g., SEL or equivalent), including settings development, coordination, and field commissioning support
  • Skilled at using MS Office Suite (Excel, Word, Outlook, PowerPoint, Teams), along with exceptional organizational skills for file management
  • Highly organized with strong attention to detail, able to manage multiple tasks simultaneously and meet tight deadlines under pressure.
  • Ability toleverageAI and emerging technologies to streamline workflows,optimizeoperational processes, and contribute to company-wide innovation.
  • Ability to work successfully in a remote environment through effective communication and organizational skills, self-motivation, proactiveness and resourcefulness in a distraction free workspace
  • Ability to follow company and site safety requirements
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate technical concepts to non-technical audiences and serve as a client-facing point of contact.

Physical Demands

The following physical demands must be met by the employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is

  • Frequently required to remain in a stationary position
  • Frequently moving through office,facilityand other environments
  • On occasion the employee may move equipment weighing up to 25 pounds

Travel / Relocation Requirements

  • Up to 20%, this may include travel to any or all 50 US states
  • Travel is defined as physically leaving home on behalf of business activities including but not limited to client sites, meetings with other employees, meetings for business development purposes, running errands on behalf of the business, attending industry conferences, etc.

Education / Experience

  • Bachelor of Science in Electrical Engineering.
  • Professional Engineer (PE) license in Electrical Engineering.
  • 10+ years of progressive energy storage or power systems engineering experience, withdemonstrateddepth in protection & control (P&C) design.
  • Experience supporting engineering delivery on medium- to high-voltage BESS, microgrid, or IBR interconnection projects, including in an engineer-of-record support capacity.
  • Hands-on protective relay experience (SEL or equivalent platform), including settings development and coordination.
  • Direct experience navigating LGIA/SGIA processes and utility interconnection requirements.
  • Experience supporting multidisciplinary BESS or power systems design and working with utilities and/or owner engineering teams on utility, renewable, data center, or industrial projects.

Preferred / Strong Plus

  • Direct, hands-on experience on at least one BESS, microgrid, or inverter-based resource (IBR) interconnection project, from interconnection application/study through protection design and commissioning.
  • Working knowledge of IEEE 2800 and/or IEEE 1547 interconnection standards for inverter-based resources.
  • Electromagnetic transient (EMT) simulation experience using PSCAD or equivalent tool.
  • Familiarity with NFPA 855 or battery energy storage fire protection and life safety design.

Benefits

DLB Associates offers a very competitive benefits package; highlights include

  • Choice of comprehensive medical plans (including two PPO-style plans and a HDHP w/ HSA option)
  • Flex spending accounts (FSA)
  • Dental and vision plans
  • Comprehensive medical, dental and vision benefits extended to spouse / domestic partner and dependent children up to age 26
  • 401k with company match and self-directed brokerage account option
  • PTO including additional paid time off during the last week of the year
  • Company paid life insurance coverage for employees and their eligible dependents
  • Short and long-term disability, AD&D coverage
  • Professional development opportunities, tuition reimbursement and professional licensing assistance
  • Paid parental leave after one year of employment

CO, CA, IL, NY, WA, and Washington DC residents only: In accordance with CO, CA, IL, NY, WA, and Washington DC law, the range provided is DLB's reasonable estimate of the base compensation for this role. The actual amount may differ based on non-discriminatory factors such as experience, knowledge, skills, abilities, and location.

DLB Associates is an EEO/Affirmative Action Employer and participates in the E-Verify program with the Department of Homeland Security. We encourage diversity in our workforce.

Are you ready to challenge yourself and redefine standards in the AEC industry? Apply now and join our award-winning team!​

jobs.title: Senior Technical Product Manager
jobs.excerpt: PAXAFE is a logistics orchestration & decision intelligence SaaS platform that helps Cold Chain planning, logistics and quality teams consolidate their transportation data agnostically, digitize and automate product quality and lane qualification decisions, and operationalize prescriptive recommendations in the transportation network.
jobs.description:
PAXAFE is a logistics orchestration & decision intelligence SaaS platform that helps Cold Chain planning, logistics and quality teams consolidate their transportation data agnostically, digitize and automate product quality and lane qualification decisions, and operationalize prescriptive recommendations in the transportation network.

​

Acting as the cold chain trust layer whose mission is to drive towards zero transportation waste, PAXAFE works with cold chain manufactures and service providers to reduce product loss, improve operational efficiencies and make more informed decisions in real-time.

PAXAFE's vision is to become the backend intelligence infrastructure that powers every temperature, time and value-sensitive shipment in the world.

PAXAFE is backed by great VCs (Framework Venture Partners, Ubiquity Ventures, Venture53, RoseCliff Ventures, etc.) and CVCs (Microsoft M12, Northwestern Mutual, Greenlight Re)

The Role

As a Senior Technical Product Manager at PAXAFE, you will own and drive the development of PAXAFE's core product modules and AI-powered intelligence capabilities. You'll be responsible for evolving our 4 flagship modules — Lane Qualification, Data-Agnostic Visibility Command Center, Temperature Release, and Insights (Performance & Risk Monitoring) — while pioneering the integration of LLM and agentic workflows that transform how pharmaceutical supply chain teams interact with and act on supply chain intelligence.

Your primary customers will be pharmaceutical logistics teams, quality assurance managers, supply chain operations leaders, and cold chain specialists who rely on PAXAFE’s CONTXT platform to make critical decisions about temperature-sensitive shipments. You'll also work closely with PAXAFE's internal teams (Solutions Engineers, Data Scientists, ML Engineers, Customer Success) to ensure our AI capabilities deliver measurable value and seamless user experiences.

This is a strategic, high-ownership position that requires vision, leadership, and technical fluency. You will define product roadmaps, drive execution, and collaborate with design, engineering, and data science teams to deliver AI-native features that automate decisions, surface insights proactively, and enable natural language interaction with complex supply chain data. You'll be at the forefront of applying cutting-edge LLM and agentic AI technologies to solve real-world pharmaceutical logistics challenges.

Key Responsibilities

Product Module Ownership & Development

jobs.description:
About Accelerant

Accelerant is a data-driven risk exchange connecting underwriters of specialty insurance risk with risk capital providers. Accelerant was founded in 2018 by a group of longtime insurance industry executives and technology experts who shared a vision of rebuilding the way risk is exchanged – so that it works better, for everyone. The Accelerant risk exchange does business across more than 20 different countries and 250 specialty products, and we are proud that our insurers have been awarded an AM Best A- (Excellent) rating. For more information, please visit .

The Role

We're building the financial data platform at Accelerant — the premium, claims, and paid data products that underpin financial processing, reserving analysis, and the monthly close — and it needs to stay fast, resilient, and observable as we scale. You'll drive the reliability and observability strategy across the platform and the enterprise systems it depends on: Velocity, MuleSoft, D365, Snowflake, Fabric, and the streaming and integration layers that move data through it. You are a key decider about what gets measured, how we define reliability, and where engineering needs to invest to keep production healthy.

We need someone who can prove a repeatable, define-to-alert observability pipeline, harden it, and scale it into systems that have never had real SLOs — and build modern, AI-assisted operational tooling that lets a small team punch far above its weight.

This Is a High-Autonomy, High-Impact Role for Someone Who:

  • Sees a recurring alert or a fragile deploy path and cannot leave it alone. Excels at shipping the right fix and the right automation, not the perfect one.
  • Has run real production systems at scale — not just written runbooks for them.
  • Has built with Datadog, OpenTelemetry, incident tooling, and AI coding assistants long enough to have strong opinions about what fits our needs.
  • Can prototype an operational agent in Cursor and iterate as they go.
  • Operates with autonomy, and can carry a technical discussion on system architecture, failure modes, and tradeoffs.
  • Is genuinely curious about applying emerging AI to reliability and operations.

What You'll Do

Drive the reliability and observability initiative

  • Own the reliability roadmap end to end. Prove a repeatable define → emit → ingest → dashboard → alert metric pipeline, set SLOs and error budgets, prioritize the work, and drive execution. You'll partner with engineering on what we monitor, how, and when — indexing on user impact over low-level infrastructure.

Harden the foundational platform

  • Take the financial data platform from functional to enterprise-grade, with a focus on availability, performance, and recoverability. Strengthen deployment paths, straight-through processing, and failover so the monthly close runs faster and cleaner as legacy hops are retired.

Expand observability breadth and depth

  • Extend instrumentation across the six target systems — Velocity, Red Panda, MuleSoft, Snowflake, Fabric, and AWS (with D365 ledger to follow) — proving both push (OpenTelemetry) and pull (agent) ingestion. Cover service health (latency, error rates, throughput) and business KPIs (match rate, reconciliation completeness, settlement correctness and latency).

Implement a scalable incident and review process

  • Build the on-call, alerting, and blameless postmortem process that keeps reliability high as systems and the team grow. Route alerts Datadog → Incident.io with ServiceNow as the system of record, and set severity standards, escalation norms, and follow-up tracking that actually closes the loop.

Scale automation, auditability, and reduce toil

  • Build the tooling that automates routine operations, self-heals common failures, and surfaces signal over noise. Establish data lineage and retention, and validate reliability at scale — 5,000+ transactions before go-live — through auto-remediation, capacity planning, and actionable dashboards.

Build specialized SRE agents using Cursor AI

  • Design and ship AI agents for incident triage, log analysis, and root-cause investigation (to name a few). Use Cursor as your build environment. Treat the agents as products solving specific problems.

Host SRE agents on the AI fabric

  • Partner with the AI platform team to deploy your agents on the org's AI fabric. Make them discoverable, governed, and reusable across functions.

What You'll Bring

Must-Haves

  • Proven experience designing, operating, and scaling reliable production systems.
  • Deep hands-on expertise with modern observability tooling — Datadog, Prometheus/Grafana, and OpenTelemetry — including both push and pull ingestion patterns.
  • Strong background defining SLIs, SLOs, and error budgets — and translating them into business-level KPIs, not just infrastructure metrics.
  • Experience operating data platforms (Snowflake, Fabric) and enterprise integration layers (MuleSoft) alongside enterprise SaaS such as D365 (F&O and/or Power Apps).
  • Hands-on incident management experience with tools like Incident.io and ServiceNow, and a track record of running effective on-call and postmortem practices.
  • Hands-on experience building with LLMs and AI coding assistants — Cursor in particular. Bonus if you've built and deployed agents.
  • Ability to define reliability strategy, reliability targets, and operational metrics — and defend them to engineering leadership and the business.
  • Strong communication skills — you can explain a root cause to a junior engineer and a reliability risk to a product lead.
  • Demonstrated bias for action and ability to operate autonomously in ambiguous, fast-changing environments.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience in insurance, fintech, or other regulated financial services industries.
  • Familiarity with insurance and finance concepts (premium, claims, settlement, reserving, monthly close) or willingness to learn them deeply.
  • Experience with streaming and event pipelines (Red Panda / Kafka) and data lineage, retention, and auditability requirements.
  • Strong working knowledge of chaos engineering, performance and load testing, and capacity planning.
  • Experience deploying AI agents on an internal AI platform or fabric (governance, eval harnesses, prompt/version management).

jobs.excerpt: Company Overview Trovata is the #1 digital platform to manage cash and liquidity.
jobs.description:
Company Overview

Trovata is the #1 digital platform to manage cash and liquidity. Built on Trovata’s industry-leading AWS cloud infrastructure and best-in-breed AI models, and a foundation of data connectivity and AI-ready infrastructure, Trovata gives treasury and finance teams real-time visibility, automated workflows, and the intelligence to lead. Our platform includes Trovata Cash, Trovata TMS, Trovata Data, and the MultiBank Connector — all designed to replace legacy systems with something built for how money moves today. We are backed by top-tier investors and integrated with the world's leading banks. The teams who choose Trovata don't just upgrade their tooling — they reposition treasury as a strategic function.

The company was founded by a longtime Controller-CFO with a vision for a better way and engineered by an experienced team from Capital One. We’re fortunate to be financially backed by a syndicate of banks, including J.P. Morgan, Wells Fargo, and Capital One.

About the role

As a Solutions Engineer focused on Trovata TMS, you are the technical and functional center of gravity in our enterprise sales process. You translate complex treasury requirements into clear, compelling demonstrations of what Trovata's next-generation treasury operating system can do — and you do it with confidence, precision, and depth.

You will work directly with enterprise prospects, strategic partners, and existing customers — running discovery, building custom demos, leading technical workshops, and owning RFP responses. You sit at the intersection of sales, product, and implementation, and your work directly shapes how Trovata wins in the market.

What you'll do

Pre-sales & demos

  • Speak knowledgeably to Trovata’s underlying technical architecture — including our AWS-native cloud infrastructure and use of best-in-breed AI models — when engaging technical evaluators, IT, and security stakeholders during the sales cycle.
  • Lead discovery conversations to understand treasury workflows, pain points, bank connectivity requirements, and system architecture.
  • Build and deliver tailored product demonstrations of Trovata TMS — covering cash positioning, forecasting, payments, bank connectivity, and reporting.
  • Configure demo environments to reflect prospect-specific scenarios, including multi-entity structures, multi-currency requirements, and ERP integrations.
  • Present to audiences ranging from treasury analysts to CFOs and boards — adapting depth and framing to each.

Workshops & technical engagements

  • Design and facilitate pre-sales workshops to map customer processes to Trovata TMS capabilities.
  • Lead proof-of-concept (POC) engagements, defining success criteria, managing execution, and presenting outcomes.
  • Partner with implementation and customer success teams to ensure a seamless handoff from sales to onboarding.

RFPs & competitive positioning

  • Own RFP and RFI responses for Trovata TMS, coordinating inputs across product, legal, and security to produce accurate, compelling submissions on deadline.
  • Serve as the go-to voice on infrastructure, security, and AI-related RFP and security-questionnaire content — accurately representing Trovata’s AWS cloud architecture, data security posture, and use of best-in-breed AI models, in partnership with engineering and security teams.
  • Maintain and continuously improve a library of RFP content, standard responses, and security questionnaire answers.
  • Develop deep competitive fluency — articulating Trovata's differentiation versus legacy TMS vendors and emerging platforms clearly and credibly.

Cross-functional impact

  • Feed structured product feedback from the field into the product team — translating prospect requirements into actionable input.
  • Contribute to go-to-market materials including demo scripts, solution briefs, and battle cards.
  • Mentor and support Account Executives on technical qualification, solution framing, and deal strategy.

Qualifications

  • Working knowledge of modern cloud infrastructure and AI/ML systems — particularly AWS-native architectures and best-in-breed foundation models — sufficient to speak credibly with technical evaluators and security teams about how Trovata’s infrastructure and AI capabilities compare to legacy, on-premise TMS platforms.
  • Ability to articulate Trovata’s security, scalability, and AI-driven automation posture — including our AWS cloud architecture and industry-leading use of best-in-breed AI models — to IT, security, and infrastructure stakeholders during technical evaluations.
  • 5+ years in solutions engineering, pre-sales, or treasury/fintech consulting — with direct exposure to treasury management systems or cash management platforms.
  • Hands-on familiarity with TMS platforms (e.g., Kyriba, FIS Integrity, ION, GTreasury, or similar) — enough to speak credibly about configuration, workflows, and limitations.
  • Deep understanding of treasury operations: cash positioning, liquidity forecasting, bank connectivity (SWIFT, BAI2, MT940), payments, and financial reporting.
  • Demonstrated ability to run enterprise discovery, build tailored demos, and present complex solutions to senior financial stakeholders.
  • Strong RFP writing and project management skills — comfortable owning multi-workstream submissions under tight timelines.
  • Clear, confident communication — written and verbal — with the ability to simplify technical depth without losing precision.

Nice to have

  • Experience with ERP integrations (SAP, Oracle, NetSuite) in a treasury or finance context.
  • Familiarity with API-based bank connectivity and financial data normalization.
  • Background in fintech, banking technology, or enterprise SaaS sales engineering.
  • CTP (Certified Treasury Professional) designation or equivalent treasury finance credential.
  • Hands-on experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS preferred) or enterprise AI/ML platforms, including exposure to leading foundation models and responsible AI governance practices.

Benefits

  • Compensations - Base salary of $129,000–$187,500, plus a 20% OTC (target on-target earnings of approximately $155,000–$225,000). Final compensation within this range may be determined by factors including relevant experience, qualifications and location.
  • Equity - All Trovata employees receive an equity grant as part of their offer. We share grant size and valuation context during the process, so you can evaluate the full package with real numbers, not vague promises.
  • Comprehensive health, dental, and vision benefits
  • Flexible, remote-first work environment
  • Flexible PTO and Accrued Sick Leave
  • Parental Leave
  • 13 Paid holidays
  • Home office stipend
  • Phone and Internet Stipend
  • Opportunity to shape the GTM motion for a next-generation treasury platform at a critical growth stage

À propos de Dialogue

Dialogue est le principal fournisseur de soins virtuels au Canada. En perfectionnant notre Plateforme de santé intégrée, nous offrons des programmes exceptionnels de santé et de bien-être en ligne (soins primaires, santé mentale, TCCi, PAE et bien-être) aux organisations qui souhaitent améliorer le bien-être de leurs employé(e)s et de leurs familles.

Lorsqu'il s'agit de notre travail, nous plaçons la barre très haut. Ensemble, nous transformons la santé et aidons des millions de personnes à améliorer leur bien-être. Nous croyons fermement qu’une équipe exceptionnelle exige plus pour sa :

  • Communauté
  • Croissance
  • Performance

Vous avez l’impression de pouvoir changer les choses? Bonne nouvelle, nous avons une place pour vous!

Nous vous acceptons comme vous êtes. En tant qu’employeur soucieux de l’égalité des chances, Dialogue s’engage à créer un lieu de travail diversifié et inclusif pour tout le monde. Position Summary

Ironmark is seeking a strategic, analytical, and client-focused Senior Digital Marketing Strategist to lead integrated marketing strategy across a portfolio of client accounts.

This role serves as the strategic bridge between client business objectives and marketing execution, partnering with clients, account teams, and channel specialists to develop growth-focused strategies that drive measurable business outcomes. The Senior Digital Marketing Strategist is responsible for aligning marketing initiatives across the customer journey, translating performance data into actionable recommendations, and ensuring execution supports broader business goals.

The ideal candidate combines strong business acumen, marketing expertise, and analytical thinking with the ability to build trusted client relationships and influence cross-functional teams. This role does not directly manage personnel but plays a critical leadership role in shaping strategy, guiding execution, and driving client success.

Key Responsibilities

Client Strategy & Leadership

  • Serve as the primary strategic advisor for assigned client accounts.
  • Lead strategic planning initiatives, quarterly business reviews, growth discussions, and client consultations.
  • Translate business goals into integrated marketing strategies and actionable roadmaps.
  • Present strategic recommendations, performance insights, and growth opportunities to client stakeholders.
  • Build trusted relationships through proactive consultation and strategic guidance.

Integrated Marketing Strategy

  • Develop and oversee integrated marketing strategies across paid media, SEO, AEO, content marketing, email marketing, local marketing, analytics, and emerging digital channels.
  • Ensure channel initiatives work cohesively throughout the customer journey and support business objectives.
  • Collaborate with channel specialists to align tactical execution with strategic priorities.
  • Identify opportunities to improve performance through audience targeting, conversion optimization, content alignment, media mix adjustments, and cross-channel coordination.
  • Stay informed on emerging technologies, AI-driven search experiences, and evolving consumer behavior.

Performance & Growth Planning

  • Analyze marketing performance data to identify trends, opportunities, risks, and growth drivers.
  • Translate insights into actionable recommendations for clients and internal teams.
  • Develop testing roadmaps and optimization plans designed to improve business outcomes.
  • Recommend channel investment strategies and budget allocation.
  • Identify opportunities for account growth and expanded service adoption.
  • Lead strategic onboarding and discovery efforts for new client engagements.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with Paid Media, SEO, Content, Creative, Analytics, Development, Local Marketing, and Account Management teams to ensure coordinated execution.
  • Provide strategic guidance while respecting channel ownership and subject matter expertise.
  • Support internal teams with market research, competitive insights, and strategic recommendations.
  • Contribute to agency thought leadership, process improvements, and strategic best practices.

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or related field, or equivalent experience.
  • 4–7 years of experience in digital marketing, growth marketing, account strategy, marketing consulting, or agency environments.
  • Experience presenting recommendations and performance insights to clients or business stakeholders.
  • Strong understanding of integrated digital marketing strategy and how multiple channels work together to drive business outcomes.
  • Demonstrated expertise in multiple digital marketing disciplines and working knowledge across paid, organic, content, local, email, and analytics channels.
  • Experience analyzing marketing performance data and translating insights into strategic recommendations.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and relationship-building skills.
  • Strong organizational, project management, and problem-solving abilities.

Preferred

  • Agency experience managing multiple client accounts.
  • Experience supporting multi-location, healthcare, multifamily, higher education, franchise, or B2B marketing programs.
  • Familiarity with GA4, Looker Studio, CRM platforms, marketing automation platforms, and reporting tools.
  • Understanding of AI-powered search experiences, AEO, attribution frameworks, and conversion optimization.

What Makes Someone Successful in This Role

  • You naturally connect business goals to marketing strategy.
  • You enjoy solving complex marketing challenges and uncovering growth opportunities.
  • You can confidently communicate with clients, executives, and channel specialists.
  • You think beyond individual tactics and understand how channels work together throughout the customer journey.
  • You are comfortable using data to inform decisions and recommendations.
  • You balance strategic thinking with accountability and execution.
  • You stay curious about emerging trends in AI, search, media, and digital marketing.

Why Join Ironmark

At Ironmark, we combine strategy, creativity, technology, and data to help organizations grow. Our team thrives on collaboration, innovation, continuous learning, and delivering measurable results for clients across a wide range of industries.

As a Senior Digital Marketing Strategist, you’ll have the opportunity to influence meaningful client outcomes, collaborate with talented specialists, and help shape the future of integrated digital marketing.

jobs.description:
Founded in 1981, Lanter Delivery Systems is a national logistics company and a leader in overnight, unattended delivery of auto, agricultural and industrial parts from their customer's distribution centers to dealer locations. In the 21st century we live in a business culture that demands cost and logistical efficiencies combined with increased productivity. Lanter's strategic, process driven approach has been embraced by the marketplace and is setting new standards in the automotive and agricultural manufacturing marketplace. We see a bright future on the road before us and we are very excited about bringing our solutions to a variety of new industries.

The ideal candidate will embody our company's Non-Negotiables:

  • Walk in Humble Confidence- We are experts at what we do, but we never assume we know everything
  • Be Open, Honest and Respectful- We say what has to be said in a tactful, courteous way
  • Be Fearless- We never fail, we only learn
  • We are One Team- We achieve more together by collaboration and consensus
  • Delivery on Commitments- We do what we say we will do
  • We have a Passion to Serve- We are dedicated, hardworking individuals who provide exceptional service to our customers and to each other
  • We put Safety First- We prioritize the safety of our team members and customers above all else in our business
  • We Strive for Operational Excellence- We are dedicated to a culture of continuous improvements, driving quality and productivity

Position Summary:

The Senior Data & Analytics Engineer supports the continued development and reliability of Lanter’s enterprise data platform. Working within an Azure and Databricks environment, this position builds and enhances data pipelines, integrates new data sources, develops reporting-ready datasets, and implements automated testing to protect the integrity of production ETL/ELT processes.

This hands-on role works across data engineering, analytics, data modeling, governance, and reporting. The position partners with business and technical stakeholders to translate complex requirements into accurate, scalable, and understandable data solutions.

Essential Duties and Key Deliverables:

  • Build and operate ETL/ELT pipelines using Databricks, SQL, Python, Spark/PySpark, and Azure Data Lake.
  • Develop an integrated enterprise gold-layer model spanning source systems, customers, and operating companies.
  • Build dimensional serving-layer and data-mart models with deliberate decisions regarding grain, keys, conformed dimensions, historical data, and slowly changing dimensions.
  • Implement automated regression testing using defined inputs and expected outputs to validate pipelines and transformations.
  • Own orchestration, observability, performance, failure diagnosis, replay and recovery, root-cause fixes, and cost management for assigned production solutions.
  • Partner with stakeholders to reconcile business definitions and establish data requirements, rules, ownership, and governance standards.
  • Apply disciplined engineering practices, including Git, code review, reusable components, automated testing, controlled deployments, and technical documentation.
  • Develop analytics and reporting solutions using Sigma, Power BI, or comparable platforms.
  • Support strategic data initiatives across Lanter’s business units and industry verticals, including AI, operational visibility, and analytics enablement.
  • Independently own deliverables and provide technical guidance on complex data and analytics needs.

Required Experience and Skills:

  • 5+ years of experience in data engineering, analytics engineering, BI engineering, or a related field.
  • Strong, recent, hands-on experience developing production pipelines with Python and Spark/PySpark.
  • Advanced SQL skills and hands-on experience with Databricks, Azure Data Lake, and Azure DevOps or comparable technologies.
  • Experience designing integrated enterprise models and dimensional data marts, including grain, keys, conformed dimensions, history, and slowly changing dimensions.
  • Experience implementing automated testing, regression testing, data-quality controls, and pipeline validation.
  • Experience operating production data solutions, including monitoring, optimization, troubleshooting, recovery, and cost management.
  • Experience with Git, code review, CI/CD, reusable development practices, and technical documentation.
  • Ability to translate complex business requirements into scalable data and analytics solutions.
  • Strong communication, collaboration, problem-solving, and independent ownership skills.

Preferred Experience:

  • Experience in logistics, transportation, supply chain, or another operationally complex environment.
  • Experience supporting data governance, AI, or advanced analytics initiatives.

Supervisory Responsibilities:

This position has no direct supervisory responsibilities but is expected to provide technical guidance and serve as a resource for complex data and analytics needs.

Position Type:

This is a full-time, remote position. Proximity to Lanter’s St. Louis headquarters is preferred but not required, and there is no regular onsite work requirement.

Travel:

Travel may be required periodically for company meetings, training, or other business needs.

Work Environment:

This job is performed in a professional remote or office environment. The role routinely uses standard office equipment such as computers, phones, and other job-related technology or systems. The team member may be required to sit for extended periods of time while working at a computer and communicating with internal and external business partners.

Physical Demands:

The team member is regularly required to listen, communicate verbally and in writing, sit for extended periods of time, use a computer and other office equipment, and occasionally lift up to 15 pounds at a time.

Other Duties:

This job description is not designed to cover a comprehensive listing of activities, duties, or responsibilities required of the team member for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may vary by location based on business needs and may change at any time with or without notice.

EEO Statement:

Lanter Delivery Systems provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all team members and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, or genetics. In addition to federal law requirements, Lanter Delivery Systems complies with applicable state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment in every location in which the company has facilities. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training. Lanter Delivery Systems expressly prohibits any form of workplace harassment based on race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, genetic information, disability, or veteran status. Improper interference with the ability of Lanter Delivery Systems team members to perform their job duties may result in discipline up to and including discharge.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Salesforce and Digital platforms
jobs.excerpt: Join nesto — proudly named Canadian Rocketship 2025*.
jobs.description:
Join nesto — proudly named Canadian Rocketship 2025*. A Deloitte Fast 50 company evolving alongside Canada’s top tech innovators and disrupting a 2.1 Trillion-dollar mortgage industry at light speed by building the mortgage ecosystem of the future.

BUILD lending technology with the best developers, AI engineers, and mortgage experts in the country. Work on a modern tech stack and a development framework designed to unlock your full potential and accelerate your career.

Why join us

  • Hypergrowth: Deloitte Fast 50 — 3 years in a row
  • Tech community credibility: TechTO Canadian Rocketship 2025*
  • Industry leadership: CLA Lending Company of the Year — 4 consecutive years
  • Talent magnet: CMP Top Mortgage Employer 2025
  • Trusted technology: powering major financial institutions across Canada
  • An entrepreneurial culture built on trust, speed, uncomfortable ambition, being stronger together, and a relentless obsession with our clients.

WHO ARE YOU

Platform thinkers. Outcome obsessed.

Builders. Problem-solvers. Curious minds. People who move fast, embrace AI as a competitive edge, and believe that great internal platforms make every team better.

ABOUT NESTO AND NESTO CLOUD

Canada's leading mortgage technology company.

Nesto is Canada’s leading provider of mortgage technology and financing solutions, managing $73B+ CAD in residential and commercial mortgages, with 1,000+ team members across 12 offices nationwide. You will be working on Nesto Cloud, Canada’s most advanced cloud platform, delivering end-to-end technology solutions for lenders in the digital age.

ABOUT THE TEAM

Where you sit.

You'll be embedded in the Product team, at the intersection of business operations and Nesto Cloud. Your closest partners will be Senior Salesforce Developers, who own the technical architecture, Apex and integrations, alongside stakeholders across sales, mortgage advisory, and operations.

Your job is to own the what and why. The developer owns the how. Together, you're the engine behind everything Salesforce at Nesto.

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

Own the platform. Shape the experience.

Salesforce Product Ownership

  • Own the Salesforce product roadmap from discovery through delivery, adoption, and iteration.
  • Translate requirements from sales, mortgage advisory, marketing, and operations into user stories, epics, and acceptance criteria your developer can build from immediately.
  • Manage the backlog and sprint cycles in close partnership with our Senior Salesforce Developers and engineering teams.
  • Drive user adoption and change management: people should want to use the tools you build.
  • Define and track KPIs for each feature; use data to continuously improve the platform.
  • Stay ahead of Salesforce's annual releases, evaluating new capabilities.

Cross-Platform Flexibility

  • Flex to adjacent platforms: customer portals, partner tools, or other user-facing SaaS, applying the same product discipline regardless of the underlying stack.
  • Partner with UX and design to ensure a coherent experience across every user touchpoint.
  • Bring a platform-agnostic mindset: the goal is always the best outcome for users, not loyalty to any one tool.

Market & User Intelligence

  • Run competitive analysis and market research to keep our platform strategy sharp and ahead of the curve.
  • Gather and synthesize user feedback through interviews, surveys, and usage analytics to make evidence-based decisions.
  • Communicate clearly and with conviction to stakeholders at all levels: from ops leads to the executive team.

AI-Augmented Ways of Working

  • Actively use AI tools (Cursor, Claude, Figma AI, etc.) to accelerate research, writing, analysis, and prototyping. Every day, not occasionally.
  • Model what high-leverage AI usage looks like and help your colleagues level up alongside you.
  • Evaluate Salesforce's native AI capabilities (Einstein, Agentforce) as part of your platform roadmap: know when to build vs. buy vs. enable.

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

The profile.

Required

  • 5-7+ years in product management, with at least 2 years directly owning a Salesforce environment.
  • Solid working knowledge of Salesforce's core clouds: Sales Cloud and Experience Cloud at minimum.
  • Enough platform fluency to hold a conversation with a Senior Salesforce Developer: you don't write Apex, but you deeply understand what it takes to build what you're asking for.
  • Strong analytical instincts: you use data to frame problems, prioritize features, and measure outcomes.
  • Excellent communicator who translates naturally between business stakeholders and technical teams.
  • Proven, active fluency with AI tools in your professional work.

Nice to have

  • Salesforce certifications: Administrator, Platform App Builder, Sales Cloud Consultant, or Service Cloud Consultant.
  • Familiarity with Salesforce integration patterns.
  • Experience managing non-Salesforce platforms.
  • Background in fintech, mortgage, or lending.
  • Exposure to UX research methods and user journey mapping.

YOU SHOULDN'T APPLY IF

Be honest with yourself.

  • You've never directly owned a Salesforce roadmap. Being adjacent doesn't count: we need someone who has done this.
  • You can't hold a technical conversation with a senior developer. You don't build, but you need to understand what you're asking others to build.
  • You think AI tools are a trend to watch rather than a lever to pull. We expect active, productive usage, not awareness.
  • You need a fully defined problem to get started. The best people here create the structure, they don't wait for it.
  • You're looking for a slow, consensus-driven environment. Uncomfortable ambition is one of our values, and we mean it.

INTERVIEW PROCESS

How we get to know each other.

  • Recruiter Screen – 30 minutes
  • Discovery Call with Director of Product – 30 minutes
  • Take-home Assignment followed by Presentation and Q&A – 60 minutes
  • Final Stakeholder Interview – 45 minutes
  • Criminal Record and Reference Checks + Offer

THE REWARD

The role is focused on selling OpenClinica’s eClinical solutions, including EDC, eConsent, eCOA/ePRO, analytics, and EMR integrations, to small to mid-size biotech and medtech companies with lean clinical operations teams, limited internal IT resources, and time-sensitive study needs. Some academic opportunities may arise, but that is not the primary focus.

  • Identify, qualify, and advance opportunities with small to mid-size biotech and medtech companies
