jobs.excerpt: About Beazley Security: Beazley Security is a global cybersecurity firm committed to helping clients enable advanced cyber defenses that reduce risk with quantifiable results.
jobs.description:
About Beazley Security:

Beazley Security is a global cybersecurity firm committed to helping clients enable advanced cyber defenses that reduce risk with quantifiable results. We’re comprised of top talent from private industry, government, intelligence, and law enforcement who are specialists in threat detection, incident response, digital forensics, offensive security, risk management, and cyber resilience. As a subsidiary of a specialty insurance giant, Beazley Insurance, we’ve been at the forefront of cyber insurance management and breach response activities for business clients in the US, UK, and Europe since 2017. As Beazley Security, the company will have an expanded scope, leveraging nearly two decades of cyber incident experience, a strong services division, and a business strategy focused on growth, to realize our goals and deliver benefits to clients.

As a company, we are committed to upholding our core values of Belonging, Integrity, Service, Accountability, and Curiosity. We believe these values are essential to creating a strong and inclusive workplace culture, as well as to deliver world-class cybersecurity solutions to our clients worldwide. As Beazley Security, these values will continue to thrive, with an extra emphasis on expansion of our capabilities and capacity in helping solve unique client challenges.

About Beazley Security Labs:

Beazley Security Labs (BSL) is responsible for transforming real-world threat activity into actionable intelligence that directly improves client security outcomes and strengthens Beazley Security’s products and services. The team conducts in-depth cybersecurity research, derives insight from incident response engagements and MDR findings, and proactively identifies emerging threats and vulnerabilities to deliver timely security advisories and detection logic for our Exposure Management platform.

Beazley Security Labs also provides operational threat intelligence that supports Managed Detection and Response and Incident Response teams through threat hunts and threat actor profiling, while also producing original research, quarterly threat reports, and industry content that builds Beazley Security’s credibility and brand. With the ultimate goal of making adversaries less effective, Labs serves as a critical bridge between frontline incidents, product innovation, and thought leadership.

About the Role:

The window between vulnerability disclosure and mass exploitation keeps getting shorter. As a Vulnerability Detection Engineer on Beazley Security Labs, your job is to close that window for our clients. When a critical vulnerability drops, you figure out how to reliably identify it from the internet, build a detection for it, prove it works, and ship it to our Exposure Management platform so clients know whether they are exposed before an attacker does. This work rewards a certain curiosity about how software breaks, and the patience to keep asking how to identify vulnerable systems from the internet.

You will work as part of the Beazley Security Labs research team to identify and analyze emerging threats and critical vulnerabilities, and to own the delivery of detection logic that surfaces that exposure in client environments. The role combines vulnerability analysis, exploit research, and threat intelligence with the engineering work required to turn research findings into real world detections. You will use agentic workflows as part of that process, building skills and automation that accelerate research, validation, and detection development. The role also contributes to Beazley Security Labs research supporting security operations, incident response, and client advisories.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Conduct vulnerability research on internet exposed services and software, working with the BSL research team to determine what a vulnerable instance looks like in collected scan data
  • Monitor vendor advisories, vulnerability disclosures, and help determine which vulnerabilities warrant detection coverage based on exploitability and exposure across our client base
  • Analyze proof of concept exploits in lab environments to identify the version strings, response behaviors, service fingerprints, and configuration artifacts that distinguish vulnerable systems and services
  • Author, test, and maintain vulnerability detection logic against Exposure Management scan data, and own detection lifecycles
  • Develop and maintain scan configurations that collect the data detections depend on, including service fingerprinting, targeted protocol probes, and response parsing
  • Validate new and existing software detections across client asset data, and be accountable for the false positive and false negative rates of the coverage you own
  • Build and improve internal tooling and automation for vulnerability monitoring, detection authoring, and regression testing
  • Collaborate on technical write ups, advisories, and remediation guidance that accompany your detections, and contribute to Beazley Security Labs intelligence reporting and published research
  • Partner with other internal departments to convert frontline intrusion findings into proactive detection coverage within Exposure Management
  • Apply where Agentic AI can be leveraged to improve our existing processes analyzing new vulnerabilities reported by the industry.
  • Research where Agentic AI can be leveraged to improve our existing processes of discovering affected software in our client base, validating vulnerable status, and producing advisory content.

Required Qualifications: 

  • Proficiency writing analytical SQL, including joins, aggregations, and regular expression matching, with the ability to reason about query correctness and performance against large datasets
  • Working proficiency in Python for data manipulation, parsing, tooling, and automation
  • Proficiency designing and applying agentic AI workflows and AI harnesses to detection research and engineering, including building reusable skills, automating research and validation, and operationalizing detection deployments at scale
  • Experience with Git, code review, and testing practices in a detection engineering environment
  • Strong grasp of networking fundamentals, HTTP, TLS, and web application architecture, sufficient to interpret raw service responses and understand how to fingerprint software
  • Practical understanding of common vulnerabilities and how they are exploited, including authentication bypass, remote code execution, injection flaws, deserialization attacks, and path traversal
  • Ability to read a vendor advisory or public proof of concept code and independently determine what evidence would confirm a vulnerable instance
  • Demonstrated ability to work carefully with ambiguous or incomplete data

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience writing detection, alerting, or analytic logic against large-scale telemetry or scan data in a data warehouse environment
  • Experience with data quality work identifying gaps, inconsistencies, or drift in upstream collection
  • Familiarity with detection and scanning frameworks such as Nuclei or Nmap NSE, and an understanding of how their scanning logic works
  • Experience collaborating in a code repository and using AI assisted coding tools
  • Exposure to vulnerability prioritization frameworks including CISA KEV, EPSS, CVSS, and CWE
  • Experience building isolated lab environments with Docker or virtual machines to reproduce vulnerable software
  • Experience with patch diffing, binary analysis, or reverse engineering
  • Published CVEs, bug bounty findings, open-source security tooling contributions

Beazley Security Offers:

  • Competitive salary and bonus.
  • Flexible working arrangements.
  • Generous leave policies including 3 months paid parental.
  • 100% of employee-only insurance premiums covered (healthcare, dental and vision).
  • Up to 5% matched 401k contribution.
  • Opportunities for career advancement and ongoing training.
  • Participation in industry conferences and events.

Dein Profil und Tätigkeitsschwerpunkte

Fokus auf Kundensupport:

  • Du führst eigenverantwortlich kleinere und größere Rechercheaufgaben (Desk Research, User Research,...) durch.

Das erwartet dich:

  • Du wirst Teil eines hochmotivierten Teams, in dem das gemeinsame Entwickeln und Vorantreiben von digitalen Gesundheitslösungen für Frauen (und der Spaß daran) im Vordergrund stehen.

  • Du kannst von deinen erfahrenen Kolleg*innen mit Expertise in Medizin, Tech, Digital Business, Regulatorik, Market Access viel lernen.

  • Eine faire Entlohnung und flexible Arbeitsmöglichkeiten (wir schätzen die flexible Nutzung des Home Offices, arbeiten aber auch gerne regelmäßig gemeinsam in unserem wunderschönen Office in Kreuzberg mit Spree-Blick, sofern es die Covid-Situation zulässt).

  • Schau‘ dir gerne auch auf an, was unsere Teammitglieder über uns sagen!

Klingt alles nach genau der richtigen Herausforderung für dich?

Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung!

Die RoX Health GmbH mit Sitz in Berlin ist ein Venture Builder und eigenständiges Tochterunternehmen des Gesundheitskonzerns Roche. Zusammen mit Partnern arbeiten wir aktuell an Innovationen in den Bereichen Onkologie, Neurologie und Frauengesundheit. Dabei bieten wir unseren Partnern Expertise und Netzwerke entlang der gesamten Startup Journey an: bei der Organisations- und Portfolioentwicklung, dem Marktzugang und der Kommerzialisierung. So verbinden wir das Beste aus Startup- und Konzernwelt für nachhaltige Verbesserungen im Gesundheitswesen.

Woran glauben wir?

Die Zukunft der Medizin ist patientenzentriert, personalisiert und digitalisiert.

In den Alltag integrierte digitale Gesundheitslösungen sind ein unverzichtbarer Schlüssel zu einem finanziell nachhaltigen und qualitativ hochwertigen Gesundheitssystem.

jobs.description:
Remote | New Zealand | Project-Based Independent Contractor

Compensation: $35–$140 USD/hour, based on specialty, experience, and project requirements

Help Shape the Future of AI in Government

What if your clinical expertise could help artificial intelligence better understand complex medical information, evaluate healthcare scenarios, and deliver more accurate, reliable responses?

At Volga Partners, we’re connecting experienced healthcare professionals with opportunities to contribute to the development and evaluation of advanced AI models.

We’re seeking physicians, nurse practitioners, and physician assistants who can apply their clinical knowledge, independent judgment, and evidence-based reasoning to evaluate AI-generated medical information.

This isn’t a traditional healthcare position. You won’t be providing direct patient care or managing a caseload. Instead, you’ll assess complex medical scenarios, challenge inaccurate conclusions, identify gaps in reasoning, and provide structured feedback that improves AI model performance.

Your clinical expertise is what matters. AI experience is a plus, not a requirement.


Important Note: This is a freelance, task-based role designed for those seeking supplemental income. It’s essential to understand the nature of freelance work—tasks will be assigned as they become available, and work may be irregular or intermittent.

The Opportunity

As a Healthcare SME, you’ll serve as a subject matter evaluator, helping assess the quality, accuracy, and reasoning of AI-generated responses across specialized healthcare functions.

You’ll examine realistic scenarios, identify errors or gaps in AI-generated conclusions, and provide expert feedback grounded in established medical standards, clinical guidelines, and professional judgment.

Your contributions will help improve how AI systems understand and respond to complex healthcare challenges.

Areas of Expertise We're Seeking

We're particularly interested in professionals with substantial knowledge and practical experience in one or more of these areas:

1. General Practice

Physicians experienced in primary care, diagnostic assessment, preventive medicine, management of common medical conditions, and evidence-based clinical decision-making.

2. Family Medicine

Physicians with expertise in comprehensive primary care, acute and chronic disease management, differential diagnosis, and patient care across different age groups.

3. Internal Medicine

Physicians experienced in adult medicine, complex medical conditions, diagnostic interpretation, multisystem disease management, and evidence-based treatment decisions.

4. Nurse Practitioners (NPs)

Advanced-practice nursing professionals with experience in clinical assessment, diagnostic reasoning, treatment planning, patient management, and healthcare quality standards within their professional scope.

5. Physician Assistants / Physician Associates (PAs)

Qualified clinical professionals with experience in patient assessment, diagnostic evaluation, treatment planning, and interpretation of medical findings within their professional scope.

You do not need expertise in every area. We're seeking depth of knowledge within your particular specialization.

What You'll Do

  • Evaluate AI-generated medical content: Assess responses for clinical accuracy, completeness, relevance, and consistency with accepted medical standards.
  • Analyze clinical reasoning: Determine whether AI-generated assessments, differential diagnoses, and treatment recommendations are supported by appropriate clinical evidence.
  • Identify errors and inconsistencies: Recognize inaccurate medical information, unsupported conclusions, missing clinical considerations, and potential patient safety concerns.
  • Validate medical information: Reference authoritative medical literature, established clinical guidelines, and evidence-based healthcare practices.
  • Provide expert feedback: Clearly explain findings, identify opportunities for improvement, and recommend clinically appropriate corrections.
  • Support AI quality improvement: Apply established evaluation guidelines, scoring criteria, and project-specific quality standards.
  • Complete independent evaluations: Use designated online platforms to complete assignments accurately and within established project timelines.

Why Join Volga Partners?

Apply Your Clinical Expertise in a New Way

Use the medical knowledge and professional judgment you've developed throughout your career to contribute to advanced AI technology without providing direct patient care.

Help Improve AI Accuracy and Reliability

Your evaluations will help identify weaknesses in AI-generated medical information and support the development of more accurate, clinically informed AI systems.

Work Remotely

Participate in specialized project-based assignments from an eligible location, with schedules and workloads determined by project needs.

Explore the Future of Healthcare Technology

Gain experience contributing to advanced AI model evaluation while applying the professional expertise you already possess.

No AI Background Required

We're looking for strong clinical professionals who can recognize accurate medical reasoning, identify mistakes, and explain their assessments using sound professional judgment.


Compensation:

Volga Partners offers project-based hourly compensation based on clinical specialization, relevant experience, professional qualifications, geographic location, and project requirements. See rates per expertise:

General Practice Physician: $65–$120

Family Medicine Physician: $70–$130

Internal Medicine Physician: $80–$140

Nurse Practitioner: $40–$75

Physician Assistant: $35–$70

Project Details

  • Engagement Type: Project-based independent contractor
  • Work Arrangement: Remote
  • Primary Location: United States
  • Additional Markets: United Kingdom, Australia, New Zealand, Canada, India, and the Philippines, subject to client approval
  • Schedule: Variable, including potential weekday and weekend assignments
  • Evaluation Platform: DataCompute
  • Project Duration: Based on client requirements and project availability
  • Selection Process: Qualified candidates may be required to complete a skills-based clinical evaluation assessment before selection

Specific assignments, schedules, workloads, and project dates will be communicated as they are confirmed. Hours and future assignments are not guaranteed.

Bring Your Medical Expertise to the Future of AI

If you're an experienced healthcare professional who enjoys analyzing complex medical information, applying evidence-based clinical judgment, and contributing to innovative technology, we'd love to hear from you.

Join Volga Partners and help shape the next generation of healthcare AI.

Apply today to be considered for upcoming project opportunities.

Requirements

Who We're Looking For

We’re seeking experienced healthcare professionals who bring more than familiarity with clinical practice. You should be comfortable analyzing complex medical information, exercising independent clinical judgment, and explaining the reasoning behind your conclusions.

Required Qualifications

  • Minimum of three years of relevant professional clinical experience in an applicable specialty.
  • Recognized medical degree, advanced-practice qualification, or equivalent professional credential appropriate to the specialty and country.
  • Demonstrated experience applying clinical judgment, diagnostic reasoning, or evidence-based medical practices.
  • Strong understanding of medical terminology, clinical guidelines, and healthcare standards relevant to the candidate's specialization.
  • Ability to critically evaluate complex medical information and distinguish accurate clinical reasoning from unsupported conclusions.
  • Strong analytical, research, and problem-solving abilities.
  • Excellent written English communication skills, including the ability to clearly explain clinical findings and professional assessments.
  • Comfort using digital platforms, web-based applications, and online research tools.
  • Ability to work independently, follow detailed instructions, and meet established quality standards.
  • Must be comfortable and understand this is a task-based role.

Preferred Qualifications

We encourage applications from professionals with backgrounds such as:

  • Current or previous professional licensure or registration relevant to the candidate's specialty.
  • Experience reviewing medical records, clinical research, medical guidelines, or healthcare quality assessments.
  • Familiarity with U.S. healthcare standards or clinical practices in the United Kingdom, Canada, Australia, or New Zealand.
  • Experience evaluating clinical documentation, medical literature, or complex healthcare cases.
  • Previous exposure to AI model evaluation, medical content review, clinical research, or healthcare technology.

Experience with AI model evaluation, large language models (LLMs), research, or structured quality assessments is beneficial but not required.

jobs.description:
About the Role

We are looking for a detail-oriented QC Reviewer to ensure the quality and consistency of robot manipulation video annotations produced by our annotation team. You'll review labeled video segments against a detailed style guide and reference examples, catch errors or inconsistencies, and provide clear, constructive feedback to annotators. This role is critical to maintaining the accuracy and reliability of training data used for robotics AI models.

Project Details:

  • Job Title: Project Cursa - Robot Manipulation Video Annotation QC
  • Location: Remote in India/Philippines﻿/Egypt/Mexico
  • Employment type: Freelance
  • Pay Rate: US$4.03/hour

What You'll Do

  • Review completed annotations of robot manipulation videos across three levels of labeling detail (atomic motion, skill/subtask, task/goal).
  • Cross-check annotator descriptions against all three camera views (overhead and both wrist-mounted cameras) to verify accuracy of described actions, object identification, and contact/grasp details.
  • Verify full coverage of each video — confirm there are no gaps in labeling, including idle or pause moments.
  • Check that descriptions accurately reflect what actually happened in the video, including failures, drops, or slipped grips — flagging any instances where outcomes were inaccurately described or "smoothed over."
  • Evaluate annotations for adherence to the style guide: correct vocabulary usage, spatial/directional accuracy, consistent terminology for objects and actions, and appropriate language variation (avoiding repetitive phrasing).
  • Identify recurring errors or patterns of confusion among annotators and report them to the team lead for calibration purposes.
  • Provide specific, actionable feedback on rejected or revised annotations, referencing the style guide and reference examples.
  • Participate in periodic calibration sessions with the team and client to align QC standards with evolving guidelines or edge-case resolutions.
  • Maintain a QC log or tracking sheet documenting review outcomes, common error types, and annotator performance trends (as required by the project).

What We're Looking For

Required:

  • Excellent written English and strong reading comprehension — you'll be evaluating precise, nuanced language choices, not just checking for typos.
  • Exceptional attention to detail — able to catch subtle mismatches between video content and written description (e.g., a mislabeled grasp type, an incorrect object part, a missed failure event).
  • Strong grasp of spatial/mechanical description (left/right, above/below, object parts like handles, lids, edges) to verify annotator accuracy.
  • Ability to apply a detailed, structured style guide consistently and make sound judgment calls in ambiguous or edge-case scenarios.
  • Comfort giving clear, specific, and constructive feedback to annotators (written feedback, not just pass/fail marks).
  • Reliable, self-directed work habits, with the ability to work independently while meeting review turnaround expectations.

Nice to Have:

  • Prior experience in a QC, editing, proofreading, or annotation review role.
  • Experience with video annotation, data labeling, or transcription QA specifically.
  • Familiarity with robotics terminology (grippers, end-effectors, manipulation).
  • Experience with annotation tools such as Label Studio, including review/approval workflows.

About Us

At Ovation Law Firm, we’re more than just attorneys — we’re a source of hope and justice for consumers and injury victims. Our firm is dedicated to turning legal challenges into life-changing victories worldwide. We handle Lemon Law and Personal Injury cases with relentless commitment, standing up for our clients when it matters most.

We pride ourselves on being relentless advocates who never back down, ensuring that our clients' rights are fiercely protected. If you are passionate about making a meaningful difference and eager to contribute to our unwavering pursuit of justice, we invite you to join our dynamic team.

We are looking for a proactive, organized, and detail-oriented Settlement Coordinator to join our remote team and support our mission of achieving meaningful outcomes for clients nationwide.

About the Role

The Settlement Coordinator moves lemon law cases from demand to funded settlement. You track every settlement, keep manufacturers and clients on schedule, and make sure settlement paperwork, vehicle surrenders and payments close cleanly.

We represent consumers in automotive lemon law claims against manufacturers nationwide. You will work closely with attorneys, case managers and manufacturer counsel on a high volume of active files.

Key Responsibilities

  • Calculate repurchase and cash-and-keep figures, including incidental damages, offsets for use, negative equity and payoff amounts.
  • Track every settlement, offer and counter-offer, and flag responses that fall below authorized ranges to the assigned attorney.
  • Serve as day-to-day contact with manufacturer representatives and defense counsel on open settlements.
  • Follow up on outstanding checks, vehicle surrenders, release drafts and funding timelines, and escalate files that stall past firm deadlines.
  • Coordinate vehicle surrender logistics, including inspection dates, title transfer, lienholder payoff and payment of attorney's fees.
  • Explain offers, settlement terms and next steps to clients in plain language.
  • Obtain signed releases, settlement agreements, odometer statements and other required documents.
  • Keep clients updated on surrender scheduling and payment status.
  • Review release agreements for accuracy against the agreed terms before sending for signature.
  • Track settlement checks and attorney fee payments through receipt and disbursement.
  • Confirm lien and loan payoffs are completed and documented.
  • Keep case management records current for every settlement milestone.

Qualifications

  • 2+ years in a law firm, claims, or settlement role, preferably in consumer or plaintiff-side litigation.
  • Experience reading and summarizing financial documents such as purchase contracts, lease agreements and loan payoff statements.
  • Strong working knowledge of Excel or Google Sheets, including formulas for damages and offset calculations.
  • Experience with a case management system (e.g., Filevine, Clio).
  • Clear, professional written communication with clients and opposing counsel.
  • Demonstrates strong attention to detail, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and quality in all tasks and deliverables.

What We Offer

  • Earn $22-24/hour: Pay based on your skills and experience for a full-time, 40-hour workweek.
  • Boost Your Income: Enjoy performance-based bonuses.
  • Health, dental, and vision insurance benefits.
  • 7 Paid time off (PTO) days plus 7 paid holidays.
  • Opportunity to directly influence the growth and success of a rapidly expanding law firm.
  • Long-term growth opportunities within a fast-growing organization.

Work Location

This is a fully remote position open only to candidates residing in Florida.

How to Apply

Applying takes two short steps:

  • Submit your application
  • Complete our Culture Index survey (about 10 minutes):

The survey is a short questionnaire about how you naturally like to work. There are no right or wrong answers, and we look at it alongside your experience, not instead of it. Please use the same name and email address on the survey that you use on this application so we can match them up.

Salary: $22-$24 Hourly DOE

Job Summary:

As General Manager, Industrial Products & Services (IPS), reporting directly to the EVP, Industries, you will own the strategy, growth, and profitability of Toptal’s business across Automotive, Manufacturing, Agriculture, Oil & Gas, Chemical, and Logistics clients, with full P&L and budget authority. You will identify where we can win, decide where to invest, and build the team and client relationships to deliver sustained growth. Your mandate covers winning new enterprise clients, expanding existing relationships, and increasing the value clients receive from Toptal’s capabilities.

You will bring a clear perspective on the challenges facing potential clients and where Toptal can help. Working with our Services leaders and subject matter experts, you will translate those challenges into viable sales proposals across our AI solutions, managed services, management consultancy, and talent offerings. You will choose which markets, accounts, and opportunities to pursue, allocate resources accordingly, and give your team a focused plan.

You will lead from the front: personally leading executive client conversations, shaping proposals, working through difficult commercial negotiations, and helping close critical pursuits. Your team should see the selling standard you expect in your own work. You will understand what is driving performance, where growth is constrained, and what needs to change.

You will build on established enterprise relationships to expand the problems clients trust Toptal to solve through our services, AI-based solutions, and talent-based capabilities. You will have the authority to build the team and invest in profitable growth.

This is a remote position. Applicants must be authorized to work in the US at the time of hire. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.

Responsibilities:

The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.

  • Set and execute the industry strategy. Identify the markets, client problems, and offerings with the strongest growth potential. Build an IPS business plan with clear priorities, financial objectives, and investment decisions. Test your assumptions with clients and adjust the plan as evidence changes.
  • Own the P&L and budget. Be accountable for revenue, profitability, and spending. Set and manage the budget, allocate resources, and evaluate returns on investments in people and growth initiatives. Understand how pricing, delivery economics, retention, and portfolio mix affect results, and act when performance diverges from the plan.
  • Win new enterprise clients. Lead your team in pursuing priority accounts. Develop a credible reason for each client to engage with Toptal, build relationships with decision-makers, and personally advance important opportunities through discovery, solution development, negotiation, and close.
  • Expand and retain client relationships. Work with Client Partners to understand client priorities, broaden relationships across buying centers, and develop opportunities across Toptal’s portfolio. Stay close to important engagements, resolve concerns with the responsible teams, and turn successful outcomes into further business.
  • Make account planning actionable. Establish clear priorities and ownership. Expect your team to explain why an account matters, whom they need to engage, what opportunity they are pursuing, and how they will create progress. Ensure priority accounts receive sustained attention.
  • Bring the right expertise into the sale. Work with Services leaders, solution architects, and specialists to diagnose needs and develop credible proposals across services, AI-based solutions, and talent. Coordinate with supporting functions to resolve obstacles and keep opportunities moving toward a decision.
  • Maintain a credible forecast. Challenge the evidence behind opportunity values, close dates, and expected revenue. Understand the assumptions connecting the pipeline to the financial plan, identify risks early, and take specific action to address shortfalls.
  • Build and develop the team. Recruit strong commercial talent, set clear expectations, and coach people through real client situations. Review calls, account plans, and active pursuits; demonstrate stronger approaches and follow through on improvements. Address underperformance promptly and develop future leaders.
  • Accomplish work objectives through leading and supervising other Toptal team members on the Industrial Products and Services team.
  • Establish objectives and initiatives for the team, recommend the team’s structure and jobs, and organize, assign, delegate, oversee, and monitor work.
  • Coach and mentor team members, provide feedback, conduct performance reviews, and implement performance improvement plans, if needed.

In the first week, expect to:

  • Learn Toptal’s business model, capabilities, sales process, and client value proposition.
  • Meet your team and the leaders whose functions support the IPS business.
  • Begin reviewing the client portfolio, active opportunities, P&L, budget, and growth priorities.

In the first month, expect to:

  • Meet priority clients and develop an informed view of their needs, our relationships, and the opportunities ahead.
  • Assess the team’s capabilities and identify immediate coaching, performance, and hiring priorities.
  • Establish a consistent rhythm for account planning, opportunity reviews, forecasting, financial management, and coaching.
  • Present your proposed IPS business plan, including priority markets and accounts, revenue and profitability assumptions, investment choices, and the first actions you will take.

In the first three months, expect to:

  • Be executing an agreed business plan with clear objectives, resource allocations, account priorities, and ownership.
  • Be personally advancing major pursuits, helping close new business, and building qualified pipelines in priority accounts, while exercising discretion and independent judgment.
  • Have specific expansion plans for key clients and be executing the talent decisions needed to strengthen the team.

In the first six months, expect to:

  • Demonstrate measurable commercial progress against the plan through closed new business, expansion revenue, and margin performance.
  • Show that coaching, account planning, and opportunity reviews are improving seller performance and commercial results.
  • Manage the P&L against the budget, address material variances, and refine investment priorities using evidence from sales and delivery outcomes.

In the first year, expect to:

  • Deliver against the agreed IPS revenue, profitability, and budget objectives.
  • Have built a stronger team with clear accountability, consistent execution, and emerging leadership capability.
  • Demonstrate deeper client relationships and broader adoption of Toptal’s services, AI-based solutions, and talent-based capabilities.
  • Present the next stage of the industry business plan, including the investments required to sustain profitable growth.

Qualifications and Job Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree is required. Master’s degree in Engineering, Business, or a related field preferred.
  • 5+ years of proven success leading professional services sales teams specifically in Industrial Products and Services, with in-depth experience in the Energy Sector, specifically Oil & Gas is required.
  • 12+ years of demonstrated experience running and managing an industry business unit with a strong understanding of business operations and management principles.
  • Deep industry relationships ranging from director-level to C-level contacts is expected.
  • A sustained record of leading enterprise SaaS or services sales teams, winning new clients, and expanding existing relationships. You can demonstrate your personal contribution to those results.
  • Industry expertise and demonstrated sales experience in at least one of Oil & Gas, Industrial Manufacturing, Automotive, or Defense & Aerospace.
  • Demonstrated accountability for commercial results and resource decisions. You can explain how your choices on pricing, hiring, investment, and account priorities affected revenue, margin, and profitability.
  • Experience closing complex enterprise opportunities, including shaping a business case, coordinating technical expertise, navigating procurement, and negotiating commercial agreements.
  • Strong industry relationships and a record of earning access to senior decision-makers through relevant insight and demonstrated value.
  • Evidence of hiring strong sellers, improving individual and team performance through specific coaching, and developing future leaders.
  • Disciplined qualification and forecasting skills. You distinguish client interest from a credible buying process, assess the evidence behind a forecast, and act when an opportunity loses momentum.
  • Sufficient fluency in technology, AI, and services delivery to discuss client priorities intelligently and recognize when deeper specialist expertise is needed.
  • Clear, persuasive written and verbal communication. You can turn a complex client problem into a compelling proposal and explain business performance without obscuring the issues.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, rapidly growing company and handle a wide variety of challenges, deadlines, and a diverse array of contacts.
  • You must be a world-class individual contributor to thrive at Toptal. You will not be here just to tell other people what to do.

Essential Job Functions

  • Regularly and reliably attend scheduled virtual team meetings on camera.
  • Work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Use all required digital collaboration tools.
  • Prioritize and self-manage workflows and deadlines.

US FLSA Classification: Full-Time/Exempt

This position receives a base salary and is also eligible to earn monthly commissions based on revenue generated from engagements sold. For candidates who meet the qualifications and job requirements listed above, Individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

jobs.description:
Principal Data Scientist, AI (Architect-Level Scope)

About KLDiscovery

KLDiscovery is a global eDiscovery and legal technology provider serving large law firms, corporate legal departments, and government agencies. We build and operate the products and services that legal teams rely on to manage, process, and review case data at scale. With operations across multiple countries and a client base that includes AmLaw 200 firms, we handle some of the largest and most complex matters in the industry.

About the Role

We're hiring our most senior AI practitioner — someone with genuine data science rigor who also wants to build. In this role, you'll set the scientific and architectural direction for gen AI and ML at KLDiscovery: designing the evaluation methodology that proves our AI holds up under legal scrutiny, choosing and validating the models and retrieval systems that power our products, and building the hardest parts of that system yourself.

This is one of the most interesting data science problem sets in enterprise software. You'll work with terabytes of real-world legal data — emails, contracts, chat transcripts, images, video, depositions, and regulatory filings — from some of the largest litigation and investigation matters in the world. The work is hard in ways that matter: documents are messy and adversarial, the stakes are real (privilege, defensibility, attorney work product), and getting the evaluation wrong has real consequences. AI that can surface key people, themes, and timelines in hours instead of weeks, or pre-classify millions of documents for relevance and privilege with results that survive scrutiny, directly changes the economics of how legal matters get resolved. We build solutions that turn data into evidence the legal system can trust.

This is a builder-first role, not a research-only or advisory one. You'll design experiments and evaluation frameworks that prove our AI is defensible in court, build the retrieval and agent systems that reason over case data, and personally ship the hardest, most novel parts of that system. You'll set strategic direction across Nebula, our eDiscovery platform, and CS & Operations, then prove out the science and the architecture by building it yourself. Not a role for anyone stepping back from the keyboard, and not a role for anyone who treats evaluation as an afterthought.

We offer competitive total compensation that includes base pay, bonus potential, equity, inclusive benefits, wellness programs, and perks. We use market and industry data to inform pay decisions while considering geography and labor markets, individual experience, and business needs. Individual compensation will vary, although a reasonable estimate of the current annualized base pay range for this position is $190,000 to $240,000.

Job location: Remote (candidate must be based in the United States)

Key Responsibilities

Own the science and the architecture, and build both personally. Design the experimentation and evaluation methodology that determines whether our AI's outputs are accurate, consistent, and defensible — then define the end-to-end gen AI architecture across Nebula and CS & Operations to deliver on it: LLMs, agent harnesses, RAG, vector search, embeddings, and model selection and triage. Build the hardest parts personally: prototype agent loops, design and run the evaluations that validate them, tune retrieval, and ship the shared infrastructure that powers AI Case Explorer (case overviews, timelines, key people and themes, PII surfacing, and Agent chat), AI Agent Review (pre-classifying relevance, privilege, and key issues, shipping MLP), and CS & Ops tech-enablement as part of our central work orchestration system.

Own evaluation rigor, AI/MLOps, and telemetry end-to-end. Design the statistical and experimental methodology behind our evaluation harnesses — the standard our outputs have to meet to hold up under legal scrutiny — and own the infrastructure that enforces it: model deployment and versioning, eval pipelines, drift and quality monitoring, cost and latency telemetry, and prompt and agent observability. Define and implement how we select, triage, and route across models (Azure OpenAI, Anthropic, open-source, fine-tuned), manage vector databases and retrieval, and evolve our evaluation methodology and agent harness as the frontier moves.

Lead the practice from the front. Set the technical and scientific bar by building, not by reviewing. Partner with Engineering, Product, and Data Science leadership to translate that rigor into shipped product. Raise the bar on both AI engineering and evaluation discipline, mentor senior ICs through hands-on technical leadership, build and maintain relationships with model and infrastructure vendors, and represent KLD's AI strategy directly with customers, partners, and at industry events.

What You Bring (Required)

  • 7+ years in data science, applied AI/ML, or ML engineering, with recent hands-on experience as a senior or principal-level practitioner in the gen AI era
  • Real training in statistics, experimentation, or applied research you know how to design an evaluation that actually tests what you think it tests, not just one that looks reasonable
  • Proven track record architecting and personally building enterprise gen AI systems in production with measurable customer impact
  • Experience with consumer-facing or B2B customer-facing AI products — systems that real external users or customers depend on, not only internal tooling
  • Builder at heart: still writes code, runs experiments, ships, and tunes prompts and evals, and wants to keep doing so as a leader
  • Deep expertise across the modern gen AI stack: LLMs, agents, RAG, vector databases, embeddings, search, and evaluation harnesses
  • Hands-on experience designing system-of-systems AI pipelines spanning search, retrieval, agent harnesses, and model selection/triage
  • Strong proficiency with the Microsoft AI stack: Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry, Azure AI Search, and supporting Azure infrastructure
  • Excellent technical leadership skills; demonstrated ability to influence architecture and methodology decisions across product, engineering, and data science
  • Strong communication skills, including explaining evaluation results and architecture trade-offs to executive and customer audiences
  • Career experience spanning both a larger, established technology company and a smaller company or startup — comfortable operating with both institutional rigor and startup pace
  • Mentor team members and contribute to a culture of continuous improvement

Nice to Have (Preferred)

  • Advanced degree (MS or PhD) in Statistics, Machine Learning, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field
  • Peer-reviewed publications, technical writing, conference talks, or other evidence of contributing to the field, not just building within it
  • Background building agentic systems with tool use, planning, and multi-step reasoning in production
  • Prior experience setting up AI governance and evaluation harnesses in a regulated or high-stakes domain
  • Open-source contributions or other evidence of being a recognized builder in the AI community
  • A demonstrated track record of sticking with hard, ambiguous problems over long timeframes rather than pivoting away when the first approach doesn't work.

jobs.excerpt: ⚡About AmberAmber is an entirely new way to buy and sell power, designed for a world powered by renewable energy.
jobs.description:
⚡About Amber

Amber is an entirely new way to buy and sell power, designed for a world powered by renewable energy. We give customers direct access to the real-time wholesale electricity price as it varies every 5 mins and the technology to shift more of their energy usage to the times when cheaper renewables are available in the grid. It’s a cheaper way to buy power, a smarter way to sell power, and the fastest way for Australia to reach 100% renewable energy.

We are a clear category leader in Australia for home battery automation and are growing rapidly (close to 100k customers). We have also recently expanded into licensing our core technology to utilities overseas, including a partnership with E.ON Next in the UK.

Amber is backed by leading Australian and international investors, including Square Peg, Main Sequence, Breakthrough Victoria, Commonwealth Bank, NRMA, Gentrack, ETF Partners and E.ON Next. Most recently, Amber raised a $78.5 million Series E, led by 1GT, Morgan Stanley Investment Management’s climate tech fund, alongside participation from existing investors.

We are scaling rapidly and you’d be joining a team of close to 250 committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and purpose-driven culture as we transform a major industry.

Our products are reshaping home energy: Amber for Batteries cuts bills by exporting stored energy at wholesale prices of up to $20/kWh, and Amber for EVs enables the cheapest, cleanest charging. In 2026, we will push this even further with our new vehicle-to-grid (V2G) technology.

💻 About the role

This role sits within the BD team because we believe there is a huge opportunity to be at the forefront of helping Amber lead the world not only in home battery automation but also in vehicle-to-grid (V2G).

Vehicle-to-Grid (V2G) is one of the biggest levers we have: letting EV owners power their homes and earn from their car, lower their bills, and feed clean energy back to the grid — all while staying in control. Australia is the most advanced grid in the world which provides a great opportunity for our customers and the renewable transition, and Amber is positioning itself to be world leaders in V2G. What’s exciting is that as a new technology, the regulations and policy for V2G are being established today, so there is a huge opportunity to make an impact and help make sure they are the right policies for our customers.

We also believe Policy sits at the forefront of growth opportunities at Amber as we look towards new ways for customers' batteries to earn from the grid (such as Voluntary Scheduling and FCAS, as well as ways to support the National CER roadmap to drive uptake onto VPPs). This is where the BD team, and this role in particular, will work closely with the growth team.

While growth initiatives are at the core of this role, we are now at a stage where we are large enough that we need to stay on top of key regulatory or policy changes which may impact Amber’s core business. For this reason you will also work closely with our Head of Legal to help shape Amber’s approach to regulatory engagement on key rule changes and consultations.

This is the first dedicated policy role at Amber - so we are super excited to work with someone who can build and own the policy roadmap here at Amber as we scale.

✨ Why this is an exciting role

  • A real seat at the table. You will sit on the Growth Leadership Team, and work with other leaders across the business. You’re not buried under layers of sign-off. You will also get dedicated access to CO-CEO and Founder Dan Adams, and Chief Growth Officer Emily Rubin.
  • Climate impact you can point to. Making policy work for the betterment of our customers - so we continue to support more households gaining access and getting more benefits from their batteries, EVs - with access to cheaper, cleaner power.
  • A team that's already strong. We have a strong business development team, and a dedicated group actively working on vehicle-to-grid at pace.
  • Making a difference quickly. You will be the first dedicated policy person at Amber - there is so much opportunity to make an impact, fast!

👉🏽Responsibilities

  • Shape and drive Amber's strategy and organisations position on key policy developments
  • Engaging with government, regulators, and peak industry bodies, and representing Amber in these domains.
  • Lead targeted submissions, and direct engagement with policy/rule markers to influence design and rollout; coordinating input from cross-functional teams as required.
  • Direct our policy priorities across emerging market shifts, vehicle-to-grid (V2G), and market design.
  • Apply, build and own company tools and processes to assess policy and regulatory developments, leading regular internal meetings to agree priorities for engagement and triaging what matters most.
  • Lead tactical planning and prepare materials for senior executive engagement, focused on opportunities to move outcomes.
  • Build strong alliances with nonprofits, think-tanks, and experts to support major policy changes that accelerate Australia's adoption of automated home batteries and V2G charging.
  • Seats, memberships and regular meetings - representing Amber in key member groups such as Smart Energy Council (SEC) subcommittees, and Electric Vehicle Council (EVC) working groups. Regular catch-ups with the federal and state departments, AEMO and ministers' offices.
  • Manage a tactical budget - this may include commissioning and managing external experts, economic modelling and research.
  • Media and public advocacy - work with Amber’s PR and marketing team to make sure we are having a voice on the right topics, and being seen as leaders in this energy space.

You're probably a match if

  • We're open to mid-level or senior candidates. >4-8 years in policy, regulatory affairs, government or a peak body. Energy experience is preferred, but not a requirement; we will support capability building and professional development in relation to the energy market.
  • Proven strategic instinct: you can tell the three things that matter from the thirty that don't, and say why in a paragraph.
  • Strong, fast writing; comfortable using AI tools as a multiplier. Confident in presenting advice to executives internally, and government and stakeholders externally.
  • The disposition of a good diplomat: reliable presence, low ego, high follow-through.
  • Some people and project management experience: this role is built to expand; a strong hire could be leading a function and a team within a few years.
  • You're confident initiating relationships from a standing start — comfortable picking up the phone, reaching out cold, and opening doors.
  • You have a working knowledge of how government and regulators actually move (submissions, rule changes, ministerial offices), and an existing network.
  • You thrive in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment — highly organised, able to juggle multiple projects, and build structure and process where little exists.

🎉Benefits

  • We’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace and a great culture of people who love coming to work to build a better world.
  • You’d be a part of a rapidly growing team of over 235 with expertise across energy, technology, marketing, and operations.
  • Be part of a growing technology start-up that will shape the future of household and grid energy use.
  • Enjoy a lively, collaborative workspace at our buzzing Melbourne CBD headquarters in the heart of the city
  • Flexible working hours with provision for regular work from home arrangements.
  • Equitable gender-neutral parental leave policies.
  • An external Employee Assistance Plan (EAP) for mental health support.
  • Competitive salary and share options in Amber.
  • Annual Learning & Development budget to support your personal growth.
  • Additional PTO between Xmas & New Year

This is a full-time role to be based ideally from Melbourne, but we are also open to considering the right candidate anywhere within Australia.

We are also open to discussing a four day work week or nine day fortnight once you are fully ramped up, if that flexibility is important to you and something you would be looking for.

Amber is a remote first team; we have an office in the Melbourne CBD, where we work flexibly between the office and home. The vast majority of our team are located in Melbourne. For those based in Sydney, they catch up in a co-working space in the city every now and then, and rest of the locations in Australia work from home. While we don't expect people to attend the office, we do expect that people mostly work in the Melbourne time zone to maximise collaboration.

💰 Salary range is between $150k and $180k base per annum for a mid level and $220k and $250k base per annum for a senior and is quoted excluding superannuation. All salaried roles at Amber include employee stock options over and above the base salary and superannuation.

🌈 If this kind of work gets you excited, we'd love to hear from you!

Even if you don’t meet 100% of the requirements listed above, we still encourage you to apply. We're open to all backgrounds and encourage people from underrepresented groups to apply. We never discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, or disability status.

🏅 Our hiring process will be as below:

  • A screening interview with our talent team
  • A take-home case study
  • A follow up interview with the Hiring Manager
  • A final chat with one/two of the Executive Leadership team members

🎬 The bit at the end

We promise to be respectful of your time as an applicant while trying to be as thorough as possible in finding the right fit for our team.

Applications will be accepted only from candidates already based in Australia, preferably Melbourne with full working rights!

Shortlisted candidates will be contacted promptly. All other applicants will also be notified of the outcome as soon as possible.

jobs.title: General Manager, SMB
jobs.excerpt: Job Summary:As General Manager, Small & Medium Business (SMB), reporting directly to the EVP, Industries, you will own the strategy, growth, and profitability of Toptal’s SMB business, with full P&L and budget authority.
jobs.description:
Job Summary:

As General Manager, Small & Medium Business (SMB), reporting directly to the EVP, Industries, you will own the strategy, growth, and profitability of Toptal’s SMB business, with full P&L and budget authority. You will improve how we win new clients, retain and expand existing relationships, and bring more of Toptal’s capabilities to market. You will decide where to invest, build the team, and be accountable for the results.

SMB requires consistent and strong commercial judgment at a high volume. New clients arrive with an immediate need; within 15 minutes your team must quickly understand the problem, explain how Toptal can help, and move the opportunity toward a sale. In addition to strengthening the inbound execution, you will grow our nascent outbound sales motion, improve our client expansion motion, develop more targeted marketing with our Enterprise industry teams, and activate a partnership ecosystem to bring new clients and revenue to Toptal.

You will lead a high-energy sales organization with clear expectations and rigorous performance management. You will listen to calls, speak with clients, examine where opportunities are lost, and coach your leaders through specific performance issues. You will know whether a shortfall comes from demand, selling quality, pricing, capacity, or the client experience, and act with the responsible teams to address it. Your managers should see the standard you expect in your own work.

You will build on an established client base and inbound demand to expand the problems small and medium-sized businesses trust Toptal to solve through our services, AI-based solutions, and talent-based capabilities. You will have the authority to build the team and invest in profitable growth.

This is a remote position. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.

Responsibilities:

The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.

  • Set and execute the SMB strategy. Identify the client needs, offerings, and sales approaches with the strongest growth potential. Build a business plan with clear financial objectives, priorities, and investment choices. Strengthen the existing talent business while developing additional sources of growth.
  • Own the P&L and budget. Be accountable for revenue, profitability, and spending. Understand how conversion, retention, pricing, offering mix, and the cost to acquire and serve clients affect results. Allocate resources, evaluate returns, and act when performance diverges from the plan.
  • Improve conversion from first contact to first engagement. Set clear standards for response speed, discovery, qualification, and closing. Ensure sellers maintain ownership as specialists resolve technical questions and clients move through the buying process. Find where momentum is lost and address the underlying causes.
  • Grow and retain the client base. Build an account management approach that gives clients appropriate attention based on their needs and potential. Expect proactive conversations about upcoming work, engagement outcomes, and opportunities to do more with Toptal. Address reasons clients leave and develop practical ways to earn repeat business.
  • Build outbound sales and targeted marketing. Grow the nascent outbound motion into a repeatable source of revenue. Work with Marketing, Sales Development, and Enterprise industry teams to select target clients, develop relevant propositions, and run coordinated campaigns. Use shared industry insight and client experience to sharpen targeting, then assess results through conversion, revenue, and acquisition economics.
  • Activate a partnership ecosystem. Build partnerships that create qualified demand and new revenue for SMB. Identify and recruit the right partners, equip them to sell with Toptal, and develop joint plans with clear opportunity ownership. Turn promising relationships into active referral, co-selling, or resale motions, and invest in those that produce profitable growth.
  • Expand adoption of services and AI-based solutions. Help sellers recognize when a client’s needs extend beyond an individual talent request. Work with Services leaders and specialists to develop relevant propositions, bring expertise into client conversations, and close business. Build the team’s ability to sell broader solutions while maintaining progress on the client’s immediate need.
  • Build a high-performing sales organization. Recruit strong managers and sellers, set demanding but achievable expectations, and establish a daily and weekly rhythm for performance management. Hold managers accountable for call quality, conversion, productivity, and commercial results. Review their coaching, demonstrate stronger approaches, recognize strong performance, and address underperformance promptly.
  • Match capacity and coverage to the work. Plan staffing around demand, response expectations, active opportunities, and account needs. Give teams clear ownership and workable client portfolios. Coordinate with Operations, Matching, and Delivery so internal transitions preserve context and keep clients moving forward.
  • Run the business with reliable evidence. Establish a consistent view of acquisition, engagement starts, retention, expansion, seller productivity, and financial performance. Build forecasts that reflect the speed and volume of SMB sales. Test changes against clear baselines, distinguish temporary movement from sustained improvement, and use technology and AI to improve execution.

In the first week, expect to:

  • Learn Toptal’s business model, capabilities, SMB sales process, and client value proposition.
  • Meet your leadership team and the functions supporting acquisition, account management, partnerships, matching, and delivery.
  • Listen to client calls and begin reviewing the funnel, client portfolio, P&L, budget, and team performance, while exercising discretion and independent judgment.

In the first month, expect to:

  • Develop an informed view of where SMB wins, where clients lose momentum, and what limits growth.
  • Assess your leaders and teams, including coaching, performance, capacity, and hiring priorities.
  • Establish a consistent rhythm for commercial reviews, forecasting, financial management, and coaching.
  • Present your proposed SMB business plan, including priority outbound campaigns, partnership opportunities, financial assumptions, and investment choices.

In the first three months, expect to:

  • Be executing an agreed business plan with clear objectives, resource allocations, and ownership.
  • Have implemented initial improvements to conversion and retention, with baselines and a clear way to assess their impact.
  • Be running targeted outbound campaigns with Marketing, Sales Development, and Enterprise industry teams, and activating initial partner opportunities.
  • Have made the initial talent and leadership decisions needed to strengthen execution.

In the first six months, expect to:

  • Demonstrate measurable progress against the plan in revenue, profitability, conversion, and retention.
  • Show that coaching and consistent performance management are improving seller and manager effectiveness.
  • Show early commercial results from outbound campaigns and activated partners, with evidence to guide further investment.
  • Manage the P&L against the budget and address material variances with specific actions.

In the first year, expect to:

  • Deliver against the agreed SMB revenue, profitability, and budget objectives.
  • Have built a stronger leadership team with clear accountability, effective coaching, and consistent execution.
  • Demonstrate sustained improvement in acquiring, retaining, and growing clients, including broader adoption of Toptal’s capabilities.
  • Have established outbound sales and partnerships as measurable contributors to growth, with a clear plan for scaling them.

Qualifications and Job Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree is required. An MBA or a master’s degree in engineering, computer science, physics, or mathematics is preferred.
  • 12+ years of B2B commercial experience, including SaaS or services sales, with a sustained record of scaling high-volume sales to small and medium-sized businesses. You can demonstrate your personal contribution to growth and improved commercial performance.
  • 5+ years leading sales and account management teams, including experience managing managers. You have built high-energy teams, set clear performance standards, improved results through specific coaching, addressed underperformance, and developed future leaders.
  • Experience leading both new-client acquisition and account management, with evidence of improving conversion, retention, and expansion.
  • Demonstrated accountability for commercial results and resource decisions. You can explain how your choices on pricing, staffing, investment, and client coverage affected revenue and profitability.
  • Experience building outbound sales and working with Marketing and Sales Development on targeted campaigns that produce measurable revenue.
  • Experience activating commercial partnerships and turning partner relationships into qualified opportunities and revenue.
  • Strong analytical judgment. You can trace a performance problem through the sales process, test competing explanations, and determine whether a change produced a meaningful improvement.
  • The ability to improve a high-volume sales operation while introducing new offerings or ways of selling. You can make changes without losing control of daily execution.
  • Sufficient fluency in technology, AI, and services delivery to discuss client priorities intelligently, evaluate commercial opportunities, and recognize when specialist expertise is needed.
  • Clear, persuasive written and verbal communication. You can explain the business, make a compelling investment case, and give teams specific direction.
  • Outstanding written and verbal communication skills, including proposals and presentations.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, rapidly growing company and handle a wide variety of challenges, deadlines, and a diverse array of contacts.
  • Regular or periodic travel to meet and engage with Toptal clients and customers both inside and outside of your geographic location.
  • You must be a world-class individual contributor to thrive at Toptal. You will not be here just to tell other people what to do.

jobs.description:
Production engineering is a field that involves crafting, building, and maintaining large-scale production systems with high efficiency and availability. It encompasses various areas, including software and systems engineering practices, storage, data management, and services. Professionals in the role of Production Engineers hold specialized knowledge and expertise across various domains, including storage architecture, high-performance distributed storage, data management, systems, networking, coding, database management, prioritization, continuous delivery and deployment, along with open-source cloud-enabling technologies such as Kubernetes, containers, and virtualization. Their responsibilities include ensuring storage architectures are reliable, scalable, and efficient. They optimize data placement and access patterns. They manage large-scale distributed storage systems and ensure low-latency data access for HPC and AI/ML workloads.

Storage Production Engineers at NVIDIA ensure that our internal and external-facing GPU cloud services meet reliability and uptime goals as promised to the users while enabling developers to make changes to the existing system through careful preparation and planning while keeping an eye on capacity, latency, and performance. This role also requires a mindset focused on automating storage operations, improving data access efficiency, and optimizing storage performance. Much of our software development focuses on optimizing operations through automation, enhancing system responsiveness, and improving the efficiency of storage and production systems. Since Production Engineers are responsible for the big picture of how our systems interface with each other, we use a breadth of tools and approaches to tackle a broad spectrum of challenges. Practices such as proactive storage performance monitoring, automated fault detection and remediation, scalable data redundancy methods, and integration of intelligent caching mechanisms factor into iterative improvements that are key to system reliability and efficiency.

What You Will Be Doing:

  • Design, implement, and support large-scale storage clusters, ensuring scalability, high availability, and data integrity.

  • Develop and maintain storage monitoring, logging, and alerting systems to ensure proactive detection and resolution of performance issues.

  • Work with AI/ML workloads to improve storage architectures for low-latency access, efficient caching, and high-throughput performance.

  • Improve the lifecycle of storage services – from inception and design to deployment, operation, and continuous optimization. Support storage services before they become available through activities such as system build consulting, developing automation frameworks, capacity management, and launch reviews.

  • Maintain production storage infrastructure by supervising availability, latency, and system health, leveraging predictive analytics and AI-driven automation.

  • Optimize storage efficiency through compression, deduplication, tiering strategies, and intelligent workload placement.

  • Scale storage systems sustainably using AI/ML-driven automation, policy-based tiering, and dynamic data migration techniques. Ensure data security and compliance by implementing encryption, access controls, and auditing mechanisms for storage systems.

  • Practice sustainable incident response and blameless root cause analysis. Be part of an on-call rotation to support storage and production systems.

What We Need To See:

  • BS degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Storage Systems, or a related technical field with 8+ years of practical experience.

  • Experience with distributed and high-performance storage solutions, including clustered and parallel file systems, distributed object storage, and enterprise-grade storage systems.

  • Solid understanding of block, file, and object storage technologies, including their scalability, reliability, and performance characteristics and standard processes.

  • Experience with storage networking protocols such as NFS, SMB, iSCSI, S3, Fibre Channel, RDMA, and NVMe over Fabrics.

  • Expertise in algorithms, data structures, complexity analysis, software design, and automating maintenance of large-scale Linux-based storage systems.

  • Experience in one or more of the following: C/C++, Java, Python, Go, NodeJS, and Bash for storage automation, monitoring, and performance tuning.

  • Hands-on experience with infrastructure configuration management tools like Ansible, Chef, Puppet, and Terraform for automating storage deployments. Experience with observability and tracing tools like InfluxDB, Prometheus, Grafana, and the Elastic stack for monitoring storage system health.

  • You should possess excellent written and oral communication skills, excellent work ethics, a deep sense of teamwork, love to produce quality work and commitment to finishing your tasks every single day.

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

  • Deep understanding of extensive distributed storage systems, replication strategies, and erasure coding techniques. Experience in capacity planning, performance tuning, and troubleshooting high-throughput storage systems.

  • Experience with Git, code review, pipelines, and CI/CD for handling infrastructure as code. Experience in analyzing and improving distributed storage system performance at scale. Strong debugging skills with a systematic problem-solving approach to identify sophisticated storage issues. Proven understanding of network protocols, architectures, and troubleshooting techniques, especially as it relates to storage performance, stability, and availability.

  • Experience using or operating private and public cloud storage solutions based on Kubernetes, OpenStack, or hybrid cloud architectures. Ability to design and implement automated storage migration, backup, and disaster recovery strategies. Thrive in collaborative environments and enjoy working with various teams to optimize storage performance. Flexible in adapting to different working styles and emerging storage technologies.

jobs.excerpt: About the Role We are looking for detail-oriented annotators to help label robot manipulation videos for AI training purposes.
jobs.description:
About the Role

We are looking for detail-oriented annotators to help label robot manipulation videos for AI training purposes. You'll watch short videos of robots performing manipulation tasks (filmed from three synchronized camera angles) and produce precise, structured, natural-language descriptions of the actions taking place. This work directly supports the development of robotics AI models and requires strong written English, sharp observational skills, and the discipline to follow a detailed style guide consistently.

Project Details:

  • Job Title: Project Cursa - Robot Manipulation Video Annotator
  • Location: Remote in India/Philippines/Egypt/Mexico
  • Employment type: Freelance
  • Pay Rate: US$3.5/hour

What You'll Do

1. Watch short robot manipulation videos, each filmed from three synchronized camera views (an overhead view and views from each of the robot's two wrist-mounted cameras).

2. Break each video into time segments and write clear, natural-language descriptions for each segment.

3. Apply labels at three levels of detail for each applicable segment:

- Atomic motion (a few seconds) — a single small movement (e.g., "close fingers around the red handle")

- Skill / subtask (several seconds to ~20 seconds) — a complete, meaningful action (e.g., "pick up the red block by its edge")

- Task / goal (up to ~1 minute) — the overall purpose of a sequence of skills (e.g., "place all blocks in the container")

4. Ensure every moment of video is covered by a label at two or more of these levels — no gaps, including idle or pause moments.

5. Accurately describe exactly what happens, including when something doesn't go as planned (a dropped object, a failed grasp, a slipped grip). Precision matters more than making the robot look successful.

6. Cross-reference all three camera angles: use the overhead view to understand the overall scene and object identity, and the close-up wrist views to confirm exact contact and grasp details.

7. Follow a detailed style guide covering vocabulary for actions, spatial relationships, object descriptions, and manner of movement, applying it consistently across many episodes.

8. Participate in periodic calibration sessions to align your labeling with the team and the client's reference examples.

What We're Looking For

Required:

1. Strong written English — you'll write dozens of short, precise descriptive sentences per video and need to vary your language rather than repeating the same phrases.

2. Sharp attention to detail — able to distinguish small differences (a successful grasp vs. a fumble, a push vs. a drag, which specific object part is being touched).
