  • Architecture & Design: 5+ years of hands-on experience designing, implementing, or consulting on complex cloud applications and infrastructure architectures.
  • Automotive Data Infrastructure: Working knowledge of real-time and batch data processing at scale, using technologies like MQTT, Apache Kafka, Kubernetes, time-series databases, and data analytics tools applied to connected vehicles.

  • Cross-Domain Integration: Hands-on experience integrating cloud-native SDV architectures with legacy OEM software and enterprise enterprise backends (PLM, MES, SAP).

  • Global OEM Exposure: Familiarity navigating complex multi-region technical requirements and delivery models across India, EU, and Japan markets.

  • A dynamic work environment with a flat hierarchy and the opportunity for rapid career advancement.
  • Access to continuous learning and development opportunities.
  • Flexible working hours to accommodate different time zones.
  • Comprehensive benefits package including health insurance and wellness programs.

jobs.description:
*Role is eligible to be remote*

We are Lennar

Lennar is one of the nation's leading homebuilders, dedicated to making an impact and creating an extraordinary experience for their Homeowners, Communities, and Associates by building quality homes and providing exceptional customer service, giving back to the communities in which we work and live in, and fostering a culture of opportunity and growth for our Associates throughout their career. Lennar has been recognized as a Fortune 500® company and consistently ranked among the top homebuilders in the United States.

Summary of Position:

The Mortgage Paralegal supports the Legal and Compliance teams by coordinating litigation and regulatory matters in a highly regulated financial services environment. Responsibilities include managing subpoena/civil investigative demand intake and response workflows, organizing and producing documents (including redactions), tracking deadlines and regulatory/production requests, and maintaining matters in case management and document management systems. The Paralegal assists with consumer complaint and contested matter correspondence, conducts legal and factual research using statutes, agency guidance, and related sources, and helps prepare draft filings, memoranda, and internal reports. This role also supports contract lifecycle management, legal e-billing administration, and legal inbox management. The Paralegal works closely with the Chief Legal and Risk Officer and partners with internal stakeholders and outside counsel as needed in a remote setting.

This position requires deep paralegal experience, strong knowledge of mortgage industry practices, and the ability to manage high-volume, time-sensitive matters in a regulated environment, with ability to adapt quickly and incorporate technology where appropriate.

Principal Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Review pleadings and related filings (e.g., summons, complaints, affidavits, answers, motions, orders, and judgments).

  • Coordinate intake, logging, and timely responses to subpoenas, garnishments, and other legal requests in partnership with internal stakeholders and outside counsel.

  • Support audits, regulatory exams, and internal reviews by compiling documentation and responding to information requests.

  • Liaise with outside counsel to coordinate matter intake, status updates, and documentation requests, and to facilitate communication among Legal, Compliance, and business teams.

  • Maintain matters in case management systems by analyzing complaints and claims, conducting fact-gathering and legal research (e.g., statutes, agency guidance, seller guides, judicial decisions), and synthesizing findings to support filings, correspondence, memoranda, and internal reports.

  • Maintain matter databases and electronic files by organizing and tracking case documents in accordance with retention policies.

  • Support settlement administration by gathering and organizing settlement data, preparing approval requests, requesting payments, reviewing agreements and releases, and coordinating signature routing.

  • Manage consumer complaint and contested matter correspondence by performing intake and logging, supporting investigations, drafting responses (e.g., CFPB, BBB, direct), and producing trend, risk, and management reports.

  • Support contract lifecycle management by coordinating intake, tracking, execution, and storage; preparing summaries, issue spotting, and redlines under attorney supervision; and maintaining templates, repositories, and version control.

  • Administer legal e-billing (e.g., Legal Tracker/Serengeti) by reviewing and coding invoices, tracking accruals, ensuring compliance with outside counsel guidelines, resolving discrepancies with firms, and monitoring legal spend and budgets.

  • Manage shared Legal inboxes and intake channels by routing inquiries, responding to routine requests, and escalating high-risk or sensitive matters.

  • Update policies, procedures, and internal documentation in coordination with Legal and Compliance leadership.

  • Handle routine legal issues under the direction of internal counsel.

  • Provide administrative support as needed, including proofreading drafts, obtaining execution signatures, and distributing fully executed documents to internal teams and outside counsel.

  • Contribute to ongoing and special legal projects and perform other responsibilities as assigned.

Education and Experience Requirements:

  • A minimum of 10 years of relevant experience as a Paralegal required, preferably in the financial services industry or a firm that provides services to companies in the financial services industry.

  • Paralegal Associate Degree, Bachelor’s Degree, and/or Paralegal Certification strongly preferred.

  • Demonstrated experience supporting in-house legal teams or law firms.

  • Familiarity with corporate governance and risk management oversight preferred.

  • Previous experience as contract administrator preferred.

Physical Requirements:

This is primarily a sedentary office position which requires the Mortgage Paralegal to have the ability to operate computer equipment, speak, hear, bend, stoop, reach, lift, and move and carry up to 25 lbs. Finger dexterity is necessary. Primarily remote; prolonged periods of sitting and computer use are expected.

Additional Requirements:

  • Ability to support contract, vendor, and policy management activities.
  • Ability to use Microsoft applications (Word, Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint, Teams) and Adobe Acrobat (PDFs); proficiency in AI tools preferred.
  • Ability to work with or learn NMLS-related processes and requirements.
  • Ability to work with or learn loan origination systems (e.g., Encompass).
  • Ability to apply knowledge of mortgage regulatory frameworks (e.g., RESPA, TILA, ECOA, CFPB requirements).
  • Ability to use Legal Tracker (Serengeti) or similar legal e-billing platforms.
  • Ability to recognize and support legal and regulatory compliance needs in the financial services industry.
  • Ability to communicate clearly in writing and verbally, including editing/proofreading with strong grammar and spelling.
  • Ability to organize, manage time, and multitask with strong attention to detail.
  • Ability to take initiative, resolve inquiries independently, and exercise sound judgment.
  • Ability to remain poised and effective in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment, including under stressful situations.
  • Ability to handle highly confidential information with discretion.
  • Ability to maintain a strong professional presence, including maturity and self-confidence.
  • Ability to prepare and format legal documents.
  • Ability to interact professionally with strong interpersonal skills and appropriate business demeanor.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with co-workers, supervisors, and management.
  • Ability to understand and follow posted work rules and procedures.

Travel Requirements:

Minimal travel required, if any, as needed for training or departmental needs.

A Gartner Analyst possesses a keen eye for identifying gaps, problems and solutions within the market they serve. They use their knowledge to help clients make better decisions, solve complex issues and execute new practices that propel clients’ businesses toward key objectives and publish these pragmatic and/or provocative insights. Career experience with the development and deployment of AI projects within the finance function will be essential. In particular, experience with a wide range of AI techniques beyond GenAI will be valuable.As will deep familiarity with specific finance processes – including forecasting, planning, budgeting, record to report, and transactional finance (such as accounts payable or accounts receivable) – and collaboration with leaders in other corporate functions such as IT, Data, Legal, HR, etc.

  • Career exposure to major finance processes and workflows, data sources and technologies.

  • Exposure to data science, quantitative analytics, statistics, probabilistic decision-making and coding languages (preferably Python) via on-the-job experience or formalized education (backgrounds in math, statistics and physics a plus).

jobs.description:
Job Description

Role Summary

The VP, Digital Experience owns Momentive's digital acquisition and web presence as one function: paid digital marketing, website strategy and development, technical SEO and AI-search visibility, and conversion rate optimization.


What You'll Do

  • Own the strategy, roadmap, and budget across paid digital marketing, website experience, technical SEO/AI-search visibility, and CRO as one unified plan.
  • Set the technical foundation and priorities for the website: performance, structured data, accessibility, and platform architecture.
  • Lead the shift from search-only optimization to combined search and AI-answer-engine visibility, coordinating with the Marcomms and Integrated Marketing teams on citation-building and digital PR.
  • Own conversion rate optimization: the testing roadmap, experimentation cadence, and reporting on improving pipeline.
  • Partner with the Director of Integrated Marketing, Director of Marcomms, and Creative Director to keep the digital roadmap aligned with brand and campaign calendars.
  • Manage vendor and agency relationships across paid media, GEO, SEO, web development, and analytics tooling.
  • Report on digital performance to the SVP and executive leadership team, connecting site and channel metrics to pipeline and revenue.
  • Own the combined budget for paid digital, web, and optimization work, including build-vs-buy and in-house-vs-agency decisions.

What Success Looks Like in the First 90 Days

  • One-on-ones completed with every member of the paid digital and web/CRO teams, with a clear read on team structure and org design.
  • A single digital roadmap that reconciles paid, SEO, and web-dev priorities
  • A written 2-quarter plan presented to the SVP covering team structure, site technical priorities, and how digital performance will be measured going forward.

What We're Looking For

  • 10+ years in digital marketing, web strategy, or a related field, including 5+ years managing directors or senior managers.
  • Experience owning both paid and organic/web-side digital work, or a strong enough grasp of both to manage leaders in each credibly.
  • A record in technical SEO, site performance, and conversion rate optimization at the strategy level.
  • Working familiarity with generative engine optimization (GEO) or answer engine optimization (AEO) practices.
  • Comfort managing a combined budget across multiple channels and vendors.
  • Experience partnering with brand, creative, and communications leaders, not just performance-marketing peers.
  • Direct, clear communication with an SVP and executive team

Nice to Have

  • Experience in B2B SaaS, nonprofit technology, or association management software.
  • Experience hiring or rebuilding teams from a smaller or destabilized starting point.
  • Experience with Claude Co-work, Claude Code and creation of agentic workers to support tasks and development.

About Us

Momentive Software amplifies the impact of over 20,000 purpose-driven organizations in over 30 countries, with over $11 billion raised and 55 million members served to date. jobs.description:
Job Description

Position Overview

Reporting to the SVP, Software Engineering and AI Operations, the Director of AI Governance & Enterprise Solutions is Momentive's senior AI subject matter expert — the person who sets the technical bar for how the company designs, builds, deploys, and governs AI agents. This role owns the Momentive Context Library, defines and enforces the standards that all AI agents must meet, leads the review and approval of agents across the portfolio, and directly builds agents and skills for the AI Operations Hub. When business units need to build AI solutions, this leader will be a strategic technical partner.

Core Responsibilities

Context Library Ownership

  • Own the Momentive Context Library — the shared knowledge repository that AI agents across the company depend on for accurate, consistent, organization-specific context.
  • Define the library's architecture, taxonomy, and content standards, ensuring it is well-organized, current, and designed to be consumed reliably by agents across different use cases.
  • Define and maintain the standards for centrally-owned content — shared company knowledge, cross-functional reference material, and foundational context that spans business units — ensuring it remains accurate, current, and consistently structured.
  • Partner with AI Operations Hub spoke leads to help them build, structure, and maintain department-owned content — including converting existing documentation and institutional knowledge into library-ready context.

Agent Review & Standards

  • Define the technical review criteria and quality standards that all AI agents, skills, and connectors must meet for AI Operations Hub approval — covering design, architecture, data handling, accuracy, safety, and operational readiness.
  • Lead the technical review and approval process for all AI agents submitted through the AI Operations Hub intake process, making or formally endorsing go/no-go recommendations.
  • Develop agent development guidelines, design patterns, and templates that translate AI Operations Hub standards into practical, reusable building blocks for spoke teams.
  • Identify systemic quality issues, common failure modes, and emerging risks across the agent portfolio, and use those insights to continuously raise the technical bar.

Building for AI Operations

  • Directly design and build AI agents, skills, and connectors for the AI Operations team's own use — including tooling that supports AI Operations Hub functions like intake review, registry management, and performance monitoring.
  • Prototype and evaluate new agent architectures, orchestration frameworks, and tooling approaches before recommending them for broader organizational use.

Technical Consulting & Deployment Guidance

  • Serve as the primary technical advisor to spoke teams as they design and build AI solutions — providing hands-on architecture guidance, reviewing approach before build begins, and troubleshooting when things go wrong.
  • Own the AI Operations Hub's standards for how agents are deployed, monitored, and secured in production — including environment configuration, observability requirements, access controls, and incident response protocols.
  • Partner with Corporate IT on the platform and infrastructure decisions that affect how agents are deployed and maintained across the organization.
  • Assess and recommend AI platforms, tools, and vendor solutions as the technology landscape evolves, with a focus on what will actually serve Momentive's operational model.
  • Partner on how AI agents and automation intersect with the enterprise application portfolio — aligning platform strategy, tooling investments, and governance standards across both functions.

Enablement

  • Develop technical reference materials, design pattern libraries, and decision guides that help spoke teams make better architectural choices independently.
  • Deliver targeted technical training and workshops when spoke teams need to build a foundational capability — this is a supporting function, not a primary one.
  • Actively connect spoke teams to each other — surfacing shared use cases, reusable patterns, and prior work across business units so teams build on each other's progress instead of solving the same problems independently.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.
  • 7+ years of hands-on experience designing and building software or AI systems, with at least 3 years working directly with large language models, AI agents, and production AI deployments.
  • Deep practical expertise with AI agent architectures, LLM APIs, orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, AutoGen, or similar), and the tradeoffs between them.
  • Expert-level knowledge of prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), tool use and function calling, context window management, and agent evaluation methodologies.
  • Demonstrated experience building and deploying AI agents in production environments — including decisions around deployment architecture, observability, access controls, and failure handling.
  • Experience designing or governing shared knowledge repositories, context management systems, or information architectures for AI systems.
  • Strong instincts for AI risk — understanding where agents fail, how to test for it, and how to build systems that degrade gracefully.
  • Experience with enterprise AI platforms such as Claude Enterprise, Azure OpenAI Service, Google Vertex AI, or similar.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills — able to make complex technical positions clear and defensible to both engineering and non-technical leadership audiences.
  • Familiarity with AI governance frameworks (NIST AI RMF or similar) and responsible AI principles as they apply to production systems.
  • Experience operating in a cross-functional environment where you set standards others must follow, not just your own team.
  • Demonstrated growth mindset and commitment to staying ahead in a rapidly evolving field.

What Success Looks Like

  • Every AI agent that reaches production has been reviewed against a clear, defensible technical standard — and the review process makes agents better, not just slower.
  • The Momentive Context Library is the most trusted source of organizational knowledge available to AI agents — current, well-structured, and actively relied upon by spoke teams.
  • AI Operations' own agents are high-quality, well-maintained, and set the standard that spoke teams aspire to.
  • Spoke teams leave technical consultations with a clearer path forward and better architectural decisions than they would have made on their own.
  • Production agents are deployed consistently, monitored reliably, and secured according to a clear, documented standard.
  • The AI Operation’s Hub technical bar is high and rising — and the organization's AI portfolio reflects it.
  • New capabilities are evaluated and piloted by the AI Operations Hub before spoke teams start asking for them.

Work with our most strategic law firm accounts on what a great pilot looks like: the outcomes they want to achieve, the practice areas to focus on, and the specific legal tasks that will demonstrate real, scalable value.   • Drive thought leadership. Stay at the forefront of AI trends and legal technology innovation. Speak with authority on legal tech, representing Clio as a credible voice in the evolving landscape of legal AI.

What you bring

  • A Juris Doctor (JD) or equivalent legal degree

  • 2+ years of legal practice experience at a US mid-sized law firm. You have a first-hand understanding of firm economics, document lifecycles, and client communication nuances.

  • Comfort working in a fast-paced, high-growth environment where priorities shift and creativity is valued.

  • A passion for legal tech and how it is transforming the legal services industry

Enterprise Account Director- Bay Area

Remote [within the US]

ABOUT THE ROLE:

We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Enterprise Account Director to join our dynamic team. As a pivotal member of our sales force, you will be responsible for driving revenue growth through strategic sales initiatives focused on our security for AI products and services. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams including marketing, product development, and customer success to ensure the delivery of comprehensive solutions that meet and exceed customer expectations.

WHO WE ARE:

HiddenLayer protects the world’s most valuable technologies from adversarial AI attacks. We were founded by AI professionals and security specialists with first-hand experience of how insidious adversarial AI attacks can be to detect and defend against. Determined to prove that these attacks were preventable, the team developed a unique, patent-pending, productized solution to support organizations in accelerating their adoption of AI securely.

Our dedication to innovation has been recognized by prestigious awards such as RSA's Innovation Sandbox Winner, CB Insights AI 100, CyberTech 100, and SC's Most Promising Early-Stage Start-up.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

  • Develop and execute a strategic sales plan to achieve sales targets and expand the customer base within the security for AI market segment.
  • Build strong, long-lasting relationships with key stakeholders, including C-level executives and decision-makers, to understand their business needs and position our solutions effectively.
  • Lead complex negotiations and contract discussions, ensuring favorable terms that align with company objectives and customer requirements.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to develop customized proposals, presentations, and demonstrations that showcase the value proposition of our security for AI solutions.
  • Track and report on sales performance metrics, forecasting accuracy, and pipeline management using CRM tools to drive informed business decisions.
  • Represent HiddenLayer at industry events, conferences, and seminars to promote our brand and establish thought leadership in the security for AI space.

WHO YOU ARE:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Computer Science, or a related field; MBA preferred.
  • Proven track record of success in enterprise sales within the cybersecurity or AI technology industry, with a minimum of 7 years of experience.
  • Deep understanding of AI security concepts, including machine learning, threat detection, anomaly detection, and data protection.
  • Strong business acumen and strategic thinking skills, with the ability to translate complex technical solutions into tangible business benefits for customers.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and negotiation skills, with the ability to influence and persuade at all levels of an organization.
  • Self-motivated and results-oriented, with a demonstrated ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment.
  • Experience with CRM software (e.g., Salesforce) and proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite.

WHY HIDDENLAYER?

We’re moving at (what feels like) the speed of light. HiddenLayer is a venture-backed company and recently closed a $50M funding round led by M12, Microsoft’s Venture Fund, and Moore Strategic Ventures.

Attracting and retaining the very best people is our #1 priority. That’s why we offer our team best-in-class benefits, including:

  • Fully Remote: We are a completely remote global team. Though we’re distributed, we are intentional about getting the team together a couple of times a year. We offer a generous stipend for your home office setup, annual upgrades to ensure you have a comfortable workspace and a monthly stipend for internet/phone expenses.
  • Comprehensive Health & Wellness Benefits: Better than your average startup healthcare benefits. With five options to choose from, of which are fully subsidized by HiddenLayer, we offer a variety of options to fit each person’s needs. We also offer vision, dental, and 401k offerings.
  • Flexible Time Off: Enjoy unlimited and flexible time off for all salaried employees, in addition to 15 paid company holidays.
  • Commitment to Learning and Development: We support personal growth and education through a dedicated L&D fund that can be used for training, conferences, certifications and industry events.
  • Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion: We are committed to building a diverse team with individuals from various backgrounds, experiences, abilities, and perspectives, and we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

To learn more about HiddenLayer visitHiddenLayer and follow us on LinkedIn or Twitter.

HiddenLayer is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, race, color, religion, national origin, age, marital status, political affiliation, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, disability or protected veteran status. We are committed to providing a workplace free of any discrimination or harassment.

jobs.description:
About AlphaSense:

The world’s most sophisticated companies rely on AlphaSense to remove uncertainty from decision-making. With market intelligence and search built on proven AI, AlphaSense delivers insights that matter from content you can trust. Our universe of public and private content includes equity research, company filings, event transcripts, expert calls, news, trade journals, and clients’ own research content.

The acquisition of Tegus by AlphaSense in 2024 advances our shared mission to empower professionals to make smarter decisions through AI-driven market intelligence. Together, AlphaSense and Tegus will accelerate growth, innovation, and content expansion, with complementary product and content capabilities that enable users to unearth even more comprehensive insights from thousands of content sets. Our platform is trusted by over 6,000 enterprise customers, including a majority of the S&P 500. Founded in 2011, AlphaSense is headquartered in New York City with more than 2,000 employees across the globe and offices in the U.S., U.K., Finland, India, Singapore, Canada, and Ireland. Come join us!

About the Team:

Our diverse Product & Engineering team values innovation, collaboration, and the continuous improvement of our platform. We offer a dynamic work environment where employees can grow and thrive while working on cutting-edge technology that shapes the future of AI and search.

At AlphaSense, we believe that diverse experiences and perspectives are critical to our success. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where all employees feel valued and empowered to be their authentic selves.

About the Role:

We are seeking a Staff Software Engineer to lead the design, evolution, and reliability of our global financial data extraction and normalization platform. This system ingests filings across formats (HTML, PDF, APIs, spreadsheets), extracts and standardizes financial data using a combination of AI and deterministic systems, and delivers trusted, traceable outputs at scale to downstream financial services teams and customers.

This role owns the self-sourcing and extraction foundation used by multiple teams across the organization. Today, human validation is used as a safety net. Your mission is to systematically reduce human dependency by increasing system correctness, confidence, and trust, without sacrificing speed or scalability.

You will operate at the intersection of distributed systems, AI-driven extraction, data quality, and platform architecture, raising the technical bar and reshaping how we build reliable systems.

Who You Are:

  • 10+ years of experience building and operating large-scale production systems
  • Proven experience designing data ingestion, extraction, or processing systems at scale
  • Deep expertise in one or more of:
    • Distributed systems
    • Data platforms and pipelines
    • AI/ML-powered extraction or classification systems
    • Platform or infrastructure engineering
  • Demonstrated ability to design trustworthy systems that combine probabilistic (AI) and deterministic approaches
  • Strong understanding of system reliability, observability, failure modes, and iterative hardening
  • Experience reducing operational or human overhead through better system design
  • Track record of technical leadership across teams without formal people management
  • Comfortable operating in ambiguity and driving clarity where none exists
  • Passion for using AI responsibly and effectively to deliver scalable, high-confidence systems

Nice to Have

    • Experience with document understanding, NLP, or financial data extraction
    • Experience building provenance, lineage, or confidence-scoring systems
    • Familiarity with cloud-native architectures and modern data stacks
    • Experience shaping or owning internal platforms used by multiple teams

What You’ll Do:

  • Own the architecture and evolution of our large-scale data extraction and normalization platform
  • Design systems that process hundreds of thousands of records across heterogeneous sources (PDF, HTML, APIs, XLS) with high reliability
  • Define and implement strategies to minimize human-in-the-loop validation through AI-based validation, confidence scoring, provenance tracking, and deterministic safeguards
  • Establish clear system contracts for correctness, traceability, and confidence (e.g., “where did this number come from?”)
  • Balance AI-driven approaches with procedural and rules-based systems where they improve reliability and explainabilityIdentify and remediate architectural and operational bottlenecks impacting scale, accuracy, and developer velocity
  • Act as the technical authority to block poor designs, redesign critical systems, and introduce new platforms or tooling when necessary
  • Partner with product and downstream consumers to define quality bars, SLAs, and success metrics
  • Serve as a technical escalation point for production issues, reliability failures, and systemic risks
  • Mentor senior engineers, shape technical culture, and raise expectations for system design and execution
  • Contribute to long-term technical strategy while remaining hands-on with critical implementations

For base compensation, we set standard ranges for all roles based on function and level benchmarked against similar stage growth companies and internal comparables. In order to be compliant with local legislation, as well as to provide greater transparency to candidates, we share salary ranges on all job postings regardless of desired hiring location. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including candidate experience/expertise and may vary from the amounts listed below.

You may also be offered equity, and a generous benefits program.

Compensation Range
$176,000—$242,000 USD

AlphaSense does not discriminate against any employee or applicant on the basis of race, color, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, age, religion, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, military or veteran status, disability, or any other non-merit factor. This policy applies to every aspect of employment at AlphaSense, including recruitment, hiring, training, advancement, and termination.

In addition, it is the policy of AlphaSense to provide reasonable accommodation to qualified employees who have protected disabilities to the extent required by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances where a particular employee works.

Recruiting Scams and Fraud

We at AlphaSense have been made aware of fraudulent job postings and individuals impersonating AlphaSense recruiters. These scams may involve fake job offers, requests for sensitive personal information, or demands for payment. Please note:

  • AlphaSense never asks candidates to pay for job applications, equipment, or training.
  • All official communications will come from an @ email address.
  • If you’re unsure about a job posting or recruiter, verify it on our Careers page.

If you believe you’ve been targeted by a scam or have any doubts regarding the authenticity of any job listing purportedly from or on behalf of AlphaSense please contact us. Your security and trust matter to us.

jobs.description:
About Blackbird Health

Blackbird Health is clinician-founded, owned, and operated by dedicated professionals. We believe that providing the best care for children starts with building the best possible team. We deliver virtual and in-person mental health services across Pennsylvania, Virginia, and New Jersey—and we’re growing into new markets in 2026.

At Blackbird, we take a whole-child approach, looking at how the brain, body, and behavior interact to address the root causes of challenges, not just the symptoms. Every role matters here, and you’ll join a collaborative, supportive, and innovative team that’s shaping the future of pediatric mental health care. If you’re passionate about helping children and families while growing your career, Blackbird is the place to make an impact.

Join us and help change mental health care for children for the better!

Position Summary

Blackbird Health is seeking independently licensed therapists to support our patients during the Fall and Winter. This flexible seasonal opportunity is designed to meet increased patient demand, with a focus on after-school, evening, and weekend virtual therapy availability.

As a Fall and Winter Therapist, you will provide evidence-based telehealth therapy services to children, adolescents, and young adults while working collaboratively within an interdisciplinary pediatric behavioral health team.

This role is ideal for clinicians seeking:

  • Supplemental Fall and Winter income
  • Flexible remote work
  • Evening and weekend hours
  • An opportunity to transition into an ongoing 1099, part-time, or full-time role with Blackbird Health

Fully remote opportunities are available, with optional hybrid and in-person opportunities for clinicians interested in onsite care.

What Makes You, You

Mission-Driven

You are passionate about transforming behavioral health for youth and committed to delivering high-quality, compassionate care.

Clinically Excellent

You bring experience using evidence-based therapeutic approaches with children, adolescents, young adults, and families.

Relationship-Focused

You excel at building meaningful therapeutic relationships and creating safe, engaging environments for patients and caregivers.

Developmentally & Neurodiversity-Informed

You are skilled in supporting patients across developmental stages and neurodiverse presentations.

Collaborative

You thrive in team-based environments and value interdisciplinary partnership, consultation, and shared problem-solving.

Tech-Savvy

You are comfortable utilizing telehealth platforms, EMR systems, Google Workspace, and other virtual communication tools.

Flexible & Patient-Centered

You are available to support patients during evening and weekend hours when families need care most.

How You'll Make an Impact

Deliver High-Quality Therapy

  • Provide individual telehealth therapy sessions for youth ages 2–26.
  • Utilize evidence-based therapeutic approaches tailored to each patient's unique needs.

Support Family Engagement

  • Partner with families and caregivers to improve understanding, treatment engagement, and long-term outcomes.

Drive Clinical Outcomes

  • Monitor patient progress toward established goals.
  • Adjust treatment plans as clinically appropriate to support continued growth and success.

Collaborate Across Teams

  • Work closely with psychiatrists, therapists, intake providers, and administrative teams to deliver coordinated, patient-centered care.

Maintain Clinical Excellence

  • Complete timely, accurate documentation.
  • Maintain high-quality clinical records and ongoing communication with patients and families.

Qualifications

Required

  • Active, unrestricted license in at least one U.S. state as one of the following:
    • LPC
    • LCSW
    • LMFT
    • PsyD or PhD
    • LSW
    • LMSW
  • Minimum of 1 year of experience working with children and adolescents
  • Reliable phone, computer, and high-speed internet connection
  • Availability for a minimum of 8 hours per week during core service hours:
    • Monday–Friday after 3:00 PM ET
    • Weekends between 8:00 AM and 7:00 PM ET

Preferred

  • Minimum of 1 year of telehealth or virtual care experience

Why Blackbird Health

  • Immediate referral opportunities
  • Flexible scheduling
  • Fully remote work options
  • Optional hybrid and in-person opportunities in select markets
  • Weekly paid clinical consultation
  • Full credentialing support
  • Administrative support so you can focus on patient care
  • Professional liability insurance coverage
  • No-show and late-cancellation reimbursement
  • Collaborative and supportive clinical culture

Compensation

$70–$100 per hour, depending on licensure, experience, and market.

Potential for Ongoing Employment

Providers participating in the Fall and Winter Core Hours Program may be considered for ongoing part-time, full-time, or 1099 opportunities with Blackbird Health following the summer program. Consideration will be based on performance, scheduling availability, organizational needs, and business demand.

Salary Range
$70—$100 USD

Join us!

To raise the standard of pediatric mental health care through accurate understanding and precise treatment that reflect how each child’s brain, body, and behavior work together.

“It's so rare to find comprehensive care like this---from testing to therapy to med management (and more)--all in one place. In addition, the school advocacy support we receive is unprecedented. We no longer feel like we are managing things alone.”

Fostering an inclusive environment:

Blackbird is committed to cultivating and preserving a culture of inclusion and belonging. We are able to grow and learn better together with a diverse team of employees. In recruiting for our team, we welcome the unique contributions that you can bring in terms of your education, opinions, culture, ethnicity, race, sex, gender identity and expression, nation of origin, age, languages spoken, veteran status, color, religion, disability, sexual orientation and beliefs. Blackbird provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type. If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or interview process, please contact us at so we can support you.

Our patient support team is busy helping children and families, please do not call or email them about your application — this helps us process your application more efficiently.

Smule has been on a mission to bring the world together through music since 2008. Music is much more than listening… it's about creating, sharing, discovering, participating, and connecting with people. With dozens of millions of monthly active users creating over 20 million songs every day, Smule is connecting people all over the world through the joy of making music and transforming the music landscape from one of passive listening to collaborative creative expression and active engagement.

We are looking for a Research Scientist to join Smule's Foundational Research team. In this role you will pursue long-horizon research questions that advance the state of the art in sequence modeling, generative modeling, and representation learning, with a particular focus on architectures and methods relevant to audio and music. You will design and execute rigorous experiments, publish at top venues, and contribute novel ideas that shape the direction of Smule's research agenda. The ideal candidate is deeply curious, comfortable with open-ended exploration, and motivated by scientific contribution.

We strongly encourage candidates with non-traditional ML backgrounds to apply. If your path into machine learning research came through physics, mathematics, signal processing, music technology, neuroscience, or another field, we want to hear from you.

  • Publish findings at top-tier venues (NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, Interspeech, ISMIR, or equivalent) and contribute to the broader research community through open-source artifacts and talks.
  • Collaborate with applied research and engineering teams to translate foundational insights into practical improvements for Smule's products.
  • Stay current with the latest literature, synthesize relevant work, and identify high-leverage research directions for the team.
  • Mentor junior researchers and interns, fostering a culture of intellectual rigor and creative exploration.

What We're Looking For:

  • Degree (B.S., M.S., or Ph.D.) in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical discipline, or currently pursuing one.
  • Strong publication record at top ML/AI venues demonstrating original contributions.
  • Deep expertise in at least one core area: sequence modeling, generative models, optimization, probabilistic methods, or representation learning.
  • Proficiency in Python and modern deep learning frameworks (PyTorch preferred).
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; ability to present complex ideas clearly to diverse audiences.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently scope, execute, and communicate a research project from idea to publication.

Bonus Points For:

  • Experience with audio, speech, or music signal processing and modeling.
  • Familiarity with linear attention mechanisms, state-space models, or efficient transformer variants.
  • Experience with large-scale distributed training and high-performance computing.
  • Track record of successful cross-functional collaboration with engineering teams.

jobs.title: Director of Product, Risk & Response
jobs.excerpt: About usCoalition is the world's first Active Insurance provider designed to help prevent digital risk before it strikes.
jobs.description:
About us

Coalition is the world's first Active Insurance provider designed to help prevent digital risk before it strikes. Founded in 2017, Coalition combines comprehensive insurance coverage and innovative cybersecurity tools to help businesses manage and mitigate potential cyberattacks.

Opportunities to make an impact with bold thinking are real—and happening daily at Coalition.

About the role

This is a new role leading a new grouping of three areas that together form Coalition's risk lifecycle: Underwriting (how we select and price risk), Claims (how we close the loop and mitigate losses when something goes wrong), and Security (the Control and Wirespeed products that help policyholders reduce risk in the first place). Each of these has historically been run as its own domain. Your job is to be strategic about how these areas come closer together, recognizing that risk selection, loss mitigation, security telemetry, and claims outcomes are not separate problems but one continuous feedback loop.

This is a people-leadership role. You will manage a team of product managers across all three areas, help to steer the strategy that connects them, and be accountable for how the combined areas perform. You'll report into product leadership and partner closely with Engineering, Design, Data, Underwriting, Claims, Actuarial, Finance, Operations, and more.

Most of the value in Active Insurance comes from the connections between these functions, not the functions themselves. Security signals from Control and Wirespeed should sharpen how we underwrite. How a claim develops should feed back into how we price risk. The quality of underwriting should shape our loss exposure and therefore our claims load. Today these loops exist, but they aren't owned by anyone as a whole.

This role is deliberately the one seat that spans them. It is not a preview of how the rest of the company is organized, and we want to be explicit about that. Engineering leadership for each of these areas reports through the CTO in separate lines. Underwriting, Claims, and Security operate as genuinely different businesses with different economics, different stakeholders, and different rhythms, and we are not trying to merge them. What we are doing is deliberately creating a single product seat that sits across all three, because the connective work is real and currently unowned, and because product is the function best positioned to do it. That means the primary instrument of this role is influence, clarity, and a credible point of view rather than formal authority over the full stack. If that sounds like the interesting part of the job rather than the frustrating part, we should talk.

Why Security sits in a risk group. Control is our attack surface monitoring and login security product: we continuously monitor policyholders' external attack surface, watch their Google and Microsoft environments, and lock down accounts that look compromised. It's provided free to all 100,000+ policyholders, and it exists because reducing their exposure directly reduces our loss ratio. That makes it a risk lifecycle product, not a side business, and it is why it belongs alongside underwriting and claims. Wirespeed MDR is a different motion: a paid, growing revenue line sold both into our policyholder base and to companies who don't buy insurance from us at all. Both matter, and part of the judgment this role requires is holding those two very different mandates at the same time without letting either starve the other.

What You'll Own

  • Underwriting. The internal risk decisioning stack: underwriting models and the real-time systems that execute them, the underwriter workbench and tooling, automation and risk selection, scanning and data collection, and insurance product development. Actuarial builds the pricing models; this organization is accountable for the systems that put them into production correctly, ensuring the right customer data reaches the right model at the right moment, that changes are testable and auditable, and that pricing behaves in production the way it was designed to. This portfolio is about the quality, consistency, speed, and auditability of underwriting decisions through better software and model-driven workflows.
  • Claims. The claims operations engine: intake, adjudication, and enablement systems, workflow tools, automation, platform migrations, and ML-assisted insights. The center of gravity is operational excellence and reducing manual overhead so claims professionals can focus on judgment, empathy, and resolution strategy, while claims data feeds back into how we understand risk.
  • Security (Control & Wirespeed). Control as the connective layer between security telemetry, the policyholder experience, and underwriting workflows, including its growing role as an underwriting-facing platform (underwriting integrations, outbound ticketing, large-market and multi-tenant support). And Wirespeed's MDR/ADR capabilities, integrations, reporting, and competitiveness in a crowded market. The two remain distinct products with distinct goals: Control's job is adoption and measurable risk reduction across the insured base; Wirespeed's job is to win on product merit against dedicated MDR competitors.

What You'll Do

  • Ensure that our product strategy across underwriting, claims, and security is consistent and treats them as one risk lifecycle, and make the deliberate trade-offs about where to invest across the three.
  • Build and develop the product team beneath you, including hiring, coaching, and holding a group of PMs to a high standard across three distinct domains, each with its own stakeholders and technical depth.
  • Own the feedback loops between areas: ensure security telemetry informs underwriting, claims development informs pricing, and underwriting quality is measured against realized loss outcomes.
  • Own the product surface that makes security adoption possible and scalable: the in-product activation, onboarding, and value-demonstration motions that drive policyholders into Control, and the product-led growth capabilities that convert engaged Control users into paid Wirespeed customers. The commercial motion spans GTM and the broker channel, and you'll partner closely with both, but the product mechanics that make the funnel work are in your domain.
  • Partner with Data and Engineering to advance model-driven workflows, automated decisioning, and ML-assisted tooling responsibly while managing the operational and regulatory considerations that come with automated decisions in a regulated product.
  • Drive major platform evolution and systems migrations across the portfolio, in close partnership with your engineering counterparts.
  • Define success metrics that span the portfolio, not just each area in isolation, and use quantitative and qualitative data to prioritize and make trade-offs.
  • Represent these areas to executive leadership, brokers, and cross-functional partners, translating between deep technical work and business outcomes.
  • Use AI consistently in how you and your team work, and champion an AI-enabled approach to underwriting, claims, and security products.

Skills and Qualifications

  • 10+ years in product, with several years leading and developing product managers
  • A track record of owning a multi-domain or platform portfolio and setting strategy across areas that can have competing priorities, finding the connective tissue and making trade-offs across it.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead in technically deep, model-driven, or data-heavy product areas, and to partner effectively with Data and Engineering on automation and decisioning.
  • Strong people leadership: you hire well, coach deliberately, set clear expectations, and make hard calls on performance without delay.
  • Proven experience with major platform migrations or systems transformations of critical internal or enterprise systems.
  • Exceptional communication and influence skills, with a track record of driving alignment across diverse senior stakeholders without relying on formal authority.
  • Comfort with ambiguity and a build mindset. This is a role for someone who wants to define how these areas operate together, not maintain a settled structure.
  • Daily fluency with AI tools as part of product work, and a point of view on how AI reshapes underwriting, claims, and security over time.

Bonus Points

  • Experience with the business of insurance or other regulated financial products due to the underwriting, pricing, claims, policy administration, and compliance-heavy workflows.
  • Familiarity with cybersecurity products, MDR/EDR, security operations, or incident response.
  • Prior work shipping products built on predictive models, risk scores, or automated decisioning while managing operational and regulatory constraints.

Compensation

Our compensation reflects the cost of labor across several US geographic markets. The US base salary for this position ranges from $200,000/year in our lowest geographic market up to $260,000/year in our highest geographic market. Consistent with applicable laws, an employee's pay within this range is based on a number of factors, which include but are not limited to relevant education, skills, job-related knowledge, qualifications, work experience, credentials, and/or geographic location. Your recruiter can share more on target salary for your location during the interview process. Coalition, Inc. reserves the right to modify this range as needed.

Work at Coalition is centered on the joint mission to Protect the Unprotected. We have built a remote-first, highly inclusive culture that welcomes people from diverse backgrounds. We trust each other to take responsibility, share ownership of outcomes, and put in the work together to protect businesses from digital risk. Coalition’s exceptional growth stems from its ability to address real-world problems for organizations of all sizes while remaining true to our founding values of character, humility, responsibility, purpose, authenticity, and inclusion.

We have an exciting opportunity within US Medical Affairs (USMA) Oncology for a Director, Regional Community Oncology Expert (RCOE) – East, supporting Community Oncology strategy and the Community Cancer Collective (CCC) within Gilead. Reporting to the Senior Director, Community Oncology Strategy and Head of the CCC within the USMA Oncology team, the core efforts of this role are responsible for co-developing the Community Oncology strategy, leading CCC efforts in their territory, and supporting the cross-functional field matrix teams.

This role will be remote, but will require travel within their respective territory, to national and regional meetings, as well as headquarters travel for specific meetings as needed.

The key functions of this role will be to represent and consider the unique role of Community Oncology within the US healthcare system with both external and internal stakeholders, including USMA Strategic Evidence & Collaboration (SEC), US Market Access, USMA Patient Access & Quality of Care (PAQ), Medical Affairs Research (MAR), US Public Affairs, US Government Affairs, Clinical Development, Clinical Operations, Real-World Evidence (RWE), Scientific Communications / Publications, Commercial, Medical Governance, Legal, Compliance, and the field-based medical and commercial teams.

The territory for this role encompasses the eastern united states.

Job Responsibilities

Specific responsibilities for this role will include, but are not limited to:

  • Support the development (in collaboration with the CCC Lead) of strategies and implementation plans to define and address education, research, and Medical Affairs insights and data generation needs within US Community Oncology practices.

  • Prepare presentation materials and present scientific data at internal meetings and external advisory boards.

  • Co-create a RWE generation plan in conjunction with key US Community Oncology practices and initiate key RWE studies to support the use of Trodelvy in breast cancer with the potential to expand to other molecules, indications, and disease areas.

  • Provide medical and scientific leadership and support at key scientific meetings (including society engagement) with US HCPs and patients, with a focus on Community Oncology practices.

  • Serve as an educational resource and trainer to Gilead colleagues, including the US Medical Science Liaisons (MSLs) / Medical Key Account Liaisons (MKALs), including medical educational activities, grants, and investigator-sponsored/collaborative studies.

  • Collaborate with Medical Affairs Research (MAR), the Global Review Committee (GRC) / Local Review Committee (LRC) teams, and Clinical Research and Development (R&D) as needed.

  • Lead the delivery of timely, accurate, and succinct communication of fair-balanced clinical and scientific presentations to Community Oncology healthcare professionals, both proactively and in response to requests for information, consistent with promotional compliance and regulatory requirements.

  • Participate in the editorial review of all relevant scientific content to ensure strategic alignment and accuracy.

  • Support data generation activities through:

    • Critical review of global investigator-sponsored research (ISR) / collaborative, Ph3b, and Ph4 study proposals generated in the US Community Oncology practices.

    • Review abstracts and/or manuscripts that result from collaborative and RWE studies generated from Community Oncology practices.

    • Communicate Gilead’s commitment to scientific excellence through research and education in Community Oncology practices.

  • Collaborate effectively and in a compliant manner with colleagues in other functional areas within Gilead.

  • Support the development, deployment, and appropriate use of field tools and resources (e.g. slide decks) for the CCC.

  • Lead and shepherd oncology medical assets (i.e. field resources) through the Medical Review Committee (MRC) process, in consultation with cross-functional Medical Affairs team members.

At Workstreet, we’re on an exciting journey to help businesses scale securely by designing and implementing cutting-edge security and compliance programs. Get to know the GRC Engineering (GOV) Team

Our GRC engineering team guides defense contractors and federal organizations through their CMMC, NIST SP 800-171, NIST SP 800-53, FedRAMP, and Assessment & Authorization compliance efforts. We act as our clients' trusted guides and primary point of contact end-to-end, leading them through gap assessments, System Security Plans, POA&Ms, and C3PAO/3PAO coordination with clarity, composure, and a genuinely client-first mindset. The Opportunity

Workstreet is seeking a Sr. Engineer, GRC Engineering (Government) to serve as a high-touch, executive-level strategic partner for organizations navigating federal compliance frameworks. Built around client relationship excellence, this role centers on delivering an exceptional client experience, cultivating trusted advisor relationships, and maintaining account retention across high-stakes engagements. You will guide clients through complex federal certifications while directing a team of primary operators who manage day-to-day execution across CMMC, NIST SP 800-171, NIST SP 800-53, and FedRAMP 20x standards.

The successful candidate will integrate rapidly into the organization, assuming active portfolio ownership within their first 15 days. Rather than focusing solely on routine task execution, you will lead end-to-end strategic engagements, handle escalations with composure, and represent clients on executive calls to ensure every partner remains deeply engaged, highly satisfied, and aligned with Workstreet long-term during U.S. Eastern Time business hours.

What You'll Do

  • Lead federal certification advisory motions - guide clients through FedRAMP 20x, Assessment & Authorization (A&A), and federal compliance lifecycles with clear milestone direction.

  • Build machine-readable compliance artifacts - author and maintain Security Decision Records, Security Configuration Guides, and OSCAL/JSON/YAML artifacts conforming to RFC-0024 and OMB M-24-15 mandates.
  • Implement continuous monitoring tooling - connect CSPM and GRC platforms into agency pipelines under FedRAMP’s Collaborative Continuous Monitoring (CCM) model to replace point-in-time ConMon reporting.

  • Orchestrate third-party assessment activities - guide clients through 3PAO assessments, C3PAO audits, and independent assessor evaluations with speed and technical rigor.
  • Track evolving federal regulatory updates - monitor Consolidated Rules (CR26), Significant Change Notifications (SCNs), and the Rev5-to-20x transition timeline to maintain client compliance.

Who You Are

  • FedRAMP pathway authority - deeply familiar with FedRAMP 20x Program Certifications (Class A/B/C) and Rev5 Agency Certifications (Class D/High) to advise clients on strategy.
  • Government cloud security architect - hands-on execution experience across major cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), specifically within AWS GovCloud or Azure Government regions.
  • Compliance-as-code operator - working ability with scripting languages and policy-as-code tooling (Python, OPA/Rego, IaC) to build and inspect automated evidence pipelines.
  • Audit-side assessment veteran - practical experience working with or for a 3PAO, participating on security assessment teams, or conducting formal evidence adjudication.

What will help you succeed

  • Active federal security credentials - hold recognized certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CGRC, or Certified Authorization Professional (CAP).
  • Validated cloud architecture credentials - active technical certifications such as AWS Solutions Architect Associate, Azure Security Engineer, or GCP Associate Cloud Engineer.
  • Collaborative continuous monitoring experience - documented history managing FedRAMP certification activities and real-time Continuous Monitoring (CCM) workflows.
  • Hands-on OSCAL schema mastery - practical experience authoring or validating machine-readable SSPs, POA&Ms, or KSI evidence utilizing OSCAL, JSON, or YAML schemas.

What We Offer

What You'll Need to Thrive

Occasional flexibility to adjust working hours is expected to accommodate changing business priorities, global collaboration, and time-sensitive hiring needs.

Scope3 operates the Interchange for agent-to-agent advertising — the place where brands and their agents discover, negotiate, and transact across every advertising surface that matters: social, CTV, audio, AI interfaces, sponsored intelligence, and those still emerging. About the Role

We’re building the future of programmatic advertising through AI agents. Our technical team is creating the infrastructure that enables AI agents to discover, negotiate, and transact media inventory autonomously.

In this role, you’ll be a technical leader responsible for the APIs, protocols, and agent interfaces that power our agentic advertising platform. You’ll design systems where AI agents are first-class participants, with their own authentication, capabilities, and communication standards.

You’ll work at the intersection of advertising technology, distributed systems, and emerging AI agent frameworks—making architectural decisions that shape how our marketplace evolves.

This is a Fullstack (80/20 backend leaning), hands-on leadership role. You’ll write production code, prototype new agent communication patterns, review system designs, and mentor engineers while setting technical direction.

This isn’t a typical engineering role
  • We’re operating in a space without a fixed playbook, so this role is best suited for builders who are comfortable creating structure where none exists.
  • Our approach favors rapid experimentation over upfront perfection—we test, learn, and then formalize what works.
  • The pace is fast and often pushes beyond what feels comfortable. For the right person, that’s part of the appeal.
  • We’re also looking for engineers who are already actively exploring AI—this isn’t a “learn it on the job” environment.
Responsibilities:
  • Design and architect scalable APIs for both human and AI agent clients
  • Lead development of agent interfaces, MCP servers, and A2A communication layers
  • Build and operate high-throughput systems for real-time advertising transactions
  • Evaluate and integrate emerging agent frameworks and protocols
  • Partner with product and design to define clear, agent-friendly API contracts
  • Drive architectural decisions around authentication, protocols, and transaction flows
  • Collaborate with external DSPs, SSPs, and agent platform partners
  • Mentor engineers on API design, distributed systems, and agent architectures
  • Anticipate and address edge cases in autonomous agent behavior

Qualifications:
  • 8+ years building distributed backend systems at scale
  • 4+ years in a technical leadership role
  • 4+ years working professionally within the AdTech ecosystem
  • Strong expertise in API design and architecture (REST, event-driven systems, auth, versioning)
  • Experience with AI agent frameworks and communication protocols, or the ability to rapidly learn and evaluate them
  • Proficiency with TypeScript/Node.js, React, and cloud platforms (GCP or AWS)
  • Experience designing systems for autonomous or semi-autonomous decision-making
  • Track record of mentoring engineers and fostering a collaborative team culture
  • Comfort working in fast-moving, evolving environments
Tech Stack:
  • API Layer: TypeScript/Node.js, REST and event-driven services
  • Agent Interfaces: MCP servers and A2A protocol handlers
  • Data: PostgreSQL, BigQuery, Cloud Storage, Redis

As the agent ecosystem evolves, you’ll help evaluate new technologies and ensure our marketplace remains at the forefront.


Compensation:

The salary range for this role is $180k-$230k USD / $190k-$245k CAD.

These ranges span multiple location-based salary bands across the US and Canada. Candidates are aligned to a narrower range based on geographic market compensation data specific to where they live, and final offers reflect demonstrated skills, experience, and role expectations.

Ми виконуємо роль віддаленого бек-офісу для майстрів у США, що спеціалізуються на ремонтних роботах. Наша команда налічує понад 100 фахівцівта повністю бере на себе всі організаційні та операційні процеси, окрім самих ремонтних робіт. Серед них: маркетинг, продажі, управління командами майстрів, контроль якості, збір відгуків, навчання технічного персоналу тощо. Працюємо у 30+ найбільших містах США та вже успішно реалізували понад 30 000 ремонтних проєктів.

Детальніше про компанію ти можеш дізнатися за посиланням . Ти ознайомишся з нашою метою, критеріями, перевагами, а також відеовідгуками про роботу в Supplax від наших співробітників.

Наша команда постійно росте і зараз ми в пошуку менеджера по роботі з клієнтами.Ми добре розуміємося в продажах, маркетингу, а також технічних деталях нашої роботи. Ми створили ефективну систему введення на посади, що допомагає стажеру за кільки тижнів з повного нуля дійти до рівня впевненого спілкування з клієнтами.

Що ти отримаєш, ставши частиною Supplax:

  • Стабільний дохід $800-$1300 (ставка + бонуси)
  • Повну зайнятість із графіком 16:00 — 01:00, 8 — годинний робочий день, Сб-Нд — вихідні.
  • Можливість працювати в стабільній компанії на ринку США з англомовними клієнтами, яка росте та розвивається разом зі своїми людьми.
  • Менторство, підтримка та жива командна культура, де кожен має голос

Що ти робитимеш щодня:

Ти станеш обличчям Supplax для наших клієнтів у США — людиною, яка будує довіру та створює комфорт у спілкуванні.

  • Пошук і супровід нових клієнтів — від першого контакту до запуску співпраці

  • Аналіз і оновлення даних у CRM та Google Sheets, щоб усе працювало чітко й прозоро

  • Умієш чути, переконувати і надихати, а не просто продавати
  • Любиш структуру, результат і справжню командну атмосферу

jobs.title: Team Lead Media Buying
jobs.excerpt: OXOIX — це простір для розвитку та реалізації найсміливіших ідей у Entertainment напрямку!
jobs.description:
OXOIX — це простір для розвитку та реалізації найсміливіших ідей у Entertainment напрямку! Ми надаємо сервісні рішення для брендів, які охоплюють міжнародні ринки.


Довіра, відкриті і конструктивні діалоги, командний результат — наші принципи, які лежать в основі всього, що ми створюємо разом.


Сьогодні ми масштабуємося: відкриваємо другу команду медіабаїнгу на Tier-1 та шукаємо Team Lead-а, який очолить її з першого дня — сформує команду та забезпечить досягнення цілей. Ти зайдеш у департамент, де є готова інфраструктура, Head, суміжний TL та синхронізований процес — але твоя команда баєрів буде твоєю відповідальністю від першого дня.

Твоя роль складатиметься з

  • Щоденного контролю спенду та зв’язок, регулярних сінків та 1-on-1 за результатами кожного баєра;

  • Тримання команди в цільовому коридорі за показником D2C;

  • Формування стратегії: гео, воронки, креативні підходи, PWA/лендінги, тести форм;

  • Встановлення методологій тестування креативів і тиражування робочих зв’язок всередині команд;

  • Діагностики воронки: відрізняти проблему в крео, PWA, лендінгу чи якості трафіку;

  • Роботи з агентствами: заведення й розподіл кабінетів, ескалації, підстраховка на випадок стопу агентства;

  • Звітності у CRM по команді та прогнозу на місяць з поясненням відхилень;

  • Онбордингу нових баєрів, рекомендування нових кандидатів, розширення нетворкінгу команди;

  • Власного заливу трафіку, особливо на старті (мін. $30,000/місяць особистого спенду).

Ми очікуємо від тебе

  • Мінімум 1 рік у ролі Team Lead у Facebook Media Buying;

  • Досвід управління командою від 6 баєрів;

  • Загальний досвід у Media Buying від 3 років, обов'язково з досвідом в iGaming;

  • Кейси з обсягом та якістю одночасно — з цифрами: який спенд тримали, з якою якістю, скількома баєрами масштабували;

  • Практичний досвід заливу з FB на Tier-1;

  • Розуміння юніт-економіки D2C: читати воронку від показу до депозиту й вирішувати за метриками;

  • Досвід з агентськими кабінетами: комунікація з агентствами, пікселі, фарми, антидетект, стабільний спенд при банах;

  • Управлінську зрілість: наймати, онбордити, ставити KPI, розбирати результат на 1-on-1.

Технологічний стек

  • Трекінгові платформи: Keitaro — обов'язково;

  • BI та аналітика: Tableau, Power BI або власні CRM-системи — досвід вітається;

  • Робочі інструменти: Jira, Slack, Google Workspace.

Буде плюсом

  • Власна сформована команда (2-3 баєри), яка готова зайти в компанію;

  • Власна мережа контактів: сильні баєри та перевірені агентства.

Чому до нас варто приєднатись

  • Стабільні бренди на white label платформах — мультигео;

  • Власна інфраструктура: не потрібно будувати технічну базу з нуля:

    • свій CRM з наскрізною аналітикою;

    • власні воронки, PWA/WebView;

    • пул агентських кабінетів.

  • Бонусна сітка вище ринкової — при виконанні KPI на якість;

  • Інвестиції в людей та технології — компанія активно впроваджує AI та автоматизацію на рівні всього бізнесу;

  • Психологічна безпека і прозорість: в останньому анонімному опитуванні команда оцінила Marketing Department на 3,75 із 4, а 98% відповідей були позитивними. Найвищі оцінки — психологічна безпека, регулярний фідбек, якість менеджменту.

Як виглядає рекрутинг процес на цю позицію ⤵️

  • Інтерв'ю з рекрутером, Tech Interview з Hiring manager-ом, Final Interview з CMO;

  • Збір рекомендацій, background check, поліграф;

  • Offer.

Що ми пропонуємо


🏆 Топові бренди — працюємо з сучасними рішеннями, які довели свою ефективність і стабільно приносять високі результати на своїх ГЕО.
🌍 Гнучкий формат — можливість обрати ремоут чи відвідувати коворкінг у Києві.

🌴 Відпочинок — 20 робочих днів щорічно + 5 retreat days, вихідні на державні свята.

💜 Wellness — страхування або компенсація за медичні послуги.

⚡ AI Champion — можливість стати частиною команди з впровадження AI та автоматизацій на рівні компанії.


Хочеш стати частиною команди? Тоді чекаємо на твій відгук!

Уся необхідна та повна інформація про обробку твоїх персональних даних надана компанії OXOIX у повному обсязі, у простій та зрозумілій формі. Надсилаючи своє резюме та інформацію, зазначену в анкеті, ти надаєш згоду на обробку твоїх персональних даних на умовах, викладених у Згоді на обробку персональних даних.

jobs.excerpt: About TruegenicsTruegenics Pte Ltd is a leading e-commerce company based in Singapore with a track record of over US$218M in online product sales.
jobs.description:
About Truegenics

Truegenics Pte Ltd is a leading e-commerce company based in Singapore with a track record of over US$218M in online product sales. We specialize in e-retailing our own brand of health supplements to a global audience.
We strive to create value and make a positive difference in the world, one life at a time. We believe that even the smallest action can define one’s destiny, and we are committed to creating products that enhance the lives of our consumers.

Why This Role Matters

We are looking for a Senior Graphic & Web Designer who is passionate about creating meaningful brand experiences. Someone who combines creativity with technical precision and takes full ownership of their work.
You will be the visual voice of our brands, shaping how our products look, feel, and perform across packaging and web experiences. This is a fully remote role, so clear communication, strong collaboration, and accountability are key to your success.
You will partner closely with the marketing, copywriting, and sales teams to create designs that not only look exceptional but also deliver measurable results, driving conversions, strengthening brand reputation, and deepening customer loyalty.

Mission of the Role

To elevate Truegenics’ visual identity across all touchpoints by ensuring every design supports business objectives, reinforces brand integrity, and resonates with our target audience.
As a senior creative, you will lead by example, maintaining design excellence, guiding junior team members, and setting high standards for creativity, performance, and consistency across all brands.

Key Responsibilities

Graphic & Packaging Design (30%)

  • Conceptualize and execute creative ideas for digital and packaging projects based on brand direction, marketing briefs, and customer experience principles.
  • Design and adapt packaging across product lines using established brand templates, ensuring consistency while introducing fresh variations for new launches.
  • Create digital design assets for websites, social media, emails, and campaigns that engage users and drive conversions.
  • Maintain a strong and consistent visual identity across all design outputs, ensuring alignment with brand guidelines and marketing objectives.
  • Develop and evolve key brand visuals including logos, icons, color systems, typography, and layout frameworks.
  • Translate marketing strategies into visually compelling campaigns that strengthen brand equity and support sales growth.
  • Mentor and guide junior designers, providing clear feedback and creative direction to improve quality and efficiency.
  • Research and incorporate emerging design trends, creative formats, and audience insights to keep the brand relevant and competitive.

Web Design & Frontend Development (70%)

  • Design and develop responsive, high-performing web pages with a strong mobile-first approach, ensuring layouts, navigation, and performance are optimized for mobile users.
  • Collaborate with marketing, media, and copywriting teams to design and optimize eCommerce landing pages that convert effectively across devices.
  • Apply UX/UI best practices to build layouts that are visually engaging, intuitive to navigate, and optimized for performance.
  • Develop reusable page templates and modular design systems to improve speed, consistency, and scalability.
  • Ensure all web assets meet quality standards for responsiveness, accessibility, and loading performance.
  • Coordinate the execution of promotional web materials, ensuring accuracy, brand consistency, and timely delivery.
  • Review and refine the work of junior designers, providing constructive feedback that enhances both creative quality and execution.

Key Requirements

  • Strong portfolio showcasing both digital and web design work. Clear examples of mobile-first design projects will be a plus.
  • Expertise in responsive and mobile UX/UI design, including optimizing layouts, images, and performance for smaller screens.
  • Experience using AI tools to streamline creative processes, generate ideas, or enhance productivity (for example, generating layout variations, assisting with copy, or automating production tasks).
  • Willingness to learn, explore, and adopt new AI tools to improve design quality and efficiency.
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to present ideas, feedback, and updates clearly in a remote, cross-functional environment.
  • Self-driven, highly organized, and accountable to deadlines.
  • Skilled in managing multiple projects while maintaining attention to detail.
  • Comfortable collaborating through digital tools and workflows such as Figma, Slack, and Wrike.

Working Arrangement

This is a fully remote position, open to candidates who can collaborate effectively across digital platforms and time zones.

The potential hire must also be equipped with the following to carry out this role effectively:

  • Laptop / CPU with acceptable speed
  • At least 1 monitor screen (inclusive of laptop screen)
  • Headset with Mic (Noise cancelling)
  • Webcam
  • Designated Workstation
  • Stable and strong power and internet connectivity
  • Noise-free and conducive environment

Тобі точно буде цікаво, якщо ти:

  • Прагнеш постійного покращення процесів;
  • Орієнтований на професійний, кар'єрний та особистий ріст;
  • Впевнено береш відповідальність за свою роботу та результати;
  • Знаєш, як переконати людину з іншим баченням.
Що потрібно від тебе:
  • Англійська C1: вільно спілкуєшся з американцями;

Опис вакансії

Supplax — це американська компанія з українським серцем, яка вже понад 5 років активно розвивається на ринку. Ми виконуємо роль віддаленого бек-офісу для майстрів у США, що спеціалізуються на ремонтних роботах. Наша команда налічує понад 100 фахівців та повністю бере на себе всі організаційні та операційні процеси, окрім самих ремонтних робіт. Серед них: маркетинг, продажі, управління командами майстрів, контроль якості, збір відгуків, навчання технічного персоналу тощо. Працюємо у 30+ найбільших містах США та вже успішно реалізували понад 30 000 ремонтних проєктів.
Детальніше про компанію ти можеш дізнатися за посиланням Ти ознайомишся з нашою метою, критеріями, перевагами, а також відео-відгуками про роботу в Supplax від наших співробітників.
Ми добре розуміємося в продажах, маркетингу, а також технічних деталях нашої роботи. Ми створили ефективну систему введення на посади, що допомагає стажеру за кілька перших тижнів з повного нуля дійти до рівня впевненого спілкування з майстрами та клієнтами.
Ми шукаємо уважну людину, яка вміє залишатися на зв’язку навіть у нічний час. Ти будеш частиною команди, що підтримує американських клієнтів і майстрів у сфері ремонту, забезпечуючи стабільність процесів 24/7.
Твої задачі:
  • працювати в тандемі з основними менеджерами;
  • вести комунікацію з клієнтом і майстром до завершення робіт;
  • контролювати якість і статус виконання проєктів;
  • оновлювати інформацію в CRM;
  • оперативно приймати рішення в межах своєї зони відповідальності.
Що потрібно від тебе:
  • вміння паралельно вести кілька задач і не втрачати фокус;
  • емпатійність і вміння вибудовувати довіру з клієнтами;
  • уважність до деталей навіть у нічний час;
  • відповідальність і самостійність у роботі без постійного контролю;
  • досвід роботи з CRM-системами.
Ми пропонуємо:
  • заробітну плату $1000 (ставка+ бонуси);
  • нічний графік: з 00:00 до 09:00 за Києвом, субота й неділя — вихідні;
  • повністю віддалений формат;
  • роботу з наявними клієнтами без продажів;
  • можливості кар'єрного зростання в компанії, що активно масштабується;
  • 5 додаткових вихідних на американські свята.
Ти наш кандидат, якщо:
  • твоя англійська на рівні C1 — ти вільно спілкуєшся з носіями і тебе не лякає жива розмова;
  • від 1 року досвіду в support або суміжній сфері;;
  • ти на «ти» з CRM і не губишся серед кількох відкритих задач;
  • нічний графік для тебе не випробування, а зручний ритм, у якому ти видаєш максимум.
Хочеш отримувати стабільний дохід у $ і працювати з дому? Відгукуйся на вакансію!
