Детальніше про компанію ти можеш дізнатися за посиланням . Ти ознайомишся з нашою метою, критеріями, перевагами, а також відеовідгуками про роботу в Supplax від наших співробітників.

У зв’язку з активним розвитком support команди ми шукаємо Team Lead, який може не лише керувати командою, розвивати напрямок, а й впливати на конверсію виконаних угод.

Що ти отримаєш, ставши частиною Supplax:

  • Стабільний дохід в $: ставка (обговорюється) + бонуси за виконання KPI.

  • Зручний формат: 100% віддалена робота з будь-якої точки світу.

  • Можливість працювати в стабільній компанії на ринку США, яка росте та розвивається разом зі своїми людьми.

  • Повну зайнятість, графік роботи: Сб-Нд-Пн + 2 дні в будні на вибір з 16:00 - 01:00 (за Київським часом).

  • Простір для рішень і змін без зайвої бюрократії.

  • Систему навчання, підтримки та адаптації для ефективного старту.

Що потрібно буде робити:

  • планувати та організовувати роботу команди Customer Support;

  • контролювати та аналізувати ключові KPI й метрики команди;

  • проводити 1:1, давати конструктивний зворотний зв’язок та допомагати співробітникам розвиватися;

  • навчати нових співробітників та створювати навчальні матеріали;

  • аналізувати робочі процеси, знаходити слабкі місця та пропонувати рішення для їх покращення;

  • працювати зі скриптами: аналізувати їхню ефективність та ініціювати зміни;

  • взаємодіяти з керівниками інших відділів, зокрема Sales.

Ти точно наш, якщо…

  • маєш від 1 року досвіду управління командою до 5 людей;

  • працював у Customer Support / логістиці або суміжних сервісних нішах;

  • вмієш працювати з KPI, метриками та показниками ефективності;

  • маєш досвід навчання та адаптації нових співробітників;

  • вільно спілкуєшся англійською (рівень strong В2 або C1);

  • маєш конкретні професійні досягнення, які можна виміряти результатом.

Якщо ти вмієш не просто керувати людьми, а бачити за цифрами причини проблем і знаходити рішення — будемо раді познайомитися!

Location: United States
Working Style: Remote

Overview

Do you have a passion for helping businesses automate their customer service operations and gain valuable insights from their customer conversations? Do you enjoy exploring innovative ways to leverage conversational data to improve customer experience and drive business outcomes? If so, we’d love to have you join our US team as a Sales & Solutions Engineer.

In this role, you will showcase Sestek’s Conversational Automation solution suite, including Conversational Intelligence, Agent Copilot, and Agentic AI powered by home-grown core technologies such as Speech Recognition, Text-to-Speech (TTS).

Who we are

We are a global technology company developing AI-powered conversational solutions that empower organizations to become more data-driven, enhance operational efficiency, and deliver superior customer experiences.

We are an R&D center, with a team of more than 100 engineers specializing in Text-to-Speech, Speech Recognition, Natural Language Processing, and Voice Biometrics technologies. Since 2022, we have been part of Unifonic, a leading Communications Platform as a Service (CPaaS) provider, and have grown into an international organization with more than 500 employees.

We serve more than 500 enterprise customers across 20 countries in the US, Europe, and MENA regions.

What you’ll do

  • Partner closely with Sales Directors, Channel Sales Managers, Account Managers, Product Managers, and Project Managers to understand customer needs and support the sales process.
  • Conduct product demonstrations and technical presentations, helping customers understand the value and capabilities of our Conversational Analytics and Conversational Automation solutions.
  • Lead customer discovery sessions, translate business requirements into technical solutions, and design solutions that address customer pain points and meet customer requirements.
  • Scope, lead, and manage Proofs of Concept (POCs), working closely with customers and internal teams to ensure successful outcomes.
  • Develop Statements of Work (SOWs) and other solution-related documentation based on customer requirements.

jobs.description:
SeoProfy — міжнародна SEO-компанія, яка працює там, де прості рішення не працюють. Ми не “женемося” за трафіком як метрикою — ми будуємо стратегії, які впливають на бізнес: заявки, продажі та ринкову частку.

Наш підхід — це поєднання аналітики, стратегії та практики. Без шаблонів, без “зробили як у всіх”. У складних нішах це єдиний спосіб отримати результат.

Всередині команди це середовище з високою планкою. Тут багато задач без готових відповідей, сильне оточення і очікування, що ти будеш думати, приймати рішення і нести за них відповідальність.

Сюди приходять не за “комфортною роботою”, а за ростом через практику, складними задачами і можливістю реально впливати на результат.


Кого ми шукаємо

Зараз SeoProfy в пошуках Senior SEO Specialist (iGaming). Якщо драйвить не процес заради процесу, а результат і сенс у роботі — варто познайомитись ближче.


Можливо, ця роль не найкращий метч, якщо:

  • Ближчий формат роботи з чіткими рамками та передбачуваними задачами;

  • Складно сприймати регулярний фідбек і працювати з ним;

  • Комфортніше працювати без високого рівня автономії;

  • Не дуже відгукується динамічний темп і зміни;

  • Не любиш рутину (а тут вона частина роботи).

SeoProfy — не компанія “для всіх”. Це компанія для тих, хто хоче більше, ніж просто стабільну роботу і готовий інвестувати в це свої зусилля.


Про роль коротко: що ти тут будеш робити насправді

  • Аналіз конкурентів, пошукової видачі, тенденцій на ринку;
  • Формування та реалізація SEO-стратегії;
  • Вибудовування "інфраструктури" для проєктів;
  • Пошук та сетап доменів/дроп-доменів;
  • Лінкбілдинг;
  • Створення та/чи генерація контенту;
  • Автоматизація рутинних процесів для масштабування результатів.

Ти наш ідеальний кандидат, якщо:

  • Маєш досвід роботи з монобрендовими iGaming-проєктами від 2-х років;
  • Маєш практичний досвід Brand Protection (захист бренду у пошуковій видачі);
  • Розумієш особливості роботи за Cross-brand SEO моделлю;
  • Досвід роботи виключно з бурж-проєктами (Tier 1 / Tier 2 GEO);
  • Мислиш категоріями бізнесу, а не тільки SEO;
  • Формуєш SEO-стратегію, оцінюєш ризики та потенціал нових напрямків;
  • Самостійно знаходиш точку зросту, тестуєш SEO-гіпотези, береш відповідальність за результат;
  • Швидко адаптуєшся до змін алгоритмів ринку.
Буде перевагою
  • досвід запуску власних SEO-проєктів;
  • створення власних SEO-інструментів;
  • розробка інструментів для генерації сайтів;
  • автоматизація генерації контенту;
  • досвід роботи з AI в SEO;
  • досвід пошуку та роботи з drop domains;
  • побудова внутрішніх SEO automation-процесів.

Що ти отримаєш разом із SeoProfy

Якщо після всього написаного бажання відгукнутися тільки посилилося — значить, ми на одній хвилі, і саме час перейти до приємного.

Компенсація та бенефіти

  • Ринкова винагорода;

  • 18 робочих днів основної відпустки;

  • До 11 додаткових днів відпустки;

  • Оплачувані лікарняні;

  • Гнучкий графік для комфортного work-life balance;

  • Вихідні у державні свята;

  • Корпоративні свята та тімбілдинги (онлайн і офлайн);

  • Участь у благодійних ініціативах і донатах.

Твій розвиток з нами

  • Прозора система грейдування;

  • Внутрішнє та зовнішнє навчання;

Турбота про команду

Job Description Summary

‎

CareMore Health is seeking a Senior Clinical Data Analyst to join the analytics team to support and advance clinical analytics by analyzing clinical, claims, and operational data to uncover insights that drive improvements in quality, outcomes, and efficiency. This role is hands-on, focused on generating clear analyses, dashboards, and actionable insights that guide clinical and operational decision-making. The ideal candidate is equally comfortable writing advanced SQL, building compelling visualizations, and communicating findings in plain business language.

‎

How will you make an impact & Requirements

‎

Key Responsibilities:

  • Data Analysis & Insight Generation
    • Write, optimize, and maintain SQL queries to extract, transform, and analyze large datasets.
    • Analyze clinical, claims, and operational datasets to identify trends, care variation, and opportunities for improving outcomes.
    • Conduct focused deep dive analyses on quality metrics, utilization patterns, readmissions, and chronic disease management.
  • Reporting & Visualization
    • Build and maintain dashboards, reports, and scorecards that track clinical quality and operational performance in Power BI or similar visualization tools.
    • Ensure reporting aligns with organizational priorities and regulatory/quality programs (e.g., HEDIS, STARS) when applicable.
    • Continuously enhance reporting tools to improve usability, accuracy, and timeliness based on close partnership with operational and clinical stakeholders.
  • Collaboration & Clinical Support
    • Partner with providers, care teams, and quality leaders to interpret data and support performance improvement efforts.
    • Serve as primary analytics contributor in organizational improvement workgroups supporting clinical and population health initiatives.
  • Data Stewardship & Standards
    • Support standardization of definitions, metrics, and methodologies across programs and markets.
    • Collaborate with data engineering and IT teams to ensure data accuracy and availability.

Qualifications:

  • Required:
    • 3+ years of experience in data analytics, healthcare analytics, business intelligence, or related field.
    • Proficiency in SQL, including writing queries with joins and basic performance tuning.
    • Experience in creating dashboards and data visualizations that support decision-making.
    • Ability to translate analytical findings into clear, concise insights for clinical, operational, or business audiences.
    • Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams (e.g., clinical, operations, quality); comfort engaging stakeholders at various levels.
    • Strong analytical thinking, problem‑solving skills, and attention to detail.
    • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Preferred:
    • 5+ years of experience in data analytics, healthcare analytics, or business intelligence.
    • Advanced SQL skills, including working complex joins, aggregations, and query optimization.

jobs.description:
This is a remote position.

Only LATAM-based candidates (bilingual in Spanish and English)
​
The Floating Medical Office Customer Serviceposition provides temporary administrative coverage to different medical practices when staffing gaps occur due to vacations, sick leave, resignations, increased workload, or other unexpected absences.
Unlike an assistant dedicated to a single client, the floating assistant must be able to quickly adapt to different providers, workflows, software systems, and operational protocols while maintaining service quality and minimizing disruption to the client.
The position follows a rapid deployment model, meaning the floating assistant is not permanently assigned to a fixed group of clients. Instead, onboarding is provided when coverage is required for a specific medical practice.
Responsibilities
Responsibilities will depend on the workflows and operational requirements of each assigned medical practice and may include:
  • Following appointment scheduling rules and provider preferences.
  • Supporting insurance workflows.
  • Assisting with referral processes.
  • Supporting prior authorization procedures.
  • Following patient communication protocols and telephone scripts.
  • Following established escalation procedures.
  • Maintaining internal documentation standards.
  • Navigating Electronic Medical Record (EMR) systems.
  • Reviewing and following client-specific documentation and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
  • Following daily operational processes and checklists.
  • Adapting to different medical practices, workflows, software systems, and operational protocols.

Requirements

  • Must have your own device and headset
  • High-speed internet connection of at least 100 MB.
  • Previous experience working with U.S.-based medical offices and knowledge of HIPAA regulations.
  • Ability to quickly adapt to different medical practices, providers, workflows, and operational protocols.
  • Ability to continuously learn and transition between different client environments.
  • Ability to learn and navigate different Electronic Medical Record (EMR) systems and software platforms.
  • Ability to understand and follow practice-specific scheduling rules, insurance workflows, referral processes, prior authorization procedures, and patient communication protocols.
  • Ability to follow telephone scripts, escalation procedures, and internal documentation standards.
  • Ability to review and follow Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), operational guides, and daily checklists.
  • Ability to work effectively following an accelerated onboarding process for each new assignment.
  • Previous experience with medical offices is preferred.
Systems
Medical practices may use different software platforms, including:
  • Athenahealth
  • eClinicalWorks
  • Nextech
  • HealthArc
  • EMA
  • Other proprietary systems
The position requires the ability to understand not only the software used by each practice, but also the operational processes and procedures established by that particular medical office.
Assignment and Onboarding Model
When coverage is required:
  • A client reports an upcoming absence or unexpected staffing need.
  • A floating assistant is assigned.
  • The assistant receives an accelerated onboarding.
  • The assistant reviews the client's documentation.
  • The assistant begins providing temporary coverage until the assigned employee returns.
Because medical offices may operate differently, each assignment may require adaptation to new workflows, provider preferences, software systems, and operational procedures.
Comprehensive client documentation, structured onboarding, and ongoing support during the initial stages of each assignment are key components of the floating coverage model.

About Us

Flying Bisons is a leading Strategic Design & Digital Consulting company based in Warsaw, with projects across Europe and the Middle East. Our mission is to help our clients Unleash Digital Potential™.

We work at scales where real impact happens: enterprise platforms, government services, and corporate ecosystems used by millions of people. Our projects include national workforce platforms (Qiwa, Ajeer), education ecosystems (Madares), major banks (Bank Pekao, Alinma), global telecoms (Ooredoo, Salam), and international brands (KFC, Hebe, NaTemat, Enel-Med).

Our uniqueness comes from going beyond design craft. As we wrote in our manifestos - Strategic Design - Manifest and Strategic Design - The Future of Design - design craft is only 10% of success. The other 90% - the Invisible 90% - is about navigating politics, aligning stakeholders, and protecting fragile visions until they reach reality.

That’s why we’re building the discipline of Strategic Design - and we want you to be part of it.

Role context

As a Senior UX Designer at Flying Bisons, you will collaborate with stakeholders, product managers and developers to align business goals with user needs, advocate for users throughout the product development process, and continuously refine experiences based on user feedback and metrics.

You should have a strong sense of ownership, as you will have responsibility over the area you will be working on. This role involves translating regulations into user-friendly experiences and iterating based on feedback. You should be experienced with complex forms, data visualization and designing for diverse user needs while meeting accessibility standards and security requirements.

We expect our designers to actively embrace an AI-first approach, not just using tools like ChatGPT for convenience, but deeply understanding and integrating AI into their workflows, ideation and output. This means staying up to date with the latest trends in AI-driven design, experimenting with new tools and thinking critically about how AI is reshaping user behavior, interfaces and expectations. Passive usage isn’t enough. We’re looking for curious minds who treat AI as a creative partner, not just a shortcut.

Scope of services

  • Creating best-in-class design solutions and user experiences.

  • Mapping user flows, defining information architecture, designing wireframes and interfaces.

  • Ensuring the designs meet project requirements and standards, and are consistent across the product.

  • Involvement in research to understand how the product is performing and identifying opportunities for further enhancements.

  • Reviewing and improving current products, with continuous optimisation through analytics tools like Google Analytics and Hotjar.

  • Working in an end-to-end digital process.

  • Visualising ideas and inspiring others.

  • Working with large design systems.

  • Managing and maintaining ongoing relationships with clients and vendors.

  • Collaborating closely with the Product Manager to align design objectives and project goals.

  • Working on a big project involving multiple international and multidisciplinary teams of researchers, strategists, data analysts, product managers, product owners and developers to translate business requirements into engaging design solutions.

What we are looking for

  • Strong portfolio of commercial projects.

  • Full understanding of the best design processes and how to tailor them to user and client needs.

  • Understanding of web and mobile design principles, including responsive and adaptive design.

  • Understanding of analytics tools like Google Analytics, Hotjar or similar.

  • Familiarity with designing for accessibility and inclusive design practices.

  • AI-first mindset and design approach.

  • Good command of written and spoken English, minimum B2 level.

  • Good communication and presentation skills.

  • Proactive attitude, with the ability to solve problems and figure things out.

  • Extreme attention to detail.

Nice to have

  • Experience in UX audits would be a plus.

  • Experience with projects in the MENA region would be a big plus.

Cooperation terms

  • B2B cooperation for independent contractors.

  • Suggested commercial range: 15 000 to 20 000 PLN net + VAT per month, depending on experience, expertise, scope and availability.

  • Cooperation in an Apple and Google Workspace-based environment.

  • Access to selected project tools, systems and environments where required for project delivery, security or client compliance.

  • Possibility to cooperate with experienced specialists from strategy, design, research, product, analytics, technology and delivery areas.

  • The cooperation is based on agreed project outcomes, delivery quality and clear communication.

Position Overview

The Director, U.S. Government Affairs is a senior leadership position responsible for developing and executing enterprise-wide federal government affairs, public policy, regulatory engagement, and stakeholder management strategies across FUJIFILM’s U.S. portfolio of businesses.

This role serves as a trusted advisor to executive leadership and is responsible for identifying legislative, regulatory, geopolitical, reputational, and business risks; developing advocacy strategies to mitigate those risks; and advancing policy initiatives that support growth, innovation, domestic manufacturing, healthcare access, trade competitiveness, and supply chain security.

The Director will assist in high-level engagement with Congress, the Executive Branch, federal agencies, trade associations, industry coalitions, and other key stakeholders while partnering closely with subsidiary leadership teams to align public policy priorities with business objectives.

This position requires an accomplished government affairs leader with demonstrated success influencing complex public policy issues, leading cross-functional initiatives, managing external consultants and advocacy organizations, and operating effectively within a highly matrixed, multinational organization.

This role is a critical strategic partner to C-suite executives and board members, directly influencing high-stakes decisions that drive FUJIFILM’s long-term business strategy and market leadership across multiple regulated industries and geographies.

Works on enterprise-wide, multi-jurisdictional government affairs initiatives encompassing complex regulatory, geopolitical, and trade risks impacting FUJIFILM’s global business resilience and innovation pipelines across healthcare, advanced manufacturing, and technology sectors.

Current lobbying experience and registration is required with experience lobbying in the semiconductor or global trade field.

Our ideal candidate should reside in the DC surrounding area.

Company Overview

At FUJIFILM Holdings America Corporation, we’re redefining innovation across the industries we touch—from healthcare and photography to semiconductors and data storage. With roots in photosensitive materials and a legacy of groundbreaking technology, we now lead 23 diverse affiliate businesses across the Americas.

We’re looking for mission-driven talents eager to join us to help create, market, and support a vast portfolio of products. At Fujifilm you’ll have the opportunity to explore and grow your skills in new, exciting ways. Whether you’re shaping tomorrow’s tech or redefining today’s processes, we’ll provide a flexible work environment and dynamic culture where innovation thrives.

Our Americas HQ is nestled in Valhalla, New York, a charming town known for its excellent schools, beautiful parks, and easy access to the vibrancy of New York City.

Fujifilm is globally headquartered in Tokyo with over 70,000 employees across four key business segments of healthcare, electronics, business innovation, and imaging. We are guided and united by our Group Purpose of “giving our world more smiles.” Visit:

Job Description

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership & Policy Development

  • Assist in the development and execution of enterprise-wide federal government affairs and public policy strategies supporting FUJIFILM’s U.S. businesses.
  • Identify emerging legislative, regulatory, geopolitical, trade, and reputational risks and develop strategies to mitigate business impacts.
  • Advise the Head of Government Affairs on public policy developments, advocacy opportunities, external stakeholder engagement strategies, and business-critical policy risks.
  • Develop long-term policy roadmaps supporting business growth, market access, domestic manufacturing expansion, supply chain resiliency, and innovation priorities.
  • Serve as a strategic thought partner to subsidiary presidents and senior leadership regarding federal legislative and regulatory developments.

Government Relations & Advocacy

  • Represent FUJIFILM before Congress, the White House, federal regulatory agencies, executive branch departments, and key policymaking bodies.
  • Develop and execute sophisticated advocacy campaigns designed to influence legislative, regulatory, and policy outcomes.
  • Build and maintain strategic relationships with Members of Congress, congressional staff, federal agencies, trade associations, policy experts, industry leaders, and external coalitions.
  • Lead engagement related to trade policy, tariffs, supply chain security, healthcare policy, manufacturing incentives, electronic materials, biotechnology, and emerging technology issues.
  • Draft and oversee policy positions, comment letters, testimony, briefing materials, advocacy communications, and executive-level policy papers.
  • Assists in the design and execution of comprehensive governance frameworks, ensuring strict adherence to federal lobbying laws, ethics rules, political activity guidelines, and risk mitigation processes. Leads enterprise-wide crisis management and issue escalation related to legislative, regulatory, geopolitical, or trade developments.

Leadership & Team Management

  • Mentor, develop, and manage government affairs professionals while fostering a high-performance, collaborative, accountable, and business-oriented culture.
  • Establish federal government affairs priorities, , workplans, development goals, and accountability mechanisms aligned with organizational objectives.
  • Assist in managing and evaluating external lobbying firms, consultants, trade associations, professional service providers, and advocacy partners to ensure measurable return on investment.
  • Coordinate cross-functional teams consisting of legal, compliance, communications, regulatory affairs, operations, finance, and business leadership stakeholders.
  • Build organizational capability through education, internal briefings, stakeholder engagement, and development of policy expertise across FUJIFILM businesses.
  • Provides visionary leadership to a multidisciplinary government affairs team, including direct reports, external consultants, and cross-functional project teams. Accountable for organizational development, talent cultivation, succession planning, and fostering a high-performing, collaborative culture aligned with FUJIFILM’s strategic goals.
  • Advises on a multimillion-dollar government affairs budget, optimizing allocation of resources across internal teams, lobbying firms, consultants, and advocacy programs to maximize influence and return on investment.

Executive Engagement & Stakeholder Management

  • Prepare executive-level policy briefings, strategic analyses, board materials, presentations, talking points, and decision-support documents.
  • Support executive interactions with policymakers, industry associations, government officials, business coalitions, and external stakeholders.
  • Lead strategic planning and issue management efforts related to high-profile legislative, regulatory, trade, geopolitical, and reputational matters.
  • Facilitate enterprise alignment around advocacy priorities, policy positions, external messaging, and engagement strategies.
  • Enhance FUJIFILM’s visibility, credibility, and influence among policy, business, and industry stakeholders.
  • Acts as the principal liaison to senior federal agency leaders, Congressional leadership, industry coalitions, and international governmental bodies, cultivating high-level partnerships that catalyze impactful and sustained policy outcomes beneficial to FUJIFILM’s business interests.

Governance, Compliance & Risk Management

  • Ensure compliance with federal lobbying, ethics, disclosure, political activity, and government engagement requirements.
  • Oversee governance processes related to trade association memberships, sponsorships, political interactions, advocacy activities, and external engagement approvals.
  • Establish metrics and reporting frameworks to measure advocacy effectiveness, business impact, risk mitigation, and organizational value.
  • Assist in managing government affairs budgets, external resources, and strategic investments while ensuring alignment with enterprise priorities.
  • Lead enterprise-wide issue escalation and crisis-response efforts involving legislative, regulatory, geopolitical, trade, or reputational risk.

Required Skills/Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in public policy, Political Science, Government Affairs, Public Administration, Law, Communications, Business Administration, International Relations, or related field required. Masters is a plus.
  • Minimum of 10 years of progressively responsible experience in government affairs, public policy, legislative affairs, regulatory affairs, public affairs, corporate affairs, or related fields.
  • Minimum of 5 years of leadership experience managing professional staff, consultants, vendors, external advisors, or cross-functional teams.
  • Demonstrated success developing and executing federal advocacy campaigns influencing legislative, regulatory, or policy outcomes.
  • Significant experience engaging directly with Congress, federal agencies, executive branch officials, national trade associations, and industry coalitions.
  • Required experience in trade policy and/or semiconductor policy, including the ability to assess policy impacts on advanced manufacturing, supply chains, technology competitiveness, and business strategy.
  • Strong understanding of the federal legislative, regulatory, appropriations, trade, and administrative policy processes.
  • Proven ability to advise senior executives on strategic policy, regulatory, geopolitical, reputational, and business risks.
  • Exceptional written, verbal, presentation, executive briefing, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to operate effectively in a highly matrixed, complex, multinational corporate environment with enterprise-wide responsibilities.

Desired Skills

  • Master’s Degree in Public Policy, Public Administration, Political Science, Business Administration, International Affairs, or related field preferred.
  • Juris Doctor (JD) strongly preferred.
  • Experience supporting advanced manufacturing, healthcare, life sciences, biotechnology, semiconductor, electronic materials, trade, or other highly regulated industries.
  • Experience leading enterprise-wide government affairs, public policy, regulatory affairs, corporate affairs, or external affairs initiatives.
  • Experience managing large-scale external stakeholder engagement programs, national trade association relationships, lobbying firms, and advocacy coalitions.
  • Demonstrated expertise in trade policy, supply chain security, healthcare innovation policy, manufacturing policy, industrial policy, or international economic policy.
  • Proven ability to lead transformational initiatives and manage change in complex, matrixed organizations.
  • Expertise in building and maintaining C-suite and government relationships to influence policy and business outcomes.
  • Exceptional negotiation skills with experience in high-stakes government and industry settings.
  • Skilled in anticipating, mitigating, and managing reputational, regulatory, and geopolitical risks at an enterprise level.
  • Adept at leading cross-divisional teams and communicating complex policy issues clearly to diverse audiences including executives and boards.
  • Strong capability in developing innovative policy solutions and thought leadership that shape industry standards.
  • Experience navigating the complexities of multinational regulatory environments and aligning global policy strategies.
  • Proficiency in leveraging data analytics and intelligence to inform policy strategies and measure advocacy effectiveness.
  • Familiarity with the latest government affairs and lobbying technology platforms and CRMs to optimize engagement and reporting.
  • Demonstrated success in forming and leading coalitions and partnerships that drive legislative and regulatory change.

Why Join Us?

At FUJIFILM, this role will help shape public policy strategies that influence healthcare innovation, domestic manufacturing, biotechnology leadership, supply chain resilience, and next-generation technologies. The Director will work alongside business leaders across a diverse portfolio of companies while helping to drive strategic initiatives that have meaningful impact on industries critical to economic growth and societal advancement.

Plays a pivotal role in positioning FUJIFILM as a market and innovation leader by proactively shaping public policy and advocacy strategies that support emerging technologies, competitive advantage, and industry leadership.

jobs.excerpt: Location: RemotePosition OverviewWe are seeking a contract writer to develop and write a Christ-centered book for parents navigating the unique joys and daily complexities of raising neurodivergent children (including those with ADHD, Autism, sensory/auditory processing disorders, or motor and learning differences).
jobs.description:
Location: Remote

Position Overview

We are seeking a contract writer to develop and write a Christ-centered book for parents navigating the unique joys and daily complexities of raising neurodivergent children (including those with ADHD, Autism, sensory/auditory processing disorders, or motor and learning differences).

In a world that often views neurodivergence solely through the lens of deficits or behavioral problems, the ultimate goal of this resource is to offer parents a deep, lasting refuge. The book should leave readers feeling deeply rooted in Scripture, comforted, and encouraged—reassuring them that they are not alone in their journey and serving as a trusted place they can repeatedly turn to for biblical wisdom, practical perspective, and unshakeable hope.

Because neurodivergence spans a wide spectrum of diagnoses and needs, this resource must focus on unifying, foundational principles rather than specifics of a single diagnosis.

Scope of Work

  • Research, outline, and write a full-length manuscript (approximately 45,000–75,000 words)
  • Collaborate closely with the editorial team through multiple rounds of revision
  • Ensure theological alignment with The Daily Grace Co.’s doctrinal commitment

Commitment

Contract, per-project basis.

Compensation

Compensation is determined based on project scope and complexity.

Additional Information

Contractors are engaged based on the needs of specific projects and are not guaranteed ongoing or full-time work. Participation in meetings, workshops, or collaborative sessions may be requested depending on the project timeline.

Why Publish with The Daily Grace Co.?

With over a decade of publishing experience, The Daily Grace Co. creates Christ-centered resources marked by theological depth, biblical faithfulness, and practical encouragement. We value thoughtful, faithful writers and partner closely from concept development through launch. Our goal is not simply to publish books—but to serve readers with resources that meet real needs and help them treasure Christ.

Proposal Requirements


Important:Proposals that do not include all required components listed below cannot be reviewed.

AI Use: We strongly discourage the use of generative AI in book proposals, and we will not move forward with a book proposal if generative AI is used to generate or refine sample chapters.

Please submit all materials inasingle PDF(not a Word Doc or Google Doc) that includes:

1. Title and Subtitle

2. Controlling Idea (1–2 sentences)

3. One-Paragraph Summary

Provide a concise overview of the book’s purpose, scope, structure, and tone.

4. Target Audience Description (One of the Most Important Sections)Who this book is specifically for

  • Their stage or season of life
  • The particular struggles, questions, or longings they are experiencing
  • Why this book matters to them now
  • Tip: Specificity is essential. Broad descriptions such as “Christian women” or “believers” are not sufficient.

5. Comparable Titles (2–3 from the Past 5 Years)
Identify 2–3 comparable books published within the last five years and explain:

  • How your book overlaps with each one
  • How it is meaningfully distinct in approach, audience, tone, or theological emphasis

6. Author Bio

Explain what uniquely qualifies you to write this book, including:

  • Education
  • Ministry, counseling, academic, or professional experience
  • Subject-matter expertise
  • Lived experience relevant to the topic (if appropriate)
  • Previous publishing or writing experience

7. Detailed Chapter Outline

Provide a working table of contents that includes:

  • Chapter titles
  • The main idea of each chapter and how it supports the controlling idea of the book

8. Front and Back Matter (Optional)

Describe any supplemental materials (e.g., photography, illustrations, reflection questions, discussion guides, recommended resources, liturgies, appendices, etc.).

9. Timeline and Specifications

Include:

  • Current manuscript status (idea stage, in progress, complete, etc.)
  • Estimated total word count (typically 45,000–75,000 words)
  • Anticipated manuscript delivery date

10. Other Book Ideas (Optional)

If you have additional book concepts that may be a fit for The Daily Grace Co., please include a brief description of each idea (1–3 sentences per concept). While these ideas will not be considered part of the current proposal, they may be considered for future publishing opportunities.

11. Sample Material

  • The complete book introduction
  • Two fully written sample chapters representative of the final manuscript
Salary: Determined per project

jobs.excerpt: INDG is expanding the way high-volume visual content is produced: from CGI and 3D pipelines into AI-assisted image generation, editing, and content orchestration.
jobs.description:
INDG is expanding the way high-volume visual content is produced: from CGI and 3D pipelines into AI-assisted image generation, editing, and content orchestration. This role exists to help turn generative AI from an experimental layer into a reliable production capability.

As a Generative-AI Artist (freelance), you will build and run image generation workflows that support real client production: fashion, sportswear, product imagery, talent visuals, campaign adaptations, and asset variation at scale. You will work inside the tension that defines this role: fast-moving AI models, production deadlines, visual realism, brand consistency, and systems that other people can actually use.

INDG has spent 20+ years building visual production systems for global brands. Grip extends that heritage into AI-orchestrated content production. Your work will help teams generate, edit, refine, and scale imagery while keeping outputs sharp enough for enterprise brand use.

What You Will Do

Build and Maintain Generative Image Workflows

Set up, configure, and troubleshoot custom ComfyUI workflows for image generation, image editing, inpainting, outpainting, upscaling, relighting, variation generation, and controlled composition.

You will connect models, nodes, prompts, masks, ControlNet inputs, LoRAs, reference images, and post-processing steps into repeatable workflows. The goal is not a one-off good image. The goal is a workflow that can produce consistent, usable outputs across many assets.

Apply AI to Production Content Problems

Use generative AI techniques against real production needs: adjusting apparel/footwear/accessories/equipment imagery, refining fashion/sportswear product shots, extending scenes, improving model consistency, generating controlled variations, or supporting creative teams with rapid image exploration.

You should understand that production images are judged on details: skin texture, garment fit, fabric behavior, seams, logos, lighting direction, pose plausibility, background continuity, and whether the image still feels brand-correct after generation.

Adapt Quickly as Models and Tools Change

Work confidently across diffusion-based models, LoRAs, ControlNet, IP-Adapter-style workflows, segmentation tools, inpainting models, outpainting methods, face and identity consistency techniques, and emerging image-generation systems.

You will test new models, identify where they improve or break the pipeline, and help the team decide when a tool is production-ready. You do not need every new release to be perfect. You need to know how to evaluate it, isolate failure modes, and translate it into a usable workflow.

Support a Pipeline Used by Artists and Production Teams

Document workflows clearly enough for artists, producers, and technical teams to reuse them. Package settings, prompts, node graphs, model dependencies, and output criteria in a way that reduces guesswork.

You will work with CGI artists, creative technologists, production leads, and platform teams to connect creative intent with operational execution. When something fails, you trace the system: model choice, conditioning input, prompt structure, mask quality, render reference, node configuration, or post-process step.

Requirements

Who You Are

You live at the intersection of image-making and systems-building. You care about the final image, but you also care about the workflow that created it.

You Have

Hands-on experience building and maintaining ComfyUI workflows, or comparable node-based generative AI systems.

A strong working knowledge of current image-generation methods: diffusion models, LoRAs, ControlNet, inpainting, outpainting, image-to-image workflows, upscaling, masking, reference-based generation, and controlled variation.

Experience producing or refining commercial-quality imagery. Fashion, sportswear, product, talent, ecommerce, campaign adaptation, or CGI production experience is a strong plus.

You Think

Systems-first. A good prompt is useful; a repeatable workflow is better.

Automation-first. Manual fixes are acceptable only when they teach the pipeline what to solve next.

Visually. You can tell when an image fails because of lighting, anatomy, garment behavior, material response, identity drift, composition, or post-processing artifacts.

Your Skills Are

ComfyUI workflow construction, debugging, model loading, node graph organization, and dependency management.

Practical prompt engineering for controlled output, not prompt decoration.

Image evaluation for realism, consistency, brand fit, and production usability.

Comfort with fast tool changes, incomplete documentation, broken nodes, model conflicts, and solving problems directly.

Why Join INDG

INDG has spent more than two decades building CGI, 3D, and visual production systems for global brands. Grip now orchestrates AI workflows and production-grade outputs across that same visual heritage.

This freelance role is for someone who wants to work where generative AI meets real production pressure: brand consistency, scale, quality control, and images that need to hold up beyond a demo.

jobs.title: Principal Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.excerpt: About Accelerant Accelerant is a data-driven risk exchange connecting underwriters of specialty insurance risk with risk capital providers.
jobs.description:
About Accelerant

Accelerant is a data-driven risk exchange connecting underwriters of specialty insurance risk with risk capital providers. Accelerant was founded in 2018 by a group of longtime insurance industry executives and technology experts who shared a vision of rebuilding the way risk is exchanged – so that it works better, for everyone. The Accelerant risk exchange does business across more than 20 different countries and 250 specialty products, and we are proud that our insurers have been awarded an AM Best A- (Excellent) rating. For more information, please visit .

About the Role

We're looking for someone to own how machine learning and AI run in production at Accelerant. You'll lead a small engineering function responsible for the platform our data scientists build on. That covers data and feature pipelines, training and inference services, deployment, monitoring, and the infrastructure behind our agentic AI work. You'll set the standards, coach the team, and be accountable for the whole thing staying up.

Much of the value in this role sits at the seams. Our machine learning systems are not an island. They need to exchange data and decisions with the wider Accelerant platform, with third-party providers, and with systems owned by other engineering teams. Designing those integrations, and building the working relationships with the people on the other side of them is closer to the centre of this job than any single piece of infrastructure.

We take the operational side seriously. We care about reproducibility, by which we mean knowing which data and which code produced any model currently making decisions. We care about training and serving computing features the same way, because the times they don't are the ones that hurt. We think about what we call the slow-label problem, where the ground truth on a claims or pricing model can arrive months or years after the prediction, and monitoring has to stay useful in the meantime. We have a bias toward dull, recoverable systems over clever ones that need someone awake to babysit them. If those are problems you've lived with rather than read about, we'd like to talk.

You'd be joining with some foundations already in place but without a decade of accumulated legacy to work around. There is meaningful scope to design the solution, and you'll be the person doing it.

What You'll Work On
  • Owning the ML platform end to end, from data and feature pipelines through training infrastructure, model registry and lineage, inference services, and the deployment path between them
  • Designing and building integrations with the wider Accelerant platform, third-party providers, and systems owned by other teams, working directly with those teams to get it right
  • Making deployment routine rather than eventful. Versioning, staged rollout, rollback, and CI/CD for models and agents
  • Building monitoring that separates data drift from pipeline breakage from genuine performance decay, and that stays informative when labels are delayed
  • Standing up the infrastructure behind our agentic AI work, including orchestration, tool and API integration, retrieval and caching, and control of cost and latency
  • Owning reliability, cost, and performance across ML workloads, from overnight batch scoring to low-latency services
  • Building model governance and audit trails that satisfy regulators and internal risk committees without becoming a tax on design or delivery
  • Leading and growing the function. Setting technical standards, coaching a small team, and partnering closely with the data scientists who depend on your work
What We're Looking For

You likely have experience with many of the following.

  • Substantial experience running machine learning systems in production, including everything that happens after launch
  • Strong engineering foundations. Python, infrastructure as code, containers and orchestration, and depth in at least one major cloud provider with sound instincts about cost and failure modes
  • Data engineering capability, pipelines, orchestration, storage and access patterns, and enough SQL to hold your own in a warehouse
  • A track record of integrating systems across organisational boundaries, including the part where you have to influence teams you don't manage
  • Enough statistical literacy to have a real conversation with a data scientist about whether a model is working, and to stay skeptical when the dashboards say it is
  • Experience leading or coaching engineers, plus judgement about which infrastructure will pay for itself and which is merely satisfying to build
  • Willingness to work with LLMs and agentic AI as everyday tools, whatever your background is today
  • The communication skills and credibility to be the person who says a system isn't ready
Bonus Points

Experience in one or more of the following is especially valuable:

  • Building infrastructure for LLM and agentic systems, including serving, orchestration, retrieval, caching, and keeping spend and latency under control at scale
  • Regulated industries where model governance, explainability, and audit trails are requirements rather than aspirations
  • Insurance or financial services, whether pricing, underwriting, claims, or portfolio management
  • Having worked as a data scientist or predictive modeller at some point, or otherwise being fluent in how models are built and not only how they're shipped
  • Internal platforms and tooling that other technical teams genuinely adopted, and a clear view of why they adopted them
  • Real-time or streaming systems, feature stores, or high-throughput scoring
Team Context

You'll join a lean, senior team with low bureaucracy and high autonomy, working alongside data scientists, engineers, actuaries, underwriters, and product managers. We're investing heavily in agentic AI as the next evolution of how a quantitative team operates, and this role helps shape that direction rather than inheriting it.

Why Accelerant?

You'll build the AI and ML foundations for a business where models drive real decisions across the insurance value chain at a company wholly bought into leveraging these systems.

You'll have

  • Ownership of a function, the freedom to decide how it works, and a team of strong data scientists who need what you build
  • Problems that span the full range, from overnight batch scoring to low-latency services to agentic systems, across more than 20 countries and 250 specialty products
  • A collaborative group of people who enjoy solving difficult problems together
Applying

Alongside your CV, please include a short note (a paragraph is plenty) telling us about one piece of machine learning infrastructure you would delete, and what you'd do instead.

jobs.description:
🚀 The Mission

You’ll start by doing what you do best: closing elite technical roles and building deep client relationships.
But this isn’t a traditional recruiting role. As you deliver hiring outcomes, you’ll also learn how to integrate AI into every part of the recruiting workflow—and help clients do the same as our platform launches.
Hop works with Fortune 500 companies and top VC-backed startups, specializing in GenAI, ML, Data Science, Data Engineering, Software Engineering, and Product talent.
We're pre-launch on Moon Engine, an agent-orchestrated recruiting ops system where autonomous agents act as decision partners, coordinating hiring with governance and auditability.
At Hop, you're a player-coach in the truest sense: hands-on recruiter today, AI-enabled recruiting advisor tomorrow. You'll work directly with our engineering and product teams to test Moon Engine, provide critical feedback, and master the future of recruiting—then bring that expertise to Fortune 500 companies and top startups as we onboard them to the platform.
Think of it as dual-track growth: deepen your recruiting craft while becoming an expert in AI-orchestrated hiring workflows.

🧬 What Makes This Different

You're not choosing between recruiting or AI. You're mastering both.
Hands-on recruiting excellence: You'll lead complex searches for senior technical talent—building relationships, managing clients, closing candidates. This is real, high-stakes recruiting work.
Learn AI integration deeply: As you recruit, you'll progressively learn to leverage Moon Engine's capabilities—from AI-assisted sourcing to automated screening. You'll become fluent in how AI amplifies (not replaces) recruiter judgment.
Product development partner: Work directly with our engineering and product teams. Your real-world recruiting experiences become product requirements. Your feedback shapes what gets built.
Customer onboarding expert: As Moon Engine launches, you'll help enterprise clients transition to AI-enabled hiring. You'll teach them what you've learned—making you indispensable to both Hop and our clients.

What You'll Actually Do

  • Phase 1: High-Level Recruiting Execution (Day 1 Onwards)
  • Lead full-cycle searches for senior technical roles: Staff+ Engineers, ML Scientists, Data Platform Leaders, Technical Product Managers
  • Build and maintain client relationships: Partner directly with CTOs, VPs of Engineering, founders—becoming their trusted hiring advisor
  • Manage candidate relationships: Source, engage, interview, close top-tier technical talent with white-glove service
  • Run strategic intake sessions: Translate business needs and technical requirements into precise hiring strategies
  • Deliver results: Own outcomes, timelines, and client satisfaction for complex, high-impact searches
  • Phase 2: AI Integration & Learning (Progressive Ramp)
  • Test Moon Engine in production: Use the platform daily on your real searches—provide honest feedback on what works and what doesn't
  • Learn AI-assisted workflows: Gradually adopt AI-powered sourcing, scoring, screening, and matching as features become available
  • Partner with engineering/product: Participate in feedback sessions, feature demos, and roadmap discussions. Your recruiting insights drive product decisions.
  • Document best practices: As you learn what AI does well (and where human judgment is critical), you'll help create the playbook for AI-enabled recruiting
  • Become the expert: Over 6-12 months, you'll develop deep expertise in how to orchestrate human + AI recruiting workflows
  • Phase 3: Client Enablement & Thought Leadership (As Moon Engine Launches)
  • Onboard enterprise clients: Guide new customers through adopting Moon Engine—teaching them what you've learned
  • Lead training sessions: Show clients how to integrate AI into their hiring processes effectively
  • Strategic consulting: Advise companies on restructuring their recruiting operations for an AI-first world
  • Represent Hop externally: Share insights at events, on podcasts, in content—establishing yourself as a recruiting + AI expert

🎯 Who Thrives Here

  • Must-Haves
  • 5+ years recruiting technical talent with a track record of closing senior/leadership roles (ML Engineers, Staff+ Engineers, Data Platform leads, etc.)
  • Exceptional client relationship skills: You can advise executives, push back when needed, and build long-term trusted partnerships
  • Candidate relationship mastery: You know how to attract, engage, and close passive candidates at the highest levels
  • Recruiting fundamentals are second nature: Sourcing, intake, interviewing, offer negotiation, stakeholder management—you've done it all at a high level
  • Genuinely curious about AI: You don't need to be technical, but you're excited to learn how AI can augment your recruiting work
  • Growth mindset: You're willing to learn new tools, experiment with new workflows, and occasionally feel uncomfortable as you master something new
  • Bonus Points
  • Prior experience with AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, AI sourcing platforms) in your recruiting work
  • Background at high-growth tech companies, recruiting agencies, or technical recruiting teams
  • You've already experimented with automation, built recruiting processes, or created "hacks" to work more efficiently
  • Comfortable giving product feedback or working closely with technical teams
Cultural Fit
Execution-oriented: You deliver results, not excuses
Collaborative learner: You'll work closely with engineers and product people—ego can't get in the way
Comfortable with ambiguity: Moon Engine is pre-launch. Things will change. You adapt.
Naturally curious: You want to understand how things work, not just use them
Long-term thinker: You see this as a multi-year journey to become a recruiting + AI expert, not just a job

🌙 Why This Opportunity Matters

Most recruiters will eventually have to learn AI. You'll be years ahead.
You're not choosing between being a great recruiter or learning AI—you're mastering both while helping build the platform. Think of it like learning digital marketing in 2005. Early movers win.
📈 What You Gain
Very competitive and unique compensation structure (base + commission + bonus, with long-term upside as Moon Engine scales)
Deep AI recruiting expertise in 6-12 months
Product influence—your feedback shapes what gets built
Client enablement role as Moon Engine launches
Unlimited PTO + thought leadership opportunities

The Senior Director, Global Site Contracts is a strategic leadership position responsible for the global oversight, execution, and continuous improvement of clinical site contracting activities supporting sponsored clinical trials worldwide. This role provides leadership for site contract strategy, governance, operational delivery, and process optimization across all regions to ensure rapid study startup, compliant contract execution, and high-quality operational performance.

The position partners closely with Clinical Operations, Legal, Finance, Global R&D Sourcing, Compliance, CROs, and external institutions to establish and maintain scalable contracting processes, global standards, negotiation strategies, and performance metrics. The role is expected to drive operational excellence through innovative solutions, standardized methodologies, data-driven decision-making, and strong stakeholder alignment.

As a member of the Clinical Business Operations leadership team, this individual contributes to organizational strategy, workforce planning, vendor management, and functional transformation initiatives that support the evolving needs of the clinical development portfolio.

Key responsibilities include:

• Lead and manage the Global Contracts Management team

• Oversee activities related to the execution of clinical site contract documents and associated processes.

Job Location: Washington D.C., District of Columbia, United States

Job Location Type: Remote

Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients

At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.

Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas –Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline of medicines to treat cancer, heart disease, inflammatory conditions, rare diseases, and obesity and obesity-related conditions. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.

Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.

Director – Business Partner Lead, Business Intelligence & Market Access

What you will do

Let’s do this. Let’s change the world. In this vital role you will serve as the Business Partner Lead for Customer Engagement, reporting directly to the Senior Director for Business Intelligence & Market Access

You will be responsible for leading category & sourcing teams across Data, Analytics, Market Research, Competitive Intelligence, Consent & Campaign Management, Market Access, Value & Pricing.

You will spearhead initiatives to define partnership strategies, oversee business planning and governance, and unlock innovation and value realization across Global Commercial Operations. Your mission will extend to fostering collaboration, enabling enterprise-wide initiatives, and championing change to position Global Procurement as a strategic value driver within the organization.

Roles & Responsibilities:

  • Serve as a trusted advisor and thought leader within the Commercialization organization, offering expert insights into market trends, supplier capabilities, and best practices for go-to-market strategies.
  • Forge strategic, high-impact partnerships with key stakeholders across Global Commercial Operations ensuring alignment between business priorities and procurement strategies.
  • Leverage market intelligence to craft business strategies that seamlessly connect with category objectives.
  • People leadership experience across global category & sourcing teams
  • Work strategically with the supply base to drive supplier-enabled innovation that supports and enhances business partner objectives.
  • Provide Business Intelligence & Market Access procurement expertise to catalyze business development, operational innovation, and other high-value initiatives.
  • Collaborate with Finance and cross-functional teams to generate, capture, and recognize value across the pipeline. Influence budgetary decisions and profit-and-loss outcomes to maximize impact.
  • Promote the adoption of Procurement-led and business-aligned strategic initiatives, ensuring integration across stakeholders, end users, suppliers, and strategic partners.
  • Bridge the gap between procurement performance and business objectives by driving the implementation of relevant initiatives developed by Category Leads.

What we expect of you

We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The professional we seek is a person with these qualifications.

Basic Qualifications:

  • Master’s degree and 10 years of business partnering, marketing, and/or related experience, OR
  • Bachelor’s degree and 12 years of business partnering, marketing, and/or related experience, AND
  • In addition to meeting at least one of the above requirements, you must have at least 5 years’ experience directly managing people and/or leadership experience leading teams, projects, programs, or directing the allocation or resources. Your managerial experience may run concurrently with the required technical experience referenced above.

Preferred Qualifications:

Functional Skills:

Must-Have Skills:

  • Proven track record of leading procurement teams or data & analytics / value & access teams
  • Proven track record of collaborating with senior-level stakeholders as a trusted business partner.
  • Strong leadership and influence within matrixed teams, with the ability to unify and guide cross-functional efforts.
  • Led teams to achieve outstanding results demonstrating value beyond savings
  • Demonstrated expertise in spearheading cross-functional initiatives, making strategic category trade-offs, and representing major vertical categories at top-level decision-making forums.
  • Exceptional change management skills, enabling the adoption of complex Procurement and business strategies across ecosystems.
  • Competence in translating business priorities into actionable category strategies.
  • Deep understanding of driving supplier-enabled innovation into commercial ecosystems.
  • Outstanding communication and stakeholder engagement abilities.

Good-to-Have Skills:

  • Advanced degree or significant professional experience
  • An analytical mindset focused on performance metrics and value management, encompassing the generation, realization, and recognition of pipeline value.
  • Expertise in Commercialization Contracting and/or Sourcing Excellence.

Professional Certifications:

  • Six Sigma, Good-to-Have
  • Agile, Good-to-Have

Soft Skills:

  • Demonstrates executive presence with the ability to influence effectively
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills tailored for executive-level interactions
  • Proven ability to collaborate with global, virtual teams
  • Adept at navigating ambiguity and adapting to change
  • Highly self-motivated with a proactive mindset
  • Exceptional multitasking and prioritization capabilities
  • A strong team player, dedicated to achieving collective goals

What you can expect of us

As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, we also work to care for your professional and personal growth and well-being. From our competitive benefits to our collaborative culture, we’ll support your journey every step of the way.

Job Title: Director, Real-World Evidence Data Platform

Summary



This role will be part of the Real-World Evidence team and will support the development, implementation, and operationalization of scalable real-world data platforms that enable high-quality, timely, and strategically relevant evidence generation. The Director will help advance connected data capabilities across claims, electronic health records, registries, specialty data sources, and other fit-for-purpose data assets to support priority evidence needs across the portfolio.

The Director will partner closely with HEOR leads, medical strategy teams, data partners, RWE colleagues, and cross-functional stakeholders to ensure that data platform capabilities are aligned with evidence generation priorities. This includes supporting the development of linked longitudinal data capabilities, helping evaluate and onboard data sources, strengthening data quality and documentation standards, and enabling more efficient activation of data assets for priority research questions.

As a member of the RWE team, the Director will contribute to evidence generation planning and execution by helping translate strategic evidence needs into practical data platform requirements. The role requires strong collaboration, technical knowledge of real-world data, and the ability to work across internal and external partners to support high-impact RWE deliverables.

This position can be based remotely anywhere in the U.S. (there may be some restrictions based on legal entity). Please note that this role would not provide relocation as a result. The expectation of working hours and travel (domestic and/or international) will be defined by the hiring manager. This position will require 20% travel.

About the Role

Key Responsibilities:

  • Support the development and operationalization of scalable real-world data platforms that enable efficient and high-quality RWE generation.
  • Partner with RWE leads and medical strategy teams to understand evidence needs and translate them into data platform requirements.
  • Support integration and use of relevant RWD sources, including claims, electronic health records, registries, specialty data, and other fit-for-purpose datasets.
  • Contribute to the development of linked longitudinal data capabilities to enable robust real-world analyses and endpoints.
  • Help evaluate, onboard, and manage external data vendors and platform partners in collaboration with senior team members.
  • Support data quality frameworks, validation protocols, documentation standards, and governance processes for RWE platform use.
  • Collaborate with analytics, epidemiology, biostatistics, medical, access, and other cross-functional partners to ensure data assets are fit for purpose.
  • Contribute to RWE project execution by enabling timely access to appropriate data assets and supporting efficient study activation.
  • Identify opportunities to improve data platform usability, scalability, and efficiency for evidence generation.
  • Communicate data platform capabilities, limitations, and opportunities clearly to internal stakeholders.
  • Support development of materials, summaries, and recommendations for leadership discussions related to RWD platform strategy.
  • Maintain awareness of evolving RWD sources, data linkage approaches, analytical platforms, and industry trends relevant to RWE.

Essential Requirements:

Education: A Bachelors degree is required. An Advanced degree in health economics, epidemiology, statistics, public health, health policy, data science, or a related field is required. Doctoral-level training or PharmD with relevant RWE, HEOR, epidemiology, or data science experience is preferred.

  • 7+ years of experience in the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, healthcare, consulting, or data/analytics sector.
  • Experience working with real-world data sources such as claims, electronic health records, registries, specialty pharmacy data, laboratory data, or linked datasets.
  • Experience supporting RWE, HEOR, epidemiology, outcomes research, medical affairs, market access, or related evidence-generation activities.
  • Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams and external data vendors or platform partners.
  • Demonstrated ability to support complex projects, manage multiple priorities, and communicate technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Experience with data quality assessment, data documentation, governance processes, or fit-for-purpose data evaluation is strongly preferred.
  • Strong understanding of real-world data sources and their application to evidence generation.
  • Working knowledge of RWE study designs, observational research methods, and data considerations for healthcare research.
  • Familiarity with data linkage, longitudinal patient journeys, endpoint development, and fit-for-purpose data assessment.
  • Understanding of US healthcare data ecosystems, including payer, provider, and specialty data sources.
  • Ability to partner with analytics and technical teams to support data platform development and implementation.
  • Knowledge of data privacy, compliance, documentation, and governance expectations for RWE use.

Novartis Compensation Summary:

The salary for this position is expected to range between $185,500 and $344,500 per year.

The final salary offered is determined based on factors like, but not limited to, relevant skills and experience, and upon joining Novartis will be reviewed periodically. Novartis may change the published salary range based on company and market factors.

Your compensation will include a performance-based cash incentive and, depending on the level of the role, eligibility to be considered for annual equity awards.

Collaborating, supporting and inspiring each other. Combining to achieve breakthroughs that change patients’ lives. Ready to create a brighter future together?

Job Title: EDC Clinical Trial Designer - FSP (Homebased - UK)

Job Location: Livingston, West Lothian, United Kingdom

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

The EDC Clinical Trial Designer will create high quality data collection tools for new clinical trials and facilitate activities related to the design, development, documentation, testing and implementation of clinical eCRF databases.

Design of eCRF forms using Oracle InForm/Central Designer or Veeva CDMS/Studio is expected. In addition, the EDC Clinical Trial Designer will ensure that all relevant standard operating procedures, CRF Standards, process and trial-specific guidelines are implemented and utilized to help ensure that a quality work product is produced and timelines and deliverables are consistently met.

Summary of the Essential Functions of the Job

  • Proficiency with the following in Central Designer/Studio
    • Understanding detailed data collection requirements based on the protocol and input from study team members.
    • Working with libraries and creating new forms when suitable forms do not exist.
    • Producing annotated study books.
    • Understanding of workflow design, dynamic forms and events.
    • Validation of study design for forms and schedule design.
    • Test steps development and QC of forms.
    • Basic understanding of activities needed for data integrations, local lab management, coding functionality.
    • Input into design of post-production form changes to the live trials.
  • Apply lessons learned from one study build to the next
  • Ability to conduct meetings with the study team to communicate work scope, project timelines, and project specific requirements.
  • Maintain a good working knowledge relative to regulatory requirements, industry trends, benchmarks, and best working practices in data management and database design by reading, participating in relevant training and/or association activities.

Minimum Requirements

  • BA/BS degree. Commensurate experience will be considered.
  • Minimum of 2 years of Clinical Data Management experience using electronic data capture systems.
  • Familiarity with clinical research processes and CDISC/CDASH/SDTM standards
  • Effective oral and written presentation and communication skills.
  • Strong attention to detail and a commitment to high quality work, customer service and getting things right the first time with minimal errors.
  • Ability to manage multiple project tasks and deliverables in a fast-paced constantly changing environment.
  • Experience in the planning and management of clinical trials in the biopharmaceutical industry or a related field

Summary

Remote

Novartis has an exciting opportunity for a Director, Analytics Infrastructure & Pipeline Operations. This role is responsible for building next-generation, AI-powered automated data pipelines and scalable data repositories that enable enterprise data science and analytics at scale. By leveraging advanced AI technologies, modern data engineering tools, and feature engineering platforms, this director creates self-service, analytics-ready datasets and enterprise feature stores that empower both expert data scientists and citizen data scientists to rapidly develop, deploy, and scale models.

This position can be based remotely anywhere in the U.S. (there may be some restrictions based on legal entity). Please note that this role would not provide relocation as a result. The expectation of working hours and travel (domestic and/or international) will be defined by the hiring manager. This position will require 20% travel.

About the Role

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and implement intelligent, self-healing data pipelines that leverage AI/ML for automated data quality monitoring, anomaly detection, and remediation.
  • Build and maintain centralized feature stores that enable feature reusability across multiple models and use cases.
  • Create curated data repositories optimized for data science/AI workflows, including training datasets, evaluation datasets, and production serving layers.
  • Develop automated feature engineering pipelines that transform raw data into analytics-ready features with lineage tracking.
  • Partner with Enterprise IT to optimize analytics platform architecture for high-performance data science workloads.
  • Build automated pipelines that integrate diverse data sources including sales, CRM, patient claims, real-world evidence, and unstructured data.
  • Create self-service data access layers that empower data scientists and analysts to query and extract data independently.
  • Establish SLAs for data availability, freshness, and quality; implement monitoring and observability solutions.

Essential Requirements

  • Advanced degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, or related field;
  • 10+ years of experience in data engineering, ML/AI engineering, or analytics infrastructure.
  • 5+ years leading teams building enterprise-scale data platforms and feature stores.
  • Expert knowledge of feature store technologies (Feast, Tecton, SageMaker Feature Store, Databricks Feature Store).
  • Deep expertise in modern data platforms optimized for ML workloads (Databricks, Auto ML, Snowflake, BigQuery).
  • Strong proficiency in Python, SQL, Spark/PySpark for large-scale data processing.

We bring life to urban downtowns, suburban hubs, small towns, and rural areas through master-planned communities, mixed-use developments, parks, and recreation facilities. The result: vibrant economic centers, resilient neighborhoods, and welcoming places that feel like home.

If you’re passionate about empowering communities, join us to discover a career with endless opportunities to make communities more equitable, resilient, and livable. 

Your Opportunity

Stantec is seeking experienced Civil Engineering Technologist or Technician focusing on Mission Critical Data Center projects within our Community Development Group. Within this team, you will have the opportunity to work on Data Center projects of various sizes across the country. The Mission Critical space requires a very proactive, responsive, and efficient design team with projects serving Fortune 10 companies who are making headlines with transformational projects. For the right candidate, there is the potential for this to be a remote work position.

The engineers on this team are a core design group dedicated to serving Data Center clients and similar major commercial programs. The projects they work on require a variety and diverse set of skills to assist our clients with site due diligence, design, entitlement approvals, permitting, and construction. Within this team you will be exposed to different design requirements across multiple geographic regions as well as different Mission Critical and commercial projects of various sizes and operational needs.

This position involves working collaboratively within the Mission Critical core design team, project partners, and various different services in the development of private civil site designs; construction plans and specifications; preparing reports, studies, and construction contract documents; computing quantities and preparing opinions of cost; performing field observations and assisting in the coordination and management of construction activities.

Your Key Responsibilities

  • Support engineering projects working directly with engineers, project managers, and design team members
  • Deliver high quality drafting of engineering drawings and exhibits
  • Assist with maintaining and further developing drafting standards, mentoring staff, and implement industry leaching technology with respect to CADD and design software
  • Draft plans for civil and related discipline design projects utilizing AutoDesk Civil 3D.
  • Perform site grading analysis and calculations utilizing Autodesk Civil 3D; prepare street and utility plan and profiles, project details, and quantity take offs.
  • Work independently and collaboratively to complete project timelines and requirements
  • Assist civil engineers with site design, utility design, grading, and overall plan production.
  • Manages deadlines and prioritizes assignments; able to work on multiple projects as schedules dictate
  • Assists with the development of a design through sketches, electronic models, diagrams, and other visual formats.
  • Utilizes technologies in development of three-dimensional models of civil systems.
  • Coordinates with other disciplines to ensure compatibility with the design intent.

  • Perform quality of earnings, debt and debt-like, working capital analysis
  • Develop an understanding of a target’s business, recognize and evaluate key performance drivers, operational trends and developments of target companies, in addition to challenging target assumptions
  • Create and design tailored transaction advisory reports specific to key issues such as normalized earnings, financial reporting, net working capital trends, and indebtedness considerations
  • Communicate due diligence findings and critical deal issues confidently in a clear, concise and articulate manner, both verbally and in written reports
  • Create a collaborative team environment, motivate, and develop and mentor/coach team through communication and actions
  • Lead and participate in people development and business development efforts

  • Demonstrated experience leading buy-side and sell-side transaction services engagements in the lower to middle market space
